materials-science.gist: Infer residual stress tensors from lattice-strain measurements via sin^2 psi analysis or inverse eigenstrain reconstruction.

materials-science.name: Dislocation dynamics and crystal plasticity
materials-science.gist: Simulate dislocation interactions or single-crystal slip with Schmid-law crystal plasticity to predict yield anisotropy and texture evolution.

materials-science.name: Interatomic potential fitting
materials-science.gist: Fit Lennard-Jones, Morse, EAM or Tersoff-type potentials to reference energies, forces and elastic constants and validate transferability.

materials-science.name: Molecular dynamics of materials properties
materials-science.gist: Run small classical MD simulations with ASE to compute thermal expansion, diffusion coefficients, RDFs or melting behaviour.

materials-science.name: Elastic constants from atomistic calculations
materials-science.gist: Derive elastic tensors from stress-strain or energy-strain fits on atomistic models and compute polycrystalline averages and stability criteria.

materials-science.name: Point defect thermodynamics
materials-science.gist: Compute defect formation energies, charge transition levels and equilibrium defect concentrations with self-consistent Fermi level solutions.

materials-science.name: Electronic band structure from tight-binding
materials-science.gist: Build tight-binding Hamiltonians for crystals or 2D materials and compute bands, DOS, effective masses and gaps along high-symmetry paths.

materials-science.name: Semiconductor carrier transport modelling
materials-science.gist: Model carrier concentrations, mobility and conductivity versus temperature and doping, and fit Hall and resistivity measurements.

materials-science.name: Thermoelectric property analysis
materials-science.gist: Fit Seebeck, conductivity and thermal conductivity data with single-parabolic-band models to extract effective mass and optimize zT.

materials-science.name: Phonons and lattice thermal properties
materials-science.gist: Compute phonon dispersions from force-constant models and derive heat capacity, Debye temperature and quasi-harmonic thermal expansion.

materials-science.name: Magnetic materials and hysteresis modelling
materials-science.gist: Fit Jiles-Atherton, Preisach or Curie-Weiss models to magnetization data and simulate Ising or micromagnetic behaviour.

materials-science.name: Dielectric and ferroelectric response
materials-science.gist: Fit Debye, Havriliak-Negami or Cole-Cole relaxation models to impedance-derived permittivity spectra and analyse P-E loops.

materials-science.name: Optical properties of thin films
materials-science.gist: Invert transmission, reflectance or ellipsometry spectra with Cauchy, Tauc-Lorentz and transfer-matrix models to obtain thickness and optical constants.

materials-science.name: Optical absorption and band gap analysis
materials-science.gist: Determine direct and indirect optical gaps, Urbach energies and sub-gap absorption from UV-Vis transmission, absorbance or diffuse-reflectance (Kubelka-Munk) data with baseline, scattering and interference corrections.

materials-science.name: Polymer molecular weight distributions
materials-science.gist: Compute Mn, Mw and dispersity from GPC/SEC chromatograms with calibration curves and deconvolve multimodal distributions.

materials-science.name: Polymerization kinetics modelling
materials-science.gist: Solve ODE or method-of-moments models for radical, step-growth or living polymerization and fit rate constants to conversion data.

materials-science.name: Polymer chain conformation and scattering
materials-science.gist: Simulate freely jointed, worm-like or self-avoiding chains and fit SAXS/SANS form factors to extract radius of gyration and persistence length.

materials-science.name: Polymer thermal analysis (DSC and TGA)
materials-science.gist: Extract glass transition, melting, crystallinity and decomposition kinetics from DSC and TGA curves using isoconversional and Kissinger methods.

materials-science.name: Polymer rheology and flow models
materials-science.gist: Fit Carreau-Yasuda, Cross and Maxwell multimode models to shear and oscillatory rheology data and predict processing behaviour.

materials-science.name: Polymer blend thermodynamics
materials-science.gist: Compute Flory-Huggins phase diagrams, spinodals and interaction parameters from cloud-point or scattering data.

materials-science.name: Battery cycling data analysis
materials-science.gist: Process cycler time series to extract capacity fade, coulombic efficiency, differential capacity (dQ/dV) features and state-of-health trends.

materials-science.name: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy fitting
materials-science.gist: Fit equivalent-circuit and distribution-of-relaxation-times models to impedance spectra of cells, electrolytes and coatings.

materials-science.name: Battery cell physics-based modelling
materials-science.gist: Simulate single-particle or pseudo-2D lithium-ion models and estimate diffusion and kinetic parameters from discharge and GITT data.

materials-science.name: Ionic conductivity and solid electrolytes
materials-science.gist: Analyse Arrhenius conductivity, MD-derived mean-square displacements and percolation in solid-state ionic conductors.

materials-science.name: Electrode open-circuit voltage and thermodynamics
materials-science.gist: Fit OCV curves with lattice-gas or Redlich-Kister models and compute stability windows and voltage from formation energies.

materials-science.name: Corrosion and electrochemical kinetics
materials-science.gist: Fit Tafel and Butler-Volmer models to polarization curves to extract corrosion rates and analyse passivation behaviour.

materials-science.name: Photovoltaic device characterization
materials-science.gist: Fit single- and double-diode models to J-V curves, analyse EQE spectra and estimate losses and detailed-balance limits.

materials-science.name: Hydrogen storage and gas adsorption isotherms
materials-science.gist: Fit Langmuir, Sips and BET isotherms to sorption data to obtain surface areas, pore size distributions and isosteric heats.

materials-science.name: X-ray photoelectron spectrum fitting
materials-science.gist: Apply Shirley or Tougaard backgrounds and fit constrained Voigt multiplets to XPS spectra for chemical-state quantification.

materials-science.name: Raman and vibrational spectra analysis
materials-science.gist: Baseline-correct, deconvolve and track Raman or FTIR peaks to quantify phase, strain, crystallinity or defect density in materials.

materials-science.name: Electron microscopy image and diffraction analysis
materials-science.gist: Analyse simulated TEM/STEM images and diffraction patterns: FFT lattice measurement, atom-column finding, strain mapping and pattern indexing.

materials-science.name: Pair distribution function analysis
materials-science.gist: Compute and fit real-space PDFs G(r) from total-scattering data with small-box structural models, including termination ripples, damping and local-versus-average structure comparison.

materials-science.name: X-ray absorption fine structure analysis
materials-science.gist: Normalize and background-subtract XANES/EXAFS spectra, then fit the EXAFS equation for coordination numbers, bond distances and Debye-Waller factors, and do linear-combination speciation.

materials-science.name: Small-angle scattering of nanoparticles and precipitates
materials-science.gist: Fit Guinier, Porod and polydisperse sphere or cylinder form factors with structure factors to SAXS/SANS curves to get precipitate size distributions and volume fractions.

materials-science.name: X-ray and neutron reflectivity of multilayers
materials-science.gist: Fit specular reflectivity curves with Parratt recursion and interfacial roughness models to recover layer thicknesses, densities and scattering-length-density profiles.

materials-science.name: Ion-beam and depth-profiling analysis
materials-science.gist: Simulate and fit Rutherford backscattering spectra and deconvolve SIMS or sputter depth profiles to get elemental depth distributions, layer stoichiometry and implant profiles.

materials-science.name: Mossbauer spectroscopy fitting
materials-science.gist: Fit singlets, quadrupole doublets and hyperfine sextets to Mossbauer spectra to extract isomer shifts, quadrupole splittings, hyperfine fields and site populations.

materials-science.name: Formation-energy convex hulls and stability diagrams
materials-science.gist: Build compositional convex hulls from formation energies to find energies above hull and decomposition products, and construct Pourbaix and chemical-potential stability maps.

materials-science.name: Cluster expansion and lattice Monte Carlo of alloy ordering
materials-science.gist: Fit effective cluster interactions to configurational energies with cross-validation and run Metropolis Monte Carlo for order-disorder transitions, short-range order and ground states.

materials-science.name: Kinetic Monte Carlo of surfaces and defect migration
materials-science.gist: Simulate thin-film deposition, island nucleation, step-flow growth or vacancy-mediated diffusion with rate-catalog KMC, and extract roughness scaling and effective kinetics.

materials-science.name: Crystal structure prediction by global optimization
materials-science.gist: Search for low-energy atomic arrangements of clusters or crystals with model potentials using basin hopping, genetic algorithms or simulated annealing, with structure de-duplication.

materials-science.name: Ionic crystal energetics and bond valence analysis
materials-science.gist: Compute Madelung constants and lattice energies by Ewald summation, apply Born-Haber cycles, and check structure plausibility with bond-valence sums and Pauling-rule metrics.

materials-science.name: Surface energies and equilibrium crystal shapes
materials-science.gist: Derive facet surface energies from slab models or broken-bond counts and build Wulff constructions for equilibrium and supported nanoparticle shapes and facet fractions.

materials-science.name: Machine learning of materials properties
materials-science.gist: Featurize compositions and structures with elemental-property and structural descriptors, and train and validate regression or classification models for properties with leakage-aware splits.

materials-science.name: Bayesian optimization and active learning for materials experiments
materials-science.gist: Use Gaussian-process surrogates and acquisition functions to plan sequential synthesis or processing experiments under constraints and multiple objectives.

materials-science.name: Materials selection and performance indices
materials-science.gist: Derive Ashby performance indices from design requirements and rank candidate materials from property databases with multi-objective, Pareto and cost constraints.

materials-science.name: Glass viscosity and composition-property models
materials-science.gist: Fit VFT, MYEGA and Arrhenius viscosity models, compute fragility and characteristic temperatures, and build additive or regression models of glass properties versus oxide composition.

materials-science.name: Sintering and densification kinetics
materials-science.gist: Model and fit solid-state sintering with master sintering curves, neck-growth laws and densification-rate equations from dilatometry shrinkage data to get activation energies.

materials-science.name: High-temperature oxidation kinetics
materials-science.gist: Fit parabolic, linear and logarithmic oxidation laws and Deal-Grove or Wagner models to mass-gain or scale-thickness data, and use Ellingham diagrams for oxide stability.

materials-science.name: Hydrogen permeation and trapping in metals
materials-science.gist: Analyse electrochemical permeation transients and thermal desorption spectra with diffusion-trapping (McNabb-Foster, Oriani) models to get diffusivities, trap energies and densities.

materials-science.name: Radiation damage and displacement cascades
materials-science.gist: Estimate displacements per atom with Kinchin-Pease/NRT models, compute ion ranges and damage profiles with binary-collision approaches, and model defect accumulation and swelling.

materials-science.name: Contact mechanics, friction and wear
materials-science.gist: Apply Hertz, JKR and DMT contact models to indentation and adhesion data, analyse rough-surface contact, and fit Archard or similar wear laws to tribometer measurements.

materials-science.name: Cellular solids and architected lattice materials
materials-science.gist: Relate relative density to stiffness and strength with Gibson-Ashby scaling, analyse foam compression curves, and compute effective properties of truss and lattice unit cells.

materials-science.name: Thin-film stress and epitaxial misfit
materials-science.gist: Compute film stress from wafer-curvature data with Stoney-type corrections, and model epitaxial misfit strain, critical thickness for dislocation formation and strain relaxation.

materials-science.name: Superconducting materials characterization
materials-science.gist: Extract Tc, upper critical fields and critical currents from resistivity and magnetization data, and fit BCS gap, WHH, Bean critical-state and flux-pinning models.

materials-science.name: Shape memory alloys and martensitic transformations
materials-science.gist: Model transformation temperatures, superelastic hysteresis and transformation strain with phenomenological constitutive models, and analyse thermal-cycling DSC and strain data.

materials-science.name: Thermal transport measurement analysis
materials-science.gist: Invert laser-flash, 3-omega, transient plane source or thermoreflectance data with heat-conduction models to get thermal diffusivity, conductivity and interface conductance.

materials-science.name: Welding and additive manufacturing thermal modelling
materials-science.gist: Use Rosenthal and finite-difference heat-source models to predict melt-pool dimensions, cooling rates and thermal histories, and relate them to defects and microstructure.

materials-science.name: Colloidal and nanoparticle characterization
materials-science.gist: Invert dynamic light scattering correlograms to size distributions, analyse zeta potential data, and compute DLVO interaction energies and aggregation stability.

materials-science.name: Cement hydration and concrete properties
materials-science.gist: Model hydration kinetics from isothermal calorimetry, phase assemblage and maturity-based strength development, and fit strength models from mix design data.

materials-science.name: Ultrasonic and nondestructive evaluation
materials-science.gist: Process pulse-echo, resonant ultrasound and eddy-current signals to measure wave velocities, elastic constants and attenuation, and to detect and size flaws in scan data.

materials-science.name: Single-crystal diffraction indexing and structure factors
materials-science.gist: Index single-crystal or Laue reflections to determine UB matrices and orientations, compute structure factors and systematic absences, and solve simple structures with Patterson or direct methods.

materials-science.name: High-resolution XRD of epitaxial films
materials-science.gist: Analyse rocking curves, superlattice satellites, thickness fringes and reciprocal space maps of epitaxial layers to obtain composition, strain relaxation, period and mosaicity, using dynamical or kinematical simulation.

materials-science.name: EDS and EELS spectral quantification
materials-science.gist: Quantify elemental composition from energy-dispersive X-ray spectra with Cliff-Lorimer or ZAF corrections, and process EELS spectra with power-law backgrounds, edge integration, Fourier-log deconvolution and log-ratio thickness.

materials-science.name: Atom probe tomography data analysis
materials-science.gist: Range mass-to-charge spectra, reconstruct and analyse point clouds for solute clustering, proxigrams, interfacial excess and nearest-neighbour distributions against random-solution baselines.

materials-science.name: X-ray computed tomography reconstruction of materials
materials-science.gist: Reconstruct sample volumes from projection sinograms with filtered back-projection or iterative methods, correct ring and beam-hardening artifacts, and segment voxels to quantify porosity and defects.

materials-science.name: Capacitance-voltage and deep-level transient spectroscopy
materials-science.gist: Extract doping profiles, flat-band voltages and interface-trap densities from MOS and Schottky C-V data, and determine trap activation energies and capture cross-sections from DLTS spectra and Arrhenius plots.

materials-science.name: Photoluminescence and carrier recombination kinetics
materials-science.gist: Fit steady-state and time-resolved photoluminescence with multi-exponential, stretched or ABC recombination models to obtain lifetimes, radiative efficiencies and trap densities, including deconvolution of the instrument response.

materials-science.name: Quantum wells and heterostructure band engineering
materials-science.gist: Solve effective-mass Schrodinger-Poisson problems for quantum wells, superlattices and heterojunctions to compute subband energies, wavefunctions, band alignment and two-dimensional carrier densities.

materials-science.name: Nanoparticle optics and Mie scattering
materials-science.gist: Compute extinction, scattering and plasmon resonances of metallic and dielectric nanoparticles with Mie theory, quasi-static and effective-medium approximations, and invert spectra for size and concentration.

materials-science.name: Liquid crystal order and elasticity
materials-science.gist: Model nematic order parameters with Maier-Saupe or Landau-de Gennes theory, compute director configurations and Freedericksz thresholds from Frank elasticity, and fit birefringence and dielectric data.

materials-science.name: Rubber elasticity and hyperelastic model fitting
materials-science.gist: Fit Neo-Hookean, Mooney-Rivlin, Ogden, Yeoh and Arruda-Boyce models to uniaxial, biaxial and shear data of elastomers, checking stability and accounting for the Mullins effect.

materials-science.name: Gelation and polymer network structure
materials-science.gist: Predict gel points and sol fractions with Flory-Stockmayer and Macosko-Miller theory, estimate crosslink density from Flory-Rehner swelling and modulus data, and locate gelation from rheological crossover.

materials-science.name: Block copolymer self-assembly and self-consistent field theory
materials-science.gist: Solve mean-field SCFT or weak-segregation models for block copolymer melts to map microphase morphologies, domain spacings and order-disorder transitions versus chi N and composition.

materials-science.name: Gas and moisture transport in polymers and membranes
materials-science.gist: Analyse time-lag permeation and gravimetric sorption kinetics with Fickian, dual-mode and non-Fickian models to get diffusivity, solubility and permeability, and evaluate selectivity trade-off bounds.

materials-science.name: Accelerated ageing and service lifetime prediction
materials-science.gist: Fit Arrhenius, Eyring and time-temperature-humidity degradation models to accelerated ageing data of polymers, coatings and devices, and extrapolate lifetimes with uncertainty.

materials-science.name: Cyclic voltammetry and electrocatalyst evaluation
materials-science.gist: Analyse cyclic and rotating-disk voltammograms with Randles-Sevcik, Koutecky-Levich and Laviron analyses to extract electrochemically active surface area, diffusion coefficients, electron counts and kinetic currents.

materials-science.name: Fuel cell and electrolyzer polarization modelling
materials-science.gist: Fit activation, ohmic and mass-transport loss models to polarization curves of PEM and solid-oxide fuel cells and electrolyzers, and separate loss contributions to estimate efficiency and degradation.

materials-science.name: Piezoelectric and electromechanical property characterization
materials-science.gist: Extract piezoelectric, elastic and dielectric coefficients and electromechanical coupling factors from impedance resonance-antiresonance spectra of standard geometries and from strain-field and charge-stress measurements, and transform piezoelectric tensors between orientations.

materials-science.name: Magnetocaloric effect analysis
materials-science.gist: Compute isothermal entropy change, adiabatic temperature change and refrigerant capacity from M(H,T) and heat-capacity data via Maxwell relations, and assess transition order with Arrott and universal-curve scaling.

materials-science.name: Spin-wave and magnetic excitation modelling
materials-science.gist: Compute magnon dispersions with linear spin-wave theory for Heisenberg models with anisotropy, and fit exchange constants to neutron-scattering-like dispersion or magnetic heat-capacity data.

materials-science.name: Anisotropic yield criteria and sheet metal formability
materials-science.gist: Calibrate Hill48, Barlat and Yld2000 yield functions from Lankford r-values and directional yield stresses, and predict forming limit diagrams with Marciniak-Kuczynski or Swift and Hill instability analyses.

materials-science.name: High strain-rate testing and stress-wave analysis
materials-science.gist: Process split Hopkinson bar, Taylor impact and plate-impact signals with wave separation, time alignment and Pochhammer-Chree dispersion correction to obtain dynamic stress-strain curves, check specimen equilibrium and extract rate-dependent properties.

materials-science.name: Grain boundary geometry and energy
materials-science.gist: Compute coincident site lattices, sigma values and misorientation descriptors for bicrystals, build boundary structures, and fit Read-Shockley or other grain boundary energy models to atomistic or experimental data.

materials-science.name: Strengthening mechanism modelling
materials-science.gist: Combine Hall-Petch, solid-solution, Orowan precipitation, shearing and Taylor dislocation strengthening contributions into yield-strength predictions and fit their parameters to processed-alloy data.

materials-science.name: Electromigration and interconnect reliability
materials-science.gist: Fit Black's equation and lognormal failure statistics to electromigration test data, model stress build-up with Korhonen and Blech-length analyses, and analyse dielectric breakdown and time-dependent breakdown lifetimes.

materials-science.name: Thin-film deposition process kinetics
materials-science.gist: Model CVD and ALD growth rates, ALD saturation curves, sputter yields, thickness uniformity across substrates and step coverage in trenches with surface-kinetics and transport models.

materials-science.name: Landau theory of structural and ferroic phase transitions
materials-science.gist: Fit Landau-Devonshire free-energy expansions to order-parameter, spontaneous-strain, dielectric and heat-capacity data to classify transition order and locate tricritical points and coupling coefficients.

materials-science.name: Wetting, contact angles and surface free energy
materials-science.gist: Determine solid surface energies from contact angles with Owens-Wendt, van Oss and Neumann methods, fit drop profiles to the Young-Laplace equation, and model Wenzel and Cassie-Baxter wetting on textured surfaces.

materials-science.name: Grand canonical Monte Carlo adsorption in porous frameworks
materials-science.gist: Simulate gas adsorption in zeolite, MOF or carbon models with GCMC and force fields, compute geometric pore size distributions and accessible surface areas, and predict isotherms and selectivities.

materials-science.name: Tortuosity and effective transport in porous microstructures
materials-science.gist: Compute effective conductivity, diffusivity, permeability and tortuosity factors of electrodes, membranes and porous media by solving Laplace or Stokes problems on voxel images and compare with Bruggeman-type relations.

astronomy.name: Aperture photometry of CCD frames
astronomy.gist: Measure source fluxes in calibrated images with apertures and local sky annuli, propagating Poisson, read-noise and background errors into magnitudes and uncertainties.

astronomy.name: PSF-fitting photometry in crowded fields
astronomy.gist: Model a spatially varying point-spread function and simultaneously fit blended stars in dense cluster or bulge images to recover fluxes and positions.

astronomy.name: CCD calibration and image reduction
astronomy.gist: Build master bias, dark and flat frames, correct for overscan, nonlinearity and bad pixels, and reject cosmic rays to produce science-ready frames.

astronomy.name: Photometric zero points and color terms
astronomy.gist: Solve for nightly zero points, extinction coefficients and color transformations between instrumental and standard systems from standard-star observations.

astronomy.name: Image coaddition and resampling
astronomy.gist: Register, reproject and weight-combine dithered exposures onto a common pixel grid with outlier rejection and correct noise propagation.

astronomy.name: Difference imaging for transient detection
astronomy.gist: PSF-match a reference to a science image, subtract, and detect and measure variable or new point sources in the difference image.

astronomy.name: Source detection and deblending
astronomy.gist: Estimate background and noise maps, segment images into sources above threshold, deblend overlapping objects and build catalogs with shape parameters.

astronomy.name: Galaxy surface brightness profile fitting
astronomy.gist: Fit Sérsic, exponential-disk and bulge-plus-disk models convolved with the PSF to galaxy images to derive structural parameters.

astronomy.name: Weak lensing shear measurement
astronomy.gist: Measure galaxy ellipticities, correct for PSF anisotropy and noise bias, and estimate tangential shear profiles or shear correlation functions.

astronomy.name: Long-slit and echelle spectral extraction
astronomy.gist: Trace spectral orders, perform optimal extraction with sky subtraction and apply flat-field and blaze corrections to 2D spectrograph frames.

astronomy.name: Wavelength calibration from arc lamps
astronomy.gist: Identify arc or sky emission lines and fit dispersion solutions, including 2D solutions across echelle orders, with residual-based outlier rejection.

astronomy.name: Flux calibration and telluric correction
astronomy.gist: Derive instrumental sensitivity from spectrophotometric standards and remove atmospheric absorption bands using telluric standards or transmission models.

astronomy.name: Radial velocity measurement by cross-correlation
astronomy.gist: Compute stellar or galaxy velocities by cross-correlating spectra with templates or line masks, including barycentric correction and error estimation.

astronomy.name: Stellar atmospheric parameter estimation
astronomy.gist: Infer effective temperature, surface gravity and metallicity by fitting synthetic spectral grids or equivalent widths to observed stellar spectra.

astronomy.name: Emission-line diagnostics of nebulae and galaxies
astronomy.gist: Fit emission-line fluxes and use line ratios to derive electron temperatures, densities, abundances, extinction and excitation classes.

astronomy.name: Photometric redshift estimation
astronomy.gist: Estimate galaxy redshifts from multiband photometry using template fitting or empirical regression and quantify outlier rates and probability distributions.

astronomy.name: Quasar absorption line analysis
astronomy.gist: Fit Voigt profiles to intervening metal and Lyman-series absorbers to measure column densities, Doppler parameters and redshifts.

astronomy.name: Interstellar extinction and dust modeling
astronomy.gist: Derive reddening and extinction curves from stellar colors or spectra and build line-of-sight or 3D dust maps.

astronomy.name: Image astrometry and geometric calibration
astronomy.gist: Determine and apply the mapping between detector pixels and sky or focal-plane positions. Tasks include absolute and differential astrometry, image registration, optical distortion and plate-scale characterization, focal-plane geometry, field rotation and differential refraction corrections, centroiding precision, and astrometric error budgets for imaging instruments.

astronomy.name: Proper motion and parallax fitting
astronomy.gist: Fit five-parameter astrometric models to multi-epoch positions, including parallax ellipses, and assess excess noise from unresolved companions.

astronomy.name: Coordinate systems and time scales
astronomy.gist: Transform positions between celestial frames, apply precession, nutation, aberration and refraction, and convert among UTC, TT, TDB and barycentric times.

astronomy.name: Catalog cross-matching and membership
astronomy.gist: Probabilistically match sources across catalogs with differing astrometric precision and assign cluster or association membership from kinematics and photometry.

astronomy.name: Orbit determination of minor bodies
astronomy.gist: Fit heliocentric orbits of asteroids or comets to astrometric observations, propagate uncertainties and compute ephemerides and close approaches.

astronomy.name: Visual and astrometric binary orbits
astronomy.gist: Fit Keplerian orbital elements to relative positions or photocenter wobble of binaries to derive periods, inclinations and dynamical masses.

astronomy.name: Periodograms for variable stars
astronomy.gist: Detect periods in unevenly sampled light curves using Lomb-Scargle, phase dispersion or multiharmonic methods and assess significance and aliases.

astronomy.name: Exoplanet transit light curve fitting
astronomy.gist: Detrend photometric time series, search for transits with box least squares, and fit limb-darkened transit models for planet and orbit parameters.

astronomy.name: Radial velocity time-series analysis
astronomy.gist: Analyse sequences of stellar radial velocities over time. Tasks include orbital solutions for single- and double-lined spectroscopic binaries and substellar companions, and mass functions with minimum masses. They also cover periodicity searches on unevenly sampled velocities, alias diagnosis, and decorrelation against activity indicators or instrumental offsets. Further examples are pulsation and rotational modulation signals, combining data from multiple instruments, detection limits and injection-recovery tests, and observation scheduling for velocity campaigns.

astronomy.name: Eclipsing binary modeling
astronomy.gist: Fit light and radial velocity curves of eclipsing binaries to obtain stellar radii, masses, temperature ratios and orbital geometry.

astronomy.name: Supernova light curve analysis
astronomy.gist: Fit empirical or parametric models to multiband supernova photometry to derive peak magnitudes, decline rates, standardized distances and classifications.

astronomy.name: Transient classification from light curves
astronomy.gist: Extract features from sparse multiband light curves and classify transients and variables while handling class imbalance and missing epochs.

astronomy.name: Gravitational microlensing event modeling
astronomy.gist: Fit point-lens and binary-lens magnification models, including parallax and finite-source effects, to microlensing photometry.

astronomy.name: Pulsar timing analysis
astronomy.gist: Fit timing models with spin, astrometric and binary parameters to pulse arrival times and characterize red and white noise residuals.

astronomy.name: Asteroseismology of solar-like oscillators
astronomy.gist: Compute power spectra of stellar light curves, measure numax and large frequency separation, and infer masses and radii through scaling relations.

astronomy.name: Stochastic variability of accreting sources
astronomy.gist: Model AGN or X-ray binary light curves with damped random walks, power spectral densities and time lags between bands.

astronomy.name: X-ray and gamma-ray spectral fitting
astronomy.gist: Fit absorbed power-law, thermal plasma and blackbody models to counts spectra with response matrices using Poisson likelihoods.

astronomy.name: Photon event list and high-energy timing
astronomy.gist: Process event lists to build barycentered light curves, detect pulsations with epoch folding or Z-squared tests, and identify flares.

astronomy.name: Radio interferometric imaging
astronomy.gist: Grid visibilities, form dirty images, and deconvolve with CLEAN or regularized methods while handling weighting and primary beam corrections.

astronomy.name: Radio spectral line cube analysis
astronomy.gist: Fit baselines, extract moment maps and rotation curves, and measure HI or molecular line kinematics from spectral data cubes.

astronomy.name: Radio frequency interference flagging
astronomy.gist: Detect and mask impulsive and narrowband interference in dynamic spectra or visibility data using robust statistics and morphological filters.

astronomy.name: Fast transient and dispersion searches
astronomy.gist: Dedisperse filterbank data over trial dispersion measures and detect single pulses or periodic signals above noise thresholds.

astronomy.name: CMB power spectrum estimation
astronomy.gist: Estimate angular power spectra from masked sky maps with pseudo-Cl or likelihood methods including beam, noise and mode-coupling corrections.

astronomy.name: Cosmological parameter inference
astronomy.gist: Constrain cosmological parameters by sampling likelihoods built from distance, growth or power spectrum measurements and compare models.

astronomy.name: Galaxy clustering statistics
astronomy.gist: Compute two-point correlation functions or power spectra from galaxy catalogs with random catalogs, and fit bias and baryon acoustic oscillation scales.

astronomy.name: Cosmological distance and growth calculations
astronomy.gist: Numerically compute distances, ages, lookback times and linear growth factors for general dark-energy and curvature models.

astronomy.name: N-body and halo finding
astronomy.gist: Run small gravitational N-body simulations, identify halos with friends-of-friends or spherical overdensity methods, and measure mass functions and profiles.

astronomy.name: Galaxy cluster mass estimation
astronomy.gist: Estimate cluster masses from member velocity dispersions, X-ray hydrostatic profiles, lensing profiles or scaling relations with selection effects.

astronomy.name: Strong gravitational lens modeling
astronomy.gist: Fit lens mass models to multiple image positions, flux ratios or extended arcs to infer Einstein radii, mass profiles and time delays.

astronomy.name: Galactic dynamics and orbit integration
astronomy.gist: Integrate stellar orbits in Milky Way potentials, compute actions and integrals of motion, and fit potentials to kinematic tracers.

astronomy.name: Galaxy rotation curves and mass models
astronomy.gist: Decompose observed rotation curves into stellar, gas and dark-matter halo contributions and compare halo profile families.

astronomy.name: Stellar cluster isochrone fitting
astronomy.gist: Fit isochrones to color-magnitude diagrams accounting for binaries, extinction and field contamination to infer age, distance and metallicity.

astronomy.name: Stellar structure and evolution modeling
astronomy.gist: Solve stellar structure equations, polytropes or simple evolution sequences and compare predicted luminosities, radii and lifetimes with observations.

astronomy.name: Radiative transfer in stellar and planetary atmospheres
astronomy.gist: Solve plane-parallel radiative transfer to compute emergent spectra, line profiles, limb darkening or temperature-pressure profiles.

astronomy.name: Exoplanet atmosphere retrieval
astronomy.gist: Infer molecular abundances, temperatures and clouds from transmission or emission spectra using forward models and Bayesian sampling.

astronomy.name: Planetary dynamics and resonances
astronomy.gist: Integrate multi-planet or small-body systems, analyze mean-motion resonances, secular evolution and long-term stability.

astronomy.name: Planetary surface and shape modeling
astronomy.gist: Analyze digital elevation models, crater size-frequency distributions or asteroid light curves to infer surface ages, topography and spin states.

astronomy.name: Solar physics data analysis
astronomy.gist: Analyze solar images, magnetograms and irradiance series to track active regions, measure differential rotation and characterize flares.

astronomy.name: Spectral energy distribution fitting
astronomy.gist: Fit galaxy spectra or UV-to-radio broadband photometry with combinations of simple stellar populations plus dust and AGN components to recover star-formation histories, ages, metallicities, stellar masses, luminosities and dust properties.

astronomy.name: Telescope optics and detector performance
astronomy.gist: Model optical aberrations, PSFs, throughput and detector gain, linearity and noise from calibration data and ray or Fourier optics.

astronomy.name: Observation planning and exposure time calculation
astronomy.gist: Compute target visibility, airmass and scheduling, and estimate signal-to-noise and exposure times from source, sky and instrument models.

astronomy.name: Gravitational-wave data analysis
astronomy.gist: Whiten detector strain with estimated noise spectra, matched-filter against compact-binary templates, and infer source masses, spins, distance and sky location by Bayesian sampling.

astronomy.name: Polarimetry and Faraday rotation
astronomy.gist: Derive Stokes parameters, polarization fractions and angles from polarimetric images or spectra, correct instrumental polarization and bias, and recover rotation measures with RM synthesis.

astronomy.name: Optical and VLBI interferometric visibilities
astronomy.gist: Fit uniform-disk, limb-darkened, binary or ring models to squared visibilities and closure phases to measure stellar diameters, companion separations or compact-source structure.

astronomy.name: Adaptive optics and atmospheric turbulence
astronomy.gist: Simulate Kolmogorov phase screens, reconstruct wavefronts from slope measurements, and estimate Fried parameter, Strehl ratio and AO-corrected PSFs from wavefront sensor or seeing data.

astronomy.name: High-contrast imaging and PSF subtraction
astronomy.gist: Suppress stellar speckles with angular or reference differential imaging and PCA-based subtraction, then estimate companion photometry, astrometry and contrast detection limits.

astronomy.name: Integral field spectroscopy and stellar kinematics
astronomy.gist: Spatially bin IFU data cubes and fit line-of-sight velocity distributions with template combinations to map velocity, dispersion and higher Gauss-Hermite moments.

astronomy.name: Reverberation mapping of active nuclei
astronomy.gist: Measure continuum-to-line time lags with interpolated or model-based cross-correlation, measure line widths, and derive broad-line region sizes and black hole masses.

astronomy.name: Luminosity functions and number counts
astronomy.gist: Estimate luminosity and mass functions with 1/Vmax, stepwise maximum likelihood or parametric Schechter fits, correcting for flux limits, completeness and Eddington bias.

astronomy.name: Galaxy scaling relations
astronomy.gist: Fit Tully-Fisher, fundamental plane, mass-metallicity or black-hole scaling relations with errors in both variables, intrinsic scatter and selection effects.

astronomy.name: Galaxy morphology quantification and classification
astronomy.gist: Compute nonparametric morphology indices such as concentration, asymmetry, Gini and M20 from galaxy images, and classify morphologies or mergers with supervised learning.

astronomy.name: Galactic chemical evolution modeling
astronomy.gist: Integrate one-zone or multizone models with gas inflow, outflow, star formation and stellar yields to predict abundance ratio tracks and metallicity distributions.

astronomy.name: Nuclear reaction networks and nucleosynthesis
astronomy.gist: Integrate stiff thermonuclear reaction networks for stellar burning stages, Big Bang nucleosynthesis or explosive conditions to compute energy generation and isotopic yields.

astronomy.name: Astrochemical kinetics networks
astronomy.gist: Solve gas-phase and grain-surface chemical rate equations for molecular clouds, photodissociation regions or disks to follow abundance evolution and identify key reactions.

astronomy.name: Photoionization and thermal equilibrium of gas
astronomy.gist: Compute ionization balance, heating and cooling functions, Strömgren structure and equilibrium temperatures of irradiated or collisionally ionized astrophysical plasmas.

astronomy.name: Astrophysical hydrodynamics simulations
astronomy.gist: Implement finite-volume or SPH solvers for shocks, blast waves, accretion flows and fluid instabilities, then validate them against Sod, Sedov-Taylor and other analytic solutions.

astronomy.name: Accretion disk modeling
astronomy.gist: Compute alpha-disk radial structure, multicolor blackbody spectra and viscous time evolution, then fit disk models to continuum spectra or outburst light curves.

astronomy.name: Protoplanetary disk and planet formation modeling
astronomy.gist: Model gas surface density evolution, dust drift, settling and growth, pebble accretion and planet migration in protoplanetary disks, and compare with observed disk profiles.

astronomy.name: Compact object structure
astronomy.gist: Integrate Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff and degenerate-matter equations for neutron stars and white dwarfs to compute mass-radius relations, and constrain equations of state or cooling ages.

astronomy.name: Stellar and binary population synthesis
astronomy.gist: Sample initial mass functions, binary fractions and orbital distributions, evolve the populations with rapid prescriptions, and predict counts of compact binaries, supernovae or stellar types.

astronomy.name: Star formation and dense core analysis
astronomy.gist: Identify clumps and cores in dust or molecular line maps with dendrograms or clump finders, then derive masses, virial parameters, core mass functions and star formation efficiencies.

astronomy.name: Nonthermal radiation modeling
astronomy.gist: Compute synchrotron, inverse Compton and hadronic emission from particle distributions and fit leptonic or hadronic models to broadband spectra of blazars, pulsar wind nebulae or remnants.

astronomy.name: Gamma-ray burst and relativistic afterglow modeling
astronomy.gist: Fit prompt-emission spectra and multiwavelength afterglow light curves with relativistic blast-wave and jet models to infer energetics, ambient density, jet angle and microphysical parameters.

astronomy.name: Poisson likelihood source searches
astronomy.gist: Perform binned or unbinned likelihood analyses of gamma-ray counts cubes or neutrino events with spatial and spectral templates to detect point sources and compute test statistics and upper limits.

astronomy.name: Cosmic-ray propagation and air shower reconstruction
astronomy.gist: Model Galactic cosmic-ray diffusion and energy losses to predict spectra and secondary ratios, or reconstruct air-shower energy, direction and composition from ground-array or fluorescence data.

astronomy.name: 21-cm cosmology and foreground removal
astronomy.gist: Simulate redshifted 21-cm signals with instrument effects, separate smooth spectral foregrounds with polynomial, PCA or Gaussian-process methods, and estimate power spectra or global signal parameters.

astronomy.name: Lyman-alpha forest statistics
astronomy.gist: Normalize quasar continua, compute transmitted flux statistics and one-dimensional flux power spectra, and constrain intergalactic medium temperature and ionization from the forest.

astronomy.name: Microwave component separation and Sunyaev-Zeldovich analysis
astronomy.gist: Separate CMB, thermal dust, synchrotron and SZ signals in multifrequency maps with internal linear combination or parametric fitting, and detect clusters with matched filters.

astronomy.name: Stellar rotation, activity and flares
astronomy.gist: Measure rotation periods from spot modulation, detect and characterize stellar flares in photometric series, and estimate ages with gyrochronology or chromospheric activity indices.

astronomy.name: Occultation timing analysis
astronomy.gist: Fit diffraction-limited ingress and egress profiles of stellar occultations by asteroids, the Moon or rings to derive object sizes, shapes, stellar diameters or ring and atmosphere structure.

astronomy.name: Exoplanet occurrence rates and demographics
astronomy.gist: Combine detection catalogs with injection-recovery completeness and geometric transit probability in hierarchical models to infer planet occurrence as a function of size, period and host properties.

astronomy.name: Meteor and fireball trajectory reconstruction
astronomy.gist: Triangulate meteor tracks from multi-station camera or radar observations, fit deceleration and ablation models, and compute pre-atmospheric heliocentric orbits and meteoroid masses.

astronomy.name: Heliospheric plasma and CME propagation
astronomy.gist: Analyze in situ solar wind magnetic field and plasma time series, identify shocks and magnetic clouds, and model coronal mass ejection arrival times with drag-based or kinematic models.

astronomy.name: Distance ladder and standard candle calibration
astronomy.gist: Calibrate Cepheid and RR Lyrae period-luminosity relations, tip-of-the-red-giant-branch edges or masers, and propagate the ladder with covariant uncertainties to estimate the Hubble constant.

astronomy.name: Molecular line excitation and column densities
astronomy.gist: Derive excitation temperatures, optical depths and column densities from molecular rotational lines using rotation diagrams, hyperfine fitting, escape-probability or large-velocity-gradient non-LTE models.

astronomy.name: Monte Carlo dust radiative transfer
astronomy.gist: Propagate photon packets through dusty envelopes, disks or clouds with absorption, anisotropic scattering and re-emission to compute temperature structures, SEDs and scattered-light images.

astronomy.name: Astronomical image deconvolution and restoration
astronomy.gist: Restore blurred and noisy astronomical images with Richardson-Lucy, Wiener, sparsity-regularized or maximum-entropy methods, and assess resolution gain, flux conservation and artifacts.

astronomy.name: Tidal and spin-orbit evolution
astronomy.gist: Integrate tidal dissipation equations for planets, moons and close binaries to follow orbital decay, circularization, spin synchronization and obliquity damping under constant-lag or constant-Q models.

astronomy.name: Relativistic ray tracing around compact objects
astronomy.gist: Integrate null geodesics in Schwarzschild or Kerr spacetimes to compute black hole shadows, relativistically broadened emission lines and images of accretion flows or hot spots.

astronomy.name: Compact binary population inference
astronomy.gist: Infer mass, spin and redshift distributions of merging black holes and neutron stars from catalogs of event posteriors with hierarchical models and injection-based selection corrections.

astronomy.name: Pulsar timing array background searches
astronomy.gist: Cross-correlate timing residuals across pulsar arrays, fit common red-noise processes and test for Hellings-Downs spatial correlations from a stochastic gravitational-wave background.

astronomy.name: Planetary climate and habitability modeling
astronomy.gist: Build energy-balance and radiative-convective climate models with ice-albedo feedback, greenhouse gases and heat transport to locate habitable zone boundaries and climate bistability.

astronomy.name: Planetary interior structure modeling
astronomy.gist: Integrate hydrostatic structure with layered equations of state for rocky, icy and gas-rich planets to predict mass-radius relations, moments of inertia, gravity harmonics and core fractions.

astronomy.name: Astrodynamics and spacecraft trajectory design
astronomy.gist: Solve Lambert problems, Hohmann and low-thrust transfers, gravity-assist sequences and porkchop plots, and propagate spacecraft orbits with perturbations for mission design.

astronomy.name: Interstellar turbulence statistics
astronomy.gist: Quantify turbulence in column density, velocity and intensity maps using structure functions, power spectra, velocity channel analysis, probability density functions and Mach-number estimators.

astronomy.name: Galactic structure from star counts
astronomy.gist: Fit thin-disk, thick-disk, halo and bulge density models to star counts and color-magnitude distributions from survey catalogs to derive scale heights, lengths and density profiles.

astronomy.name: Galaxy environment and group finding
astronomy.gist: Identify galaxy groups and clusters in redshift surveys with friends-of-friends or Voronoi methods, estimate local densities, and relate environment to galaxy colors and star formation.

astronomy.name: Galaxy-halo connection modeling
astronomy.gist: Build halo occupation distribution, abundance matching or conditional luminosity function models to populate halo catalogs with galaxies and fit clustering and abundance measurements.

astronomy.name: Linear cosmological perturbations and Boltzmann solvers
astronomy.gist: Integrate linearized Einstein-Boltzmann equations for photons, baryons, neutrinos and dark matter to compute transfer functions, matter power spectra and CMB anisotropy spectra.

astronomy.name: Reionization history modeling
astronomy.gist: Model the evolution of ionized hydrogen fraction from source emissivities, clumping and escape fractions, or build semi-numerical ionization fields, and compare with Thomson optical depth and quasar constraints.

astronomy.name: Dark matter detection signal modeling
astronomy.gist: Compute direct-detection recoil spectra and exclusion limits, or annihilation and decay fluxes with J-factors for dwarf galaxies and the Galactic center, and confront them with data.

astronomy.name: Time-ordered data map-making
astronomy.gist: Reconstruct sky maps from scanning bolometer or radiometer time streams with binning, destriping or maximum-likelihood map-making, handling correlated 1/f noise, pointing and filtering transfer functions.

astronomy.name: Small-body populations and asteroid families
astronomy.gist: Compute proper orbital elements, identify collisional families with hierarchical clustering, model Yarkovsky drift and debias size-frequency distributions of asteroid and trans-Neptunian populations.

astronomy.name: Cometary activity and coma modeling
astronomy.gist: Derive gas and dust production rates with Haser and Afρ models, model dust tails with syndyne-synchrone geometry, and track activity evolution with heliocentric distance.

astronomy.name: Transit timing variation analysis
astronomy.gist: Measure individual transit times, detect timing variations from perturbing planets, and fit dynamical or analytic resonant models to infer planet masses and eccentricities.

astronomy.name: Stellar surface imaging by inversion
astronomy.gist: Reconstruct starspot and magnetic field maps from rotationally modulated line profiles or light curves using Doppler, Zeeman-Doppler or light-curve inversion with regularization.

astronomy.name: Jeans and orbit-superposition dynamical modeling
astronomy.gist: Fit spherical or axisymmetric Jeans models and Schwarzschild orbit libraries to stellar kinematics of dwarf galaxies, globular clusters and galaxy centers to infer mass profiles and anisotropy.

astronomy.name: Collisional star cluster dynamics
astronomy.gist: Simulate star clusters with direct N-body or Fokker-Planck methods to study two-body relaxation, mass segregation, core collapse, binary hardening and tidal mass loss.

astronomy.name: Spectrograph design and performance modeling
astronomy.gist: Apply grating equations, anamorphic magnification and echelle formats to design spectrographs and compute resolving power, order layout, sampling, throughput and wavelength coverage.

astronomy.name: Single-dish radio calibration and mapping
astronomy.gist: Calibrate single-dish radio data with system temperatures, gain curves, beam and aperture efficiencies, and grid on-the-fly or position-switched observations into calibrated maps and spectra.

astronomy.name: Stellar winds and mass-loss modeling
astronomy.gist: Solve Parker and line-driven CAK wind equations, model P Cygni and recombination line profiles, and derive mass-loss rates and terminal velocities from spectra or infrared excess.

biology.name: Short-read alignment and small variant calling
biology.gist: Map simulated or public sequencing reads to a reference, then call SNVs and indels from pileups using genotype likelihoods, base qualities and strand-bias filters.

biology.name: Copy number and structural variant detection
biology.gist: Infer deletions, duplications and rearrangements from read depth, discordant pairs and split reads using segmentation or HMMs with GC and mappability correction.

biology.name: De novo genome assembly of small genomes
biology.gist: Assemble bacterial, viral or organellar genomes from error-containing reads with de Bruijn or overlap graphs, then evaluate contiguity and misassemblies.

biology.name: Genome-wide association mapping
biology.gist: Test genotype-phenotype associations with linear or logistic mixed models while correcting for population structure, relatedness and multiple testing.

biology.name: Haplotype phasing and genotype imputation
biology.gist: Reconstruct haplotypes and fill in missing genotypes using linkage disequilibrium structure, reference panels and Li-Stephens-type HMMs.

biology.name: Demographic inference from site frequency spectra
biology.gist: Fit population size changes, splits and migration to observed allele frequency spectra by likelihood or diffusion and moment approximations.

biology.name: Genomic scans for natural selection
biology.gist: Detect selective sweeps and balancing selection from polymorphism data with statistics such as Tajima's D, Fst outliers, iHS and composite likelihoods.

biology.name: Heritability and polygenic score estimation
biology.gist: Estimate SNP heritability and genetic correlations, and build and validate polygenic predictors from genotype data or summary statistics.

biology.name: QTL and eQTL mapping
biology.gist: Map loci controlling quantitative traits or gene expression in experimental crosses or populations using interval mapping, permutation thresholds and covariate adjustment.

biology.name: Gene prediction and genome annotation
biology.gist: Find ORFs, genes, splice sites and repeats in genomic sequence with HMMs, codon statistics and homology evidence, then emit standard annotation files.

biology.name: Transcription factor motif discovery and scanning
biology.gist: Discover enriched sequence motifs with EM or Gibbs sampling, then scan genomes with position weight matrices against calibrated background models.

biology.name: ChIP-seq and ATAC-seq peak calling
biology.gist: Identify enriched genomic regions from aligned fragments against control or local background, estimate fragment sizes, control FDR and compare conditions.

biology.name: DNA methylation differential analysis
biology.gist: Quantify CpG methylation from bisulfite or array data and detect differentially methylated positions and regions with beta-binomial or smoothing models.

biology.name: Hi-C chromatin contact map analysis
biology.gist: Normalize contact matrices by matrix balancing, then call compartments, TADs and loops and compare 3D genome organization between conditions.

biology.name: Mutational signature extraction in cancer genomes
biology.gist: Decompose trinucleotide-context mutation catalogs into signatures and per-sample exposures with NMF or fit them against known signature references.

biology.name: Tumor subclonal reconstruction from allele frequencies
biology.gist: Infer purity, ploidy, clonal clusters and phylogenies from variant allele frequencies and copy number with mixture models.

biology.name: Bulk RNA-seq differential expression
biology.gist: Model gene count matrices with negative binomial GLMs, normalization, dispersion shrinkage and complex designs to find differentially expressed genes.

biology.name: Isoform quantification and alternative splicing
biology.gist: Estimate transcript abundances by EM over read compatibility classes and test differential exon usage or percent-spliced-in between conditions.

biology.name: Single-cell RNA-seq clustering and annotation
biology.gist: Run QC, normalization, feature selection, dimensionality reduction and graph clustering on sparse cell-by-gene matrices, then assign cell types from marker genes.

biology.name: Single-cell trajectory and RNA velocity
biology.gist: Order cells along differentiation paths with pseudotime, branching graphs or spliced/unspliced kinetic models and find dynamically regulated genes.

biology.name: Cell-type deconvolution of bulk profiles
biology.gist: Estimate cell-type proportions in bulk expression or methylation samples from reference signatures using constrained regression or probabilistic models.

biology.name: Spatial transcriptomics pattern analysis
biology.gist: Identify spatially variable genes, tissue domains and cell neighborhood interactions from spot- or cell-resolved expression with coordinates.

biology.name: Gene set and pathway enrichment
biology.gist: Test over-representation or rank-based enrichment of curated gene sets with appropriate null models, background choice and multiple-testing correction.

biology.name: Co-expression network module detection
biology.gist: Build gene correlation or partial-correlation networks, detect modules and hub genes, and relate module eigengenes to sample traits.

biology.name: Ribosome profiling and translation efficiency
biology.gist: Process footprint reads to assign P-site offsets, detect 3-nt periodicity and translated ORFs, and estimate changes in translation efficiency.

biology.name: Peptide-spectrum matching with target-decoy FDR
biology.gist: Identify peptides from tandem mass spectra by scoring against in-silico digested protein databases, localize modifications and control FDR with decoys.

biology.name: Quantitative proteomics differential abundance
biology.gist: Roll up label-free, TMT or SILAC peptide intensities to proteins, handle missingness and normalization, and test differential abundance.

biology.name: Untargeted metabolomics LC-MS feature processing
biology.gist: Detect chromatographic peaks, align retention times, group adducts and isotopes, and annotate features by accurate mass across sample runs.

biology.name: Protein structure geometry and contact analysis
biology.gist: Compute secondary structure, solvent accessibility, contacts, interfaces and structural superpositions from atomic coordinate files.

biology.name: Molecular dynamics trajectory analysis
biology.gist: Analyze biomolecular simulation trajectories for RMSD/RMSF, conformational clustering, hydrogen bonds, collective variables and free-energy surfaces.

biology.name: Elastic network and coarse-grained protein dynamics
biology.gist: Build Gaussian or anisotropic network models or simple coarse-grained force fields to compute normal modes, fluctuations and conformational transitions.

biology.name: Cryo-EM single-particle image processing
biology.gist: Estimate CTF parameters, pick and align particles, compute 2D class averages and 3D reconstructions, and assess resolution by Fourier shell correlation.

biology.name: SAXS profile modelling of macromolecules
biology.gist: Compute and fit small-angle scattering curves from structures or ensembles, deriving radius of gyration, pair-distance distributions and oligomer mixtures.

biology.name: Protein-ligand interaction modelling and virtual screening
biology.gist: Computational analysis of how small molecules engage protein targets and how to prioritise them. Examples: binding pocket detection and druggability scoring, pharmacophore construction and matching, pose generation and interaction fingerprinting, fitting or re-weighting empirical affinity functions against measured data, ligand-based similarity and QSAR ranking, free-energy estimates from end-point or perturbation data, and virtual-screen enrichment evaluation against actives and decoys.

biology.name: Coevolution-based residue contact prediction
biology.gist: Infer residue-residue contacts from multiple sequence alignments with mutual information, direct coupling analysis or pseudolikelihood Potts models.

biology.name: RNA secondary structure prediction and design
biology.gist: Compute minimum free energy and partition-function structures with nearest-neighbor energy models, and design sequences that fold to target structures.

biology.name: Protein NMR spectra and relaxation analysis
biology.gist: Process FIDs into spectra, pick and assign peaks, track chemical shift perturbations and fit relaxation or model-free dynamics parameters.

biology.name: Sequence alignment and profile HMM search
biology.gist: Implement or apply pairwise, multiple and profile-HMM alignment to detect remote homologs and evaluate statistical significance of alignment scores.

biology.name: Phylogenetic tree inference and dating
biology.gist: Reconstruct phylogenies from alignments with distance, parsimony or maximum-likelihood methods, assess support, and estimate divergence times under clock models.

biology.name: Codon-model selection analysis
biology.gist: Estimate dN/dS ratios and test for episodic or site-specific positive selection on protein-coding alignments with codon substitution models.

biology.name: Phylogenetic comparative methods and ancestral states
biology.gist: Model trait evolution on trees with Brownian motion, OU and Mk models, run PGLS regressions, and reconstruct ancestral character states.

biology.name: Coalescent simulation and genealogical inference
biology.gist: Simulate genealogies with recombination and demography, and infer mutation rates, recombination rates or population parameters from sequence data.

biology.name: Wright-Fisher and experimental evolution dynamics
biology.gist: Simulate or infer selection coefficients, drift and fixation from allele frequency time series in evolving populations or evolve-and-resequence experiments.

biology.name: Pathogen phylodynamics and outbreak reconstruction
biology.gist: Estimate reproduction numbers, growth rates and transmission trees from dated pathogen genomes combined with epidemiological data.

biology.name: Stochastic gene expression simulation
biology.gist: Simulate transcriptional bursting and regulatory circuits with Gillespie or chemical Langevin methods and fit the resulting noise and distribution statistics to data.

biology.name: Signaling pathway ODE model calibration
biology.gist: Build kinetic ODE models of signaling or cell-cycle networks, fit parameters to time-course data, and analyze identifiability and sensitivity.

biology.name: Boolean and logical regulatory network models
biology.gist: Construct logical models of gene regulation, enumerate attractors and basins, and infer network rules from discretized expression data.

biology.name: Fluorescence microscopy cell segmentation and quantification
biology.gist: Segment nuclei and cells in multichannel images with classical image processing, then measure intensities, morphology and colocalization per cell.

biology.name: Time-lapse cell tracking and lineage reconstruction
biology.gist: Link segmented cells across frames, detect divisions, reconstruct lineage trees and extract cell-cycle durations and growth rates.

biology.name: FRAP and single-particle tracking diffusion analysis
biology.gist: Fit recovery curves and mean-squared-displacement or step-size distributions to estimate diffusion coefficients, binding kinetics and mobile fractions.

biology.name: Flow cytometry gating and population analysis
biology.gist: Apply compensation and transforms to multiparameter event data, then gate or cluster cell populations and compare frequencies across samples.

biology.name: Enzyme kinetics and binding curve fitting
biology.gist: Fit Michaelis-Menten, inhibition, cooperativity and dose-response models to assay data with proper error models, model selection and confidence intervals.

biology.name: Pooled CRISPR screen hit calling
biology.gist: Normalize guide counts from pooled knockout or activation screens and score gene-level essentiality or enrichment with robust ranking and count models.

biology.name: Oligonucleotide design for primers, probes and guides
biology.gist: Design PCR primers, hybridization probes or CRISPR guides that satisfy thermodynamic, specificity and off-target constraints against a genome.

biology.name: Microbial growth and kill-curve modelling
biology.gist: Fit logistic, Gompertz or mechanistic models to plate-reader growth and antibiotic time-kill data to extract lag, growth rate, yield and MIC.

biology.name: 16S amplicon denoising and diversity analysis
biology.gist: Denoise amplicon reads into sequence variants, assign taxonomy, and compute alpha/beta diversity and compositional differential abundance.

biology.name: Shotgun metagenomic profiling and binning
biology.gist: Estimate taxonomic and functional composition from shotgun reads and bin contigs into genomes using coverage and composition features.

biology.name: Bacterial pangenome and resistance gene analysis
biology.gist: Cluster genes across many isolates into core and accessory genomes, detect antimicrobial resistance and virulence genes, and associate them with phenotypes.

biology.name: Microbial community dynamics inference
biology.gist: Infer species interaction parameters from abundance time series with generalized Lotka-Volterra or consumer-resource models and predict community responses.

biology.name: Genome-scale metabolic modelling
biology.gist: Use stoichiometric models for flux balance and flux variability analysis, gene knockout prediction, and integration of expression or isotope-labeling flux data.

biology.name: Long-read nanopore signal analysis and error correction
biology.gist: Process raw nanopore current traces or noisy long reads: segment events, align signal to k-mer models, detect base modifications from signal shifts, and correct or polish reads by consensus.

biology.name: Protein sequence feature prediction
biology.gist: Predict transmembrane helices, signal peptides, disordered regions, secondary structure and amphipathicity from amino acid sequence using hydropathy scales, sliding windows, HMMs or trained classifiers.

biology.name: Protein-protein interaction network analysis
biology.gist: Analyze interaction networks for degree distributions, centrality, network motifs and densely connected complexes, and score network proximity between gene sets against degree-preserving null models.

biology.name: Gene regulatory network inference
biology.gist: Reconstruct directed regulator-target networks from steady-state, time-series or perturbation expression data using regression ensembles, information-theoretic or causal methods, and benchmark against known edges.

biology.name: Hydrogen-deuterium exchange and crosslinking mass spectrometry
biology.gist: Fit deuterium uptake curves, compute protection factors and differential HDX between states, or identify crosslinked peptide pairs and check them against structural distance restraints.

biology.name: X-ray crystallography data reduction and phasing
biology.gist: Index and integrate diffraction intensities, scale and merge reflections, compute Patterson maps and Wilson statistics, solve phases, and evaluate electron density and R-factors.

biology.name: Deep mutational scanning fitness landscapes
biology.gist: Turn variant counts before and after selection into fitness scores with error models, then fit additive, global-epistasis or pairwise-epistasis models across the mutational landscape.

biology.name: Immune repertoire sequencing analysis
biology.gist: Assign V(D)J genes and CDR3s to antibody or T-cell receptor reads, define clonotypes and lineages, and compute repertoire diversity, somatic hypermutation and clonal expansion between samples.

biology.name: Population structure and admixture inference
biology.gist: Estimate ancestry proportions and population clusters from genotype matrices with PCA and ADMIXTURE-style likelihood models, and infer local ancestry tracts or admixture timing along chromosomes.

biology.name: Genetic linkage map construction
biology.gist: Estimate pairwise recombination fractions in crosses, group markers into linkage groups, order them by likelihood or seriation, and convert recombination rates to map distances while handling genotyping errors.

biology.name: Pedigree analysis and identity-by-descent detection
biology.gist: Compute kinship coefficients, infer relationships and detect IBD segments from genotypes, and evaluate Mendelian segregation or linkage likelihoods in family pedigrees.

biology.name: Recombination and horizontal gene transfer detection
biology.gist: Locate recombination breakpoints and horizontally transferred segments in sequence alignments or genomes using phylogenetic incongruence, compositional anomalies and sliding-window statistics.

biology.name: Gene family evolution and tree reconciliation
biology.gist: Infer orthologs and paralogs, reconcile gene trees with species trees through duplication, transfer and loss events, and fit birth-death models of gene family size across lineages.

biology.name: Synteny and whole-genome comparative alignment
biology.gist: Identify collinear blocks and anchors between genomes, reconstruct rearrangement histories and whole-genome duplications, and estimate genomic rearrangement distances.

biology.name: Single-molecule force spectroscopy analysis
biology.gist: Analyze optical tweezers, magnetic tweezers or AFM traces by fitting worm-like chain elasticity, detecting motor steps and unfolding events, and extracting force-dependent kinetics with Bell-Evans models.

biology.name: Single-molecule fluorescence trajectory analysis
biology.gist: Idealize smFRET and fluorescence intensity traces with hidden Markov models, count photobleaching steps for stoichiometry, and estimate state dwell times and transition rates.

biology.name: Ion channel gating kinetics from patch-clamp recordings
biology.gist: Detect openings in single-channel recordings, fit dwell-time distributions and Markov gating schemes, and model whole-cell currents with Hodgkin-Huxley-type voltage-dependent kinetics.

biology.name: Morphogen gradients and reaction-diffusion pattern formation
biology.gist: Simulate and fit PDE models of morphogen transport, Turing patterns and positional information in developing tissues, and analyze robustness and scaling of the resulting patterns.

biology.name: Biological rhythm detection in time-course data
biology.gist: Detect and characterize circadian, cell-cycle or ultradian oscillations in expression or activity time series using cosinor fits, nonparametric rhythmicity tests and phase-amplitude estimation.

biology.name: Protein stability from denaturation curves
biology.gist: Fit two-state and multistate unfolding models to thermal melts, differential scanning fluorimetry or chemical denaturation data to extract Tm, unfolding enthalpy, free energy and m-values.

biology.name: qPCR and digital PCR quantification
biology.gist: Determine threshold cycles and amplification efficiencies from fluorescence curves, perform relative quantification with reference gene normalization, and compute absolute copy numbers from Poisson partition statistics.

biology.name: Affinity purification and co-fractionation interaction scoring
biology.gist: Score bait-prey interactions in AP-MS data against contaminant backgrounds, and infer protein complexes from co-elution profiles across chromatographic fractions.

biology.name: Sequence-to-function predictive modelling
biology.gist: Train and evaluate k-mer, one-hot or embedding-based models that predict promoter strength, enhancer activity, peptide function or binding from biological sequences, with interpretation of learned features.

biology.name: Protein electrostatics and pKa calculation
biology.gist: Solve Poisson-Boltzmann or generalized Born models on protein structures to compute electrostatic potentials, residue pKa shifts, titration curves and pH-dependent stability or binding.

biology.name: Transposon insertion sequencing fitness analysis
biology.gist: Map Tn-seq insertion sites, normalize insertion densities, call essential genes with HMM or gap statistics, and estimate condition-specific fitness effects of gene disruptions.

biology.name: Viral within-host diversity and haplotype reconstruction
biology.gist: Call low-frequency variants in deep viral sequencing data while separating true variants from errors, then reconstruct quasispecies haplotypes and estimate within-host diversity and their frequencies.

biology.name: Chromatin state segmentation
biology.gist: Combine multiple histone mark and accessibility tracks into genome-wide chromatin states with multivariate HMMs or clustering, then interpret, annotate and compare the states across cell types.

biology.name: Allele-specific expression and imbalance testing
biology.gist: Quantify allelic read counts at heterozygous sites while correcting reference mapping bias, and test for allelic imbalance, imprinting or cis-regulatory effects with beta-binomial models.

biology.name: Single-molecule localization microscopy reconstruction
biology.gist: Fit point-spread functions to blinking emitters for sub-pixel localization, correct drift, render super-resolution images, and quantify molecular clustering with Ripley's functions or DBSCAN.

biology.name: Protein structure prediction and model quality assessment
biology.gist: Build 3D protein models by homology modelling, threading or fragment assembly, then score and rank them with statistical potentials and model-quality metrics such as GDT, lDDT and TM-score against references.

biology.name: Computational protein sequence design
biology.gist: Optimize amino acid sequences for a fixed backbone or target property with rotamer packing, simulated annealing or integer programming over pairwise energy functions, and evaluate the designed sequences for stability and specificity.

biology.name: Protein-protein docking and interface scoring
biology.gist: Generate rigid-body or FFT-based poses of protein complexes, score them with shape complementarity, electrostatics and desolvation terms, and rank them against native interfaces.

biology.name: Real-time binding kinetics and calorimetry
biology.gist: Globally fit SPR and biolayer interferometry sensorgrams for association and dissociation rates, including mass-transport and heterogeneity models, and integrate ITC thermograms to extract stoichiometry, affinity and binding enthalpy.

biology.name: Biomolecular optical spectroscopy deconvolution
biology.gist: Estimate protein secondary structure fractions from far-UV CD or infrared amide I spectra by constrained regression against reference sets or band fitting, decompose UV-vis and fluorescence spectra into components, and track conformational changes across conditions with spectral decomposition.

biology.name: Intact and native protein mass spectra deconvolution
biology.gist: Deconvolve charge-state envelopes from intact or native mass spectra into zero-charge masses, then assign proteoforms, post-translational modifications, ligand-bound states and complex stoichiometries.

biology.name: Glycan and glycopeptide mass spectrometry annotation
biology.gist: Assign glycan compositions and glycopeptide spectra from fragment ions and oxonium signatures, enumerate candidate structures with combinatorial rules, and quantify site-specific glycoform distributions.

biology.name: Codon usage bias and coding sequence optimization
biology.gist: Compute codon adaptation, effective number of codons and tRNA adaptation indices, relate codon bias to expression or mutational pressure, and redesign coding sequences under host usage and mRNA structure constraints.

biology.name: K-mer spectrum genome profiling
biology.gist: Count k-mers in raw reads and fit mixture models to k-mer frequency histograms to estimate genome size, heterozygosity, repeat content, ploidy and sequencing error rate without a reference.

biology.name: Sketch-based genome distance and species delineation
biology.gist: Compute MinHash or average nucleotide identity distances between genomes or read sets, cluster and dereplicate genome collections, and delineate species or strains from distance thresholds.

biology.name: Batch effect correction and omics data integration
biology.gist: Detect and remove technical batch effects from expression, methylation or single-cell matrices with empirical Bayes, linear mixed or mutual-nearest-neighbour methods, and quantify how well biological signal is preserved.

biology.name: Multi-omics factor analysis and integration
biology.gist: Jointly decompose matched genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic and metabolomic datasets with factor models, canonical correlation or kernel methods to find shared and modality-specific axes of variation.

biology.name: Cell proliferation and label-dilution kinetics
biology.gist: Fit division-structured models to CFSE dye-dilution histograms, BrdU or deuterium labelling curves to estimate division rates, death rates, precursor frequencies and cell turnover in proliferating populations.

biology.name: Traction force microscopy and cell mechanics inference
biology.gist: Compute substrate displacement fields from bead images by particle image velocimetry, then reconstruct cellular traction stresses by regularized Fourier or finite-element inversion of elasticity equations.

biology.name: Gel and blot image densitometry
biology.gist: Detect lanes and bands in electrophoresis gel and western blot images, subtract backgrounds, quantify band intensities with loading normalization, and calibrate molecular weights from ladder migration.

biology.name: High-throughput screening plate data analysis
biology.gist: Correct plate, row-column and edge effects in multiwell screening data, compute assay quality metrics such as Z-prime, normalize to controls and call hits with robust statistics and false discovery control.

biology.name: Drug combination synergy analysis
biology.gist: Fit dose-response surfaces to combination matrix data and quantify synergy or antagonism under Bliss independence, Loewe additivity, highest single agent and ZIP reference models with uncertainty estimates.

biology.name: Multispecies coalescent species tree inference
biology.gist: Infer species trees and species boundaries from many discordant gene trees or loci under incomplete lineage sorting with quartet, summary or likelihood methods, and test for introgression with site pattern statistics.

biology.name: Diversification rate and birth-death tree analysis
biology.gist: Fit speciation and extinction models to dated phylogenies, analyse lineage-through-time plots, and test for rate shifts and trait-dependent diversification with state-dependent birth-death likelihoods.

biology.name: Nucleosome positioning and occupancy mapping
biology.gist: Call nucleosome dyads and occupancy from MNase-seq or fragment-length-resolved data, measure phasing and spacing around regulatory elements, and model sequence-dependent positioning preferences.

biology.name: MicroRNA target prediction and small RNA analysis
biology.gist: Process small RNA sequencing reads into miRNA and isomiR counts, predict miRNA targets from seed pairing, site context and duplex energies, and test target repression in matched expression data.
