biology.name: Genome editing outcome quantification
biology.gist: Align amplicon reads from CRISPR, base or prime editing experiments to quantify indel spectra, editing efficiency and bystander edits, and model repair outcome distributions from sequence context.

biology.name: DNA replication timing and origin mapping
biology.gist: Infer replication timing profiles from S-phase copy number or Repli-seq data, locate replication origins and fork directionality from Okazaki fragment or nucleotide analogue signals, and fit stochastic origin firing models.

biology.name: Barcode lineage tracing and clonal dynamics
biology.gist: Count heritable DNA barcodes or reconstruct lineage trees from accumulated CRISPR scars, correct barcode errors, and infer clonal fitness, fate bias and population dynamics across time points.

biology.name: Kinetic metabolic modelling and metabolic control analysis
biology.gist: Build enzyme-kinetic ODE models of metabolic pathways, compute steady states, flux and concentration control coefficients and elasticities, and fit kinetic parameters to metabolite time courses.

biology.name: Synthetic gene circuit design and part characterization
biology.gist: Characterize promoter, RBS and repressor transfer functions from reporter data, then compose and tune genetic circuits such as switches, oscillators and logic gates to meet dynamic specifications.

biology.name: RNA and protein turnover from metabolic labelling
biology.gist: Estimate synthesis and degradation rates of transcripts or proteins from pulse-chase, SLAM-seq, 4sU or dynamic SILAC labelling time courses with kinetic models that handle label recycling and incorporation efficiency.

biology.name: Cryo-electron tomography and subtomogram averaging
biology.gist: Align tilt series, reconstruct tomograms by weighted back-projection or iterative methods with missing-wedge handling, then locate, align and average subtomograms of repeated macromolecular structures.

biology.name: Microscopy image restoration and deconvolution
biology.gist: Model or measure point-spread functions and restore fluorescence images and stacks by Richardson-Lucy, Wiener or regularized deconvolution, background and flat-field correction and denoising, judged against ground truth.

biology.name: Fluorescence correlation spectroscopy and lifetime analysis
biology.gist: Fit FCS autocorrelation and cross-correlation curves for concentrations, diffusion times and binding, and fit time-correlated photon decay or phasor data for fluorescence lifetimes and FRET efficiencies.

medicine.name: Survival analysis of cohort outcomes
medicine.gist: Time-to-event modelling of patient cohorts with censoring, using Kaplan-Meier, Cox proportional hazards, competing risks and checks of model assumptions.

medicine.name: Randomized trial sample size design
medicine.gist: Computing power and sample size for parallel, crossover, cluster and non-inferiority trials, analytically or by simulation, under realistic dropout and variance assumptions.

medicine.name: Group sequential and adaptive trial monitoring
medicine.gist: Designing and analysing interim looks with alpha-spending boundaries, futility rules, sample-size re-estimation and simulated operating characteristics.

medicine.name: Bayesian adaptive dose-finding designs
medicine.gist: Simulating and calibrating CRM, BOIN or EWOC phase I designs to estimate the maximum tolerated dose and evaluate safety and accuracy metrics.

medicine.name: Population pharmacokinetic modelling
medicine.gist: Fitting compartmental PK models with between-subject variability to sparse concentration-time data using nonlinear mixed-effects estimation and covariate selection.

medicine.name: Noncompartmental pharmacokinetic analysis
medicine.gist: Computing AUC, Cmax, half-life, clearance and bioequivalence statistics from concentration-time profiles with BLQ handling and lambda-z selection rules.

medicine.name: Pharmacodynamic exposure-response modelling
medicine.gist: Linking drug exposure to effect with Emax, indirect-response and effect-compartment models, including hysteresis and dose-regimen prediction.

medicine.name: Physiologically based pharmacokinetic simulation
medicine.gist: Building ODE models of organ compartments with blood flows and partition coefficients to predict tissue concentrations and drug-drug interactions.

medicine.name: Dosing regimen optimization
medicine.gist: Designing individualized or population dosing schedules that meet therapeutic target windows, using Bayesian forecasting and constrained optimization over PK/PD models.

medicine.name: Compartmental infectious disease modelling
medicine.gist: Simulating and fitting SIR/SEIR-type ODE or stochastic models to incidence data to estimate transmission parameters and intervention effects.

medicine.name: Reproduction number estimation from incidence
medicine.gist: Estimating time-varying Rt from case counts with serial-interval distributions, reporting delays and right-truncation, using renewal-equation methods.

medicine.name: Nowcasting delayed surveillance reports
medicine.gist: Correcting reporting delays and backfill in surveillance time series with delay-distribution models to estimate current true counts.

medicine.name: Outbreak detection in syndromic surveillance
medicine.gist: Detecting aberrations in daily counts from emergency departments or labs using CUSUM, Farrington and scan statistics, with seasonal baselines.

medicine.name: Spatial epidemiology and disease mapping
medicine.gist: Estimating smoothed area-level disease rates and clusters with Poisson regression, conditional autoregressive priors and spatial scan statistics.

medicine.name: Case-control and cohort association analysis
medicine.gist: Estimating odds ratios, risk ratios and rate ratios with confounder adjustment, matching, stratification and effect-modification assessment.

medicine.name: Causal inference from observational health data
medicine.gist: Estimating treatment effects with propensity scores, inverse probability weighting, g-computation or target trial emulation, including balance and sensitivity diagnostics.

medicine.name: Instrumental variable and Mendelian randomization
medicine.gist: Estimating causal exposure effects from genetic or other instruments using two-stage methods, IVW, MR-Egger and pleiotropy-robust estimators.

medicine.name: Meta-analysis of clinical studies
medicine.gist: Pooling effect sizes across trials with fixed and random effects, heterogeneity estimation, subgroup meta-regression and publication-bias tests.

medicine.name: Network meta-analysis of treatments
medicine.gist: Combining direct and indirect trial evidence to rank interventions, checking consistency and computing league tables and SUCRA scores.

medicine.name: Diagnostic test accuracy evaluation
medicine.gist: Computing sensitivity, specificity, ROC curves, likelihood ratios and predictive values with confidence intervals, including verification bias and imperfect reference standards.

medicine.name: Clinical prediction model development
medicine.gist: Developing and internally validating risk scores with penalized regression, bootstrap optimism correction, calibration curves and decision-curve analysis.

medicine.name: Missing data handling in clinical datasets
medicine.gist: Assessing missingness mechanisms and applying multiple imputation or pattern-mixture sensitivity analyses to trial and registry data.

medicine.name: Longitudinal mixed-effects analysis of repeated measures
medicine.gist: Modelling repeated clinical measurements with linear and generalized mixed models, MMRM and joint longitudinal-survival models.

medicine.name: Health economic decision modelling
medicine.gist: Building Markov or microsimulation cost-effectiveness models with QALYs, discounting, ICERs and probabilistic sensitivity analysis.

medicine.name: Electronic health record cohort extraction
medicine.gist: Building processing pipelines that clean, deduplicate and phenotype patients from synthetic EHR tables using code lists, temporal logic and lab rules.

medicine.name: Clinical laboratory reference intervals
medicine.gist: Deriving age- and sex-partitioned reference ranges from routine lab data with robust and indirect methods that separate pathological subpopulations.

medicine.name: Laboratory method comparison and QC
medicine.gist: Assessing analytical agreement and quality control using Bland-Altman, Deming and Passing-Bablok regression, Westgard rules and measurement uncertainty.

medicine.name: Electrocardiogram signal processing
medicine.gist: Filtering ECG recordings, detecting QRS complexes, delineating waves and computing intervals such as QTc, while handling noise and baseline wander.

medicine.name: Physiological variability and complexity analysis
medicine.gist: Quantifying beat-to-beat, breath-to-breath and stride-to-stride fluctuations in physiological interval and event series. This covers heart rate and blood pressure variability, baroreflex sensitivity, cardiorespiratory coupling, respiratory and gait interval variability, and autonomic function testing. Methods include artifact and outlier correction of event series, uneven-sampling spectral estimation, entropy, fractal and detrended fluctuation measures, and coupling and causality analysis between physiological rhythms.

medicine.name: Arrhythmia detection from cardiac rhythms
medicine.gist: Classifying atrial fibrillation, ectopy and other rhythms from beat sequences or waveforms using engineered features and classical classifiers.

medicine.name: EEG spectral and event analysis
medicine.gist: Preprocessing scalp EEG with artifact removal, computing band power and connectivity, and detecting spikes, seizures or sleep spindles.

medicine.name: Sleep staging and polysomnography metrics
medicine.gist: Scoring sleep stages from multichannel physiological signals and deriving apnea-hypopnea indices, oxygen desaturation events and sleep architecture.

medicine.name: Photoplethysmography and pulse oximetry
medicine.gist: Extracting heart rate, SpO2 and respiratory rate from PPG signals, with motion artifact rejection and signal quality indices.

medicine.name: Blood pressure waveform analysis
medicine.gist: Analysing arterial pressure traces for systolic and diastolic detection, pulse wave velocity, augmentation index and Windkessel model fitting.

medicine.name: Electromyography and motor signal analysis
medicine.gist: Processing surface EMG for onset detection, envelope and fatigue metrics, and decomposing motor unit activity.

medicine.name: Gait and wearable accelerometry analysis
medicine.gist: Deriving step counts, gait events, activity intensity and sedentary bouts from inertial sensor streams with calibration and non-wear detection.

medicine.name: Continuous glucose monitoring analytics
medicine.gist: Computing glycemic variability and time-in-range metrics, filling sensor gaps, and fitting glucose-insulin models to CGM traces.

medicine.name: Respiratory mechanics and spirometry
medicine.gist: Analysing flow-volume curves and ventilator waveforms to estimate compliance and resistance and to compute standardized lung-function indices.

medicine.name: Cardiovascular physiology modelling
medicine.gist: Simulating lumped-parameter models of the heart and circulation to reproduce pressure-volume loops and the response to disease or devices.

medicine.name: Glucose-insulin and endocrine system modelling
medicine.gist: Fitting minimal and hormonal feedback ODE models to tolerance-test or pulsatile hormone data to estimate insulin sensitivity and secretion.

medicine.name: CT reconstruction and dose
medicine.gist: Reconstructing CT slices from simulated sinograms with filtered backprojection or iterative methods, then assessing artifacts, noise and radiation dose metrics.

medicine.name: MRI reconstruction from k-space
medicine.gist: Reconstructing MR images from undersampled or multi-coil k-space using parallel imaging, compressed sensing and correction of off-resonance or motion.

medicine.name: Quantitative MRI parameter mapping
medicine.gist: Fitting relaxometry, diffusion tensor, IVIM or DCE pharmacokinetic models voxelwise to multi-contrast MR signals.

medicine.name: Medical image segmentation with classical methods
medicine.gist: Segmenting organs, lesions or cells using thresholding, region growing, active contours, graph cuts or atlas methods, and scoring overlap metrics.

medicine.name: Medical image registration
medicine.gist: Aligning intra- or inter-patient images with rigid, affine or deformable transforms that optimize mutual information or other similarity measures.

medicine.name: Radiomics feature extraction and modelling
medicine.gist: Computing shape, intensity and texture features from segmented regions, then testing reproducibility and building outcome classifiers.

medicine.name: Nuclear medicine and PET quantification
medicine.gist: Reconstructing emission data with MLEM or OSEM and estimating SUV and kinetic parameters with compartmental tracer models and partial-volume correction.

medicine.name: Ultrasound beamforming and elastography
medicine.gist: Forming images from simulated channel data with delay-and-sum or adaptive beamformers, and estimating tissue stiffness or Doppler flow.

medicine.name: Functional MRI time-series analysis
medicine.gist: Preprocessing BOLD signals, fitting general linear models with HRF convolution and computing activation or resting-state connectivity maps.

medicine.name: Digital pathology image analysis
medicine.gist: Analysing histology tiles through stain normalization, nucleus detection, morphometric features and tissue classification with classical pipelines.

medicine.name: Radiotherapy dose planning and evaluation
medicine.gist: Optimizing beam fluences to meet dose-volume constraints, computing DVHs, gamma indices and TCP/NTCP radiobiological models.

medicine.name: Tumor growth and treatment response modelling
medicine.gist: Fitting Gompertz, logistic or mechanistic models to tumor volume or biomarker trajectories to predict response to chemo- or radiotherapy.

medicine.name: Antimicrobial resistance and pharmacodynamics
medicine.gist: Analysing MIC distributions and resistance surveillance trends, and simulating bacterial kill and resistance emergence under dosing regimens.

medicine.name: Pharmacovigilance signal detection
medicine.gist: Mining spontaneous adverse event reports with disproportionality measures such as PRR, ROR and Bayesian shrinkage, and assessing signals over time.

medicine.name: Vaccine efficacy and immunogenicity analysis
medicine.gist: Estimating vaccine effectiveness from test-negative or cohort designs, modelling antibody waning and correlates of protection.

medicine.name: Clinical genomics variant interpretation
medicine.gist: Filtering and annotating patient variant calls with population frequency and inheritance rules, and computing polygenic risk scores with calibration.

medicine.name: Hospital operations and patient flow modelling
medicine.gist: Simulating emergency department and bed occupancy with queueing or discrete-event models, and optimizing staffing or scheduling.

medicine.name: Health survey analysis with complex sampling
medicine.gist: Estimating prevalence and associations from weighted, stratified, clustered health surveys with design-based variance estimation.

medicine.name: Demographic and burden-of-disease estimation
medicine.gist: Building life tables, standardizing rates, decomposing mortality trends and computing DALYs or years of life lost from vital statistics.

medicine.name: Environmental and occupational exposure epidemiology
medicine.gist: Modelling health effects of air pollution, temperature or workplace exposures with distributed-lag nonlinear and time-series Poisson models.

medicine.name: Multi-state and recurrent event models
medicine.gist: Modelling transitions between illness states and repeated events such as hospitalizations or relapses, using Andersen-Gill, PWP, frailty and Markov multi-state models with transition-probability estimation.

medicine.name: Interrupted time series and policy evaluation
medicine.gist: Estimating the effects of health policies or interventions on population outcomes with segmented regression, difference-in-differences, synthetic control and handling of autocorrelation and seasonality.

medicine.name: Multiplicity control in confirmatory trials
medicine.gist: Controlling familywise error across multiple endpoints, doses or subgroups with Bonferroni-Holm, Hochberg, gatekeeping and graphical testing procedures, and verifying error rates by simulation.

medicine.name: Trial randomization and allocation schemes
medicine.gist: Implementing and evaluating permuted-block, stratified, minimization and response-adaptive randomization for balance, predictability and the validity of re-randomization tests.

medicine.name: Inter-rater reliability and clinical agreement
medicine.gist: Quantifying agreement among clinicians or raters with Cohen's and Fleiss' kappa, weighted kappa, ICC variants and generalizability theory, including sample size and confidence intervals.

medicine.name: Psychometrics of patient-reported outcomes
medicine.gist: Validating questionnaires and health scales with item response theory, confirmatory factor analysis, differential item functioning and minimal clinically important difference estimation.

medicine.name: In vitro dose-response and drug synergy
medicine.gist: Fitting Hill and log-logistic curves to cell viability or inhibition assays to estimate IC50 values, and scoring drug combinations with Bliss, Loewe, HSA and ZIP synergy models.

medicine.name: Toxicological benchmark dose and risk assessment
medicine.gist: Fitting quantal and continuous dose-response models to animal toxicity data to derive benchmark doses with BMDL, using model averaging and extrapolation to reference doses.

medicine.name: Biological assay relative potency
medicine.gist: Estimating relative potency from parallel-line and slope-ratio bioassays, with tests of parallelism and linearity, Fieller confidence intervals and combination of assays.

medicine.name: Provider performance profiling and risk adjustment
medicine.gist: Comparing hospital or surgeon outcomes with risk-adjusted standardized ratios, funnel plots, hierarchical shrinkage and risk-adjusted CUSUM monitoring of surgical outcomes.

medicine.name: Medication adherence and drug utilization analysis
medicine.gist: Deriving adherence, persistence and treatment episodes from pharmacy dispensing or claims records using PDC, MPR, grace-period rules and group-based trajectory modelling.

medicine.name: Health inequality measurement
medicine.gist: Quantifying socioeconomic and geographic disparities in health with concentration indices, slope and relative indices of inequality, Theil decomposition and Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition.

medicine.name: Cancer screening natural history modelling
medicine.gist: Simulating preclinical disease progression to estimate sojourn time, test sensitivity, lead time, length bias and overdiagnosis, and to compare screening schedules.

medicine.name: Agent-based and network transmission modelling
medicine.gist: Simulating epidemics on contact networks or with individual-based models to evaluate contact tracing, household transmission, superspreading and targeted vaccination strategies.

medicine.name: Pathogen genomic epidemiology and phylodynamics
medicine.gist: Inferring transmission clusters, molecular clock rates, growth rates and who-infected-whom from pathogen sequence alignments, combined with case dates and locations.

medicine.name: Wastewater-based epidemiology
medicine.gist: Normalizing pathogen concentrations in sewage with flow and fecal markers, smoothing noisy assay data and relating wastewater signals to clinical incidence and prevalence.

medicine.name: Within-host viral and immune dynamics
medicine.gist: Fitting target-cell-limited and immune-response ODE models to viral load or antibody kinetics to estimate infected-cell lifespans, viral clearance and antiviral drug efficacy.

medicine.name: Clinical deterioration and early warning scores
medicine.gist: Building and evaluating early warning systems for sepsis or cardiac arrest from irregularly sampled vital signs and labs, with lead-time-aware performance and alarm burden metrics.

medicine.name: Child growth and anthropometric references
medicine.gist: Constructing growth centile curves with LMS and GAMLSS methods, computing z-scores, and classifying stunting, wasting and growth faltering from longitudinal measurements.

medicine.name: Nutritional epidemiology and measurement error correction
medicine.gist: Analysing dietary intake data with energy adjustment, dietary pattern extraction and regression calibration or SIMEX corrections for error in self-reported exposures.

medicine.name: Fairness and bias auditing of clinical algorithms
medicine.gist: Assessing subgroup disparities in calibration, error rates and decision thresholds of clinical risk models, and evaluating recalibration or reweighting mitigation strategies.

medicine.name: High-dimensional biomarker discovery
medicine.gist: Screening omics or proteomic panels for diagnostic and prognostic markers with false discovery rate control, stability selection and validation of multimarker signatures.

medicine.name: Ophthalmic imaging and visual function analysis
medicine.gist: Segmenting retinal layers and vessels in OCT or fundus images, and analysing visual field series for glaucoma progression with pointwise regression and event-based criteria.

medicine.name: Audiometry and auditory signal analysis
medicine.gist: Processing pure-tone audiograms, otoacoustic emissions and auditory brainstem responses to estimate thresholds, classify hearing loss and fit hearing-aid prescriptions.

medicine.name: Musculoskeletal biomechanics and motion capture
medicine.gist: Computing joint kinematics and kinetics from marker trajectories and force plates with inverse kinematics, inverse dynamics and muscle-force estimation by static optimization.

medicine.name: Vascular hemodynamics simulation
medicine.gist: Simulating blood flow in arteries with Womersley, 1D wave-propagation or lattice models to estimate wall shear stress, stenosis pressure drops and fractional flow reserve.

medicine.name: Cardiac electrophysiology modelling
medicine.gist: Simulating cardiomyocyte action potentials and tissue propagation with Hodgkin-Huxley-type and monodomain models to study drug-induced QT prolongation, restitution and reentry.

medicine.name: Bioheat transfer and thermal therapy modelling
medicine.gist: Solving the Pennes bioheat equation for hyperthermia, radiofrequency or laser ablation to predict temperature fields and thermal damage with Arrhenius and CEM43 dose models.

medicine.name: Near-infrared spectroscopy and diffuse optics
medicine.gist: Recovering tissue oxygenation and hemodynamic changes from NIRS or diffuse optical measurements using the modified Beer-Lambert law, diffusion-theory fitting and motion artifact correction.

medicine.name: Clinical text processing with rule-based NLP
medicine.gist: Extracting diagnoses, medications and measurements from synthetic clinical notes with pattern matching, negation and temporality detection, de-identification and concept normalization.

medicine.name: Radionuclide therapy internal dosimetry
medicine.gist: Estimating absorbed doses to organs and tumors from serial SPECT/PET activity with time-activity curve fitting, MIRD S-values, voxel dose kernels and biologically effective dose for radioligand therapy.

medicine.name: Diffusion MRI tractography and structural connectomics
medicine.gist: Reconstructing white-matter pathways from fiber orientation fields with deterministic or probabilistic tracking, then building and analysing structural connectivity networks with graph metrics.

medicine.name: EEG and MEG source localization
medicine.gist: Solving the electromagnetic inverse problem with lead-field models, dipole fitting, minimum-norm, LORETA or beamformer estimators to localize cortical generators of evoked or epileptic activity.

medicine.name: Target-mediated drug disposition and biologics PK
medicine.gist: Modelling monoclonal antibody and biologic kinetics with TMDD, quasi-equilibrium and receptor-occupancy ODE models, FcRn recycling and anti-drug antibody effects on nonlinear clearance.

medicine.name: QSAR and ADMET property modelling
medicine.gist: Predicting drug potency, solubility, permeability, hERG liability or toxicity from molecular descriptors and fingerprints, with applicability domain checks and scaffold-split validation.

medicine.name: Epidemic forecasting and forecast evaluation
medicine.gist: Producing probabilistic forecasts of cases, hospitalizations or deaths with statistical and mechanistic models and ensembles, scored with weighted interval scores, CRPS, coverage and calibration.

medicine.name: Seroprevalence and serocatalytic modelling
medicine.gist: Estimating population seroprevalence with test sensitivity and specificity adjustment and inferring age- or time-varying force of infection from cross-sectional serosurveys with mixture-model cutoffs.

medicine.name: Capture-recapture prevalence estimation
medicine.gist: Estimating the size of hidden or under-ascertained patient populations from overlapping registries and data sources using log-linear multiple-system estimation with source dependence and heterogeneity.

medicine.name: Relative survival and cure models for cancer registries
medicine.gist: Estimating net and relative survival against population life tables with Ederer and Pohar-Perme estimators, excess hazard regression, mixture and non-mixture cure models and period analysis.

medicine.name: Bayesian borrowing from historical and external controls
medicine.gist: Augmenting trial arms with historical or real-world data through power priors, commensurate priors, meta-analytic-predictive priors and robust mixtures, assessing prior-data conflict and type I error inflation.

medicine.name: Clinical microbiome data analysis
medicine.gist: Analysing amplicon or metagenomic count tables from patients with alpha and beta diversity, compositional transforms, differential abundance testing and association with clinical outcomes.

medicine.name: Clinical flow cytometry analysis
medicine.gist: Processing multiparameter cytometry events through compensation, transformation, automated gating and clustering to quantify cell populations, minimal residual disease and immunophenotypes.

medicine.name: Bioanalytical method validation and calibration
medicine.gist: Building weighted calibration curves for LC-MS and immunoassay quantitation, establishing LOD, LLOQ, accuracy, precision, matrix effects and incurred-sample reanalysis acceptance under regulatory criteria.

medicine.name: Dermatological and wound image analysis
medicine.gist: Segmenting skin lesions and wounds in dermoscopic or clinical photographs, extracting color, asymmetry and border features, correcting illumination and tracking wound area healing over time.

medicine.name: Bone densitometry and skeletal imaging analysis
medicine.gist: Computing BMD T- and Z-scores from DXA or QCT data, trabecular bone texture and microarchitecture metrics, vertebral fracture morphometry and absolute fracture risk estimation.

medicine.name: Imaging system performance and observer studies
medicine.gist: Characterizing image quality with MTF, noise power spectra and detectability indices from model observers, and analysing multi-reader multi-case ROC studies of radiologist performance.

medicine.name: Gas exchange, oxygen transport and acid-base physiology
medicine.gist: Modelling oxygen-hemoglobin dissociation, ventilation-perfusion mismatch, capnography and blood gas data, and interpreting acid-base disturbances with Henderson-Hasselbalch and Stewart approaches.

medicine.name: Renal function and dialysis kinetics
medicine.gist: Estimating GFR from creatinine and cystatin equations or tracer clearance, and modelling urea and solute kinetics in hemodialysis to compute Kt/V, clearance and dialysis prescription adequacy.

medicine.name: Cardiopulmonary exercise testing analysis
medicine.gist: Deriving VO2 peak, ventilatory and lactate thresholds, oxygen uptake kinetics and VE/VCO2 slopes from breath-by-breath gas exchange data with noise filtering and breakpoint detection.

medicine.name: Closed-loop physiological control systems
medicine.gist: Designing and testing in silico controllers for artificial pancreas, anesthesia depth, vasopressor or ventilator automation using PID, model predictive control and virtual patient populations.

medicine.name: Voice and speech pathology acoustics
medicine.gist: Computing jitter, shimmer, harmonics-to-noise ratio, cepstral peak prominence and formant measures from voice recordings to quantify dysphonia, dysarthria and neurological disease progression.

medicine.name: Ecological momentary assessment and intensive longitudinal analysis
medicine.gist: Modelling dense within-person symptom or behaviour data from diaries and smartphones with multilevel vector autoregression, dynamic networks, time-varying effects and compliance-aware handling.

medicine.name: Twin and family studies of heritability
medicine.gist: Estimating genetic and environmental variance components from twin and pedigree data with ACE structural equation models, liability-threshold models and familial aggregation analysis.

medicine.name: Self-controlled pharmacoepidemiologic designs
medicine.gist: Estimating transient drug or vaccine effects with self-controlled case series, case-crossover and case-time-control designs, handling event-dependent exposure, seasonality and risk window choice.

medicine.name: Statistical disclosure control of health data
medicine.gist: Protecting patient microdata and tabulations with k-anonymity, l-diversity, cell suppression, synthetic data generation and differential privacy, while measuring re-identification risk and utility loss.

medicine.name: Multi-criteria benefit-risk assessment
medicine.gist: Weighing efficacy and safety outcomes of treatments with MCDA, stochastic multicriteria acceptability analysis, swing weighting and quantitative benefit-risk frameworks under parameter uncertainty.

medicine.name: Organ allocation and kidney exchange optimization
medicine.gist: Optimizing kidney paired-donation cycles and chains, and simulating organ allocation policies for waitlist outcomes, using integer programming, compatibility graphs and fairness constraints.

medicine.name: Geographic access to health services
medicine.gist: Measuring spatial accessibility with two-step floating catchment and gravity models, and optimizing locations of clinics, ambulances or screening sites for coverage and travel-time objectives.

medicine.name: Bioimpedance and electrical impedance tomography
medicine.gist: Reconstructing lung ventilation or tissue conductivity images from boundary voltage data with regularized EIT inversion, and estimating body composition from bioimpedance spectroscopy with Cole models.

medicine.name: Fetal heart rate and cardiotocography analysis
medicine.gist: Processing intrapartum and antenatal CTG traces to estimate baseline, variability, accelerations, decelerations and uterine contractions, handling signal loss and classifying fetal compromise.

neuroscience.name: Extracellular spike sorting
neuroscience.gist: Detect, align and cluster action potentials from multi-channel extracellular recordings, using threshold detection, PCA/wavelet features and mixture or density clustering. Score unit isolation with L-ratio, isolation distance and ISI violations, and correct electrode drift in probe recordings by estimating motion from spike positions over time.

neuroscience.name: Local field potential spectral analysis
neuroscience.gist: Estimate power spectra, separate periodic oscillations from aperiodic 1/f background, and track band power over time in LFP recordings using multitaper and parametric fits.

neuroscience.name: Current source density analysis
neuroscience.gist: Infer transmembrane current sources from laminar LFP profiles with standard, spline or kernel CSD methods and localize sinks across cortical layers.

neuroscience.name: Phase-amplitude and cross-frequency coupling
neuroscience.gist: Measure coupling between low-frequency phase and high-frequency amplitude in neural signals using modulation indices, surrogate statistics and bias-corrected estimators.

neuroscience.name: Spike-field coherence and phase locking
neuroscience.gist: Quantify how spikes lock to oscillation phase via pairwise phase consistency, spike-triggered averages and coherence, while correcting for spike-count bias.

neuroscience.name: Sharp-wave ripple and burst event detection
neuroscience.gist: Detect transient oscillatory events such as hippocampal ripples, spindles or beta bursts in field recordings with band-pass envelopes, adaptive thresholds and duration criteria.

neuroscience.name: Intracellular patch-clamp feature extraction
neuroscience.gist: Extract passive membrane properties, action potential waveform features and f-I curves from current-clamp sweeps, and fit membrane time constants and input resistance.

neuroscience.name: Voltage-clamp ionic current kinetics
neuroscience.gist: Fit Hodgkin-Huxley-style activation and inactivation curves, time constants and reversal potentials to voltage-clamp protocol data, with leak and series-resistance correction.

neuroscience.name: Synaptic event detection and analysis
neuroscience.gist: Detect miniature and spontaneous postsynaptic currents with template matching or deconvolution, then analyse amplitude and interval distributions and quantal parameters.

neuroscience.name: Short-term synaptic plasticity modelling
neuroscience.gist: Fit Tsodyks-Markram or release-probability models to paired-pulse and train responses to estimate facilitation, depression and recovery time constants.

neuroscience.name: Spike train point-process GLMs
neuroscience.gist: Fit Poisson or Bernoulli generalized linear models with stimulus filters, spike-history and coupling terms to spike trains, and assess fits with time-rescaling goodness-of-fit tests.

neuroscience.name: Firing-rate estimation and PSTH smoothing
neuroscience.gist: Estimate time-varying firing rates from trial-aligned spike trains with optimized kernel bandwidths, Bayesian adaptive smoothing or Gaussian process regression.

neuroscience.name: Spike train variability and regularity
neuroscience.gist: Characterize interspike-interval statistics, Fano factors, CV2, local variation and renewal-model fits, and test for non-stationarity in spike trains.

neuroscience.name: Spike train synchrony and correlation
neuroscience.gist: Quantify pairwise and higher-order spike correlations with cross-correlograms, jitter-based surrogates and unitary event analysis, and separate them from shared rate covariation.

neuroscience.name: Spike train distance metrics
neuroscience.gist: Compare spike trains with Victor-Purpura, van Rossum, SPIKE and ISI distances to quantify stimulus discriminability and reliability across trials.

neuroscience.name: Receptive field and tuning curve estimation
neuroscience.gist: Estimate spatial and temporal receptive fields or orientation and frequency tuning from stimulus-response data with spike-triggered averages, regularized regression and parametric tuning fits.

neuroscience.name: Information-theoretic neural coding
neuroscience.gist: Estimate mutual information and entropy between stimuli and spike counts or patterns with bias-corrected plug-in, NSB or shuffle-corrected estimators.

neuroscience.name: Population decoding of stimuli and movement
neuroscience.gist: Decode stimuli, position or kinematics from neural population activity with Bayesian, Kalman-filter or regularized linear decoders, using cross-validated error estimates.

neuroscience.name: Hippocampal place and grid cell analysis
neuroscience.gist: Compute occupancy-normalized rate maps, spatial information, grid scores and head-direction tuning from tracking and spike data, with shuffle significance tests.

neuroscience.name: Neural population dimensionality reduction
neuroscience.gist: Extract low-dimensional latent trajectories from trial-structured population activity with PCA, factor analysis, GPFA or demixed PCA, and characterize their dynamics.

neuroscience.name: Latent dynamical systems for neural data
neuroscience.gist: Fit linear dynamical systems, switching LDS or hidden Markov models to multi-neuron recordings to infer latent states and transitions.

neuroscience.name: Representational similarity analysis
neuroscience.gist: Build representational dissimilarity matrices from neural or model responses and compare them with model RDMs using rank correlations, noise ceilings and permutation tests.

neuroscience.name: Calcium imaging trace processing
neuroscience.gist: Compute ΔF/F with baseline estimation, subtract neuropil contamination and detect calcium transients in fluorescence traces extracted from two-photon imaging.

neuroscience.name: Spike inference from calcium fluorescence
neuroscience.gist: Deconvolve fluorescence traces into spike rates or events with autoregressive models, non-negative deconvolution or sequential Monte Carlo, and calibrate against ground truth.

neuroscience.name: Imaging motion correction and ROI segmentation
neuroscience.gist: Register frames of functional imaging movies by rigid or piecewise phase correlation and segment cell ROIs by matrix factorization or correlation-based methods.

neuroscience.name: fMRI general linear model analysis
neuroscience.gist: Model BOLD time series with HRF-convolved task regressors, nuisance confounds and autocorrelated noise, then compute contrasts and multiple-comparison-corrected statistical maps.

neuroscience.name: Hemodynamic response function estimation
neuroscience.gist: Estimate voxel or region HRF shapes with FIR, basis-set or parametric models and quantify latency and width differences across regions or conditions.

neuroscience.name: fMRI preprocessing and denoising
neuroscience.gist: Perform slice-timing correction, motion-parameter regression, CompCor, scrubbing and temporal filtering on 4D volumes, and quantify how much each step reduces noise.

neuroscience.name: Resting-state functional connectivity
neuroscience.gist: Estimate region-wise connectivity matrices from parcellated BOLD time series with correlation, partial correlation or shrinkage covariance, and test group differences.

neuroscience.name: Dynamic functional connectivity states
neuroscience.gist: Track time-varying connectivity with sliding windows, phase synchrony or HMMs and cluster recurring connectivity states, assessing dwell times and transitions.

neuroscience.name: Multivariate pattern decoding of neuroimaging
neuroscience.gist: Classify conditions from voxel or sensor patterns with cross-validated linear classifiers or searchlights, using correct fold structure and permutation-based significance.

neuroscience.name: Diffusion MRI tensor and microstructure modelling
neuroscience.gist: Fit diffusion tensor, kurtosis or multi-compartment models to diffusion-weighted signals to estimate FA, MD and fibre orientations under Rician noise.

neuroscience.name: Tractography and structural connectomes
neuroscience.gist: Propagate streamlines through fibre-orientation fields and assemble region-to-region structural connectivity matrices, with filtering and thresholding choices.

neuroscience.name: Brain network graph analysis
neuroscience.gist: Compute modularity, hubs, rich-club coefficients, small-worldness and efficiency of structural or functional brain graphs against degree-preserving null models.

neuroscience.name: Structural MRI morphometry
neuroscience.gist: Estimate tissue volumes, cortical thickness proxies or voxel-based morphometry from segmented anatomical images, with covariate-adjusted group statistics.

neuroscience.name: Cerebrovascular and haemodynamic imaging
neuroscience.gist: Quantitative imaging of the brain's blood supply and vascular physiology. Examples include perfusion and blood-volume mapping, cerebrovascular reactivity to CO2 or breath-hold challenges, calibrated BOLD and oxygen-metabolism estimation, oxygen extraction fraction from susceptibility or T2 methods, phase-contrast MRI velocity and flow quantification, angiographic vessel segmentation and vascular territory mapping, blood-brain barrier permeability, and vascular-lesion characterisation in stroke and small-vessel disease.

neuroscience.name: EEG artifact removal and preprocessing
neuroscience.gist: Remove ocular, muscle and line-noise artifacts from multichannel EEG with ICA, regression, notch filtering and bad-channel interpolation, and re-reference the data.

neuroscience.name: Event-related potential analysis
neuroscience.gist: Epoch, baseline-correct and average EEG around events, measure ERP component latencies and amplitudes, and test effects with cluster-based permutation statistics.

neuroscience.name: Time-frequency analysis of M/EEG
neuroscience.gist: Compute event-related spectral perturbations and inter-trial coherence with Morlet wavelets or multitapers, and assess significance with nonparametric statistics.

neuroscience.name: EEG/MEG source localization
neuroscience.gist: Solve forward and inverse problems for scalp sensor data with dipole fitting, minimum-norm, LCMV beamformers or sparse priors on spherical or simplified head models.

neuroscience.name: Directed connectivity and Granger causality
neuroscience.gist: Estimate directed interactions between neural signals with multivariate autoregressive models, Granger causality, partial directed coherence or transfer entropy, and correct for volume conduction.

neuroscience.name: Sleep staging and polysomnography
neuroscience.gist: Classify sleep stages from EEG, EOG and EMG epochs using spectral features and detect spindles, slow waves and arousals in overnight recordings.

neuroscience.name: Seizure and epileptiform event detection
neuroscience.gist: Detect interictal spikes, high-frequency oscillations and seizure onsets in scalp or intracranial EEG using line length, spectral features and classifier pipelines.

neuroscience.name: Brain-computer interface signal decoding
neuroscience.gist: Decode motor imagery, SSVEP or P300 responses from EEG with common spatial patterns, canonical correlation or Riemannian classifiers in offline evaluation.

neuroscience.name: Drift-diffusion and evidence accumulation models
neuroscience.gist: Fit drift-diffusion, linear ballistic accumulator or race models to choice and reaction-time data by likelihood or quantile methods, and compare model variants.

neuroscience.name: Psychophysical function fitting
neuroscience.gist: Fit psychometric functions with lapse rates, estimate thresholds and slopes, and simulate or analyse adaptive staircases and signal-detection-theory measures.

neuroscience.name: Reinforcement learning models of behaviour
neuroscience.gist: Fit Q-learning, actor-critic or model-based/model-free hybrid models to trial-by-trial choices by maximum likelihood or hierarchical estimation, with parameter recovery checks.

neuroscience.name: Bayesian observer and cue-combination models
neuroscience.gist: Model perceptual estimates as Bayesian inference with priors and sensory noise, fitting cue-integration weights, biases and causal-inference parameters to response data.

neuroscience.name: Animal pose and movement kinematics
neuroscience.gist: Clean and filter tracked keypoint trajectories, compute velocities, joint angles and gait cycles, and segment locomotion bouts from video-derived pose data.

neuroscience.name: Unsupervised behavioural motif segmentation
neuroscience.gist: Discover recurring behavioural syllables from pose or accelerometry time series with autoregressive HMMs, wavelet embeddings and clustering, and characterize transition structure.

neuroscience.name: Eye movement and pupillometry analysis
neuroscience.gist: Detect saccades, fixations and blinks in eye-tracking traces, interpolate artifacts and model task-evoked pupil dilation with deconvolution.

neuroscience.name: Single-neuron conductance-based modelling
neuroscience.gist: Simulate and fit Hodgkin-Huxley-type or multi-compartment neuron models, explore excitability with bifurcation analysis, and match recorded voltage features.

neuroscience.name: Integrate-and-fire model fitting
neuroscience.gist: Fit leaky, exponential or adaptive integrate-and-fire models to intracellular recordings and predict spike timing with coincidence-factor scoring.

neuroscience.name: Dendritic cable and morphology modelling
neuroscience.gist: Solve cable equations on reconstructed or synthetic dendritic trees to compute attenuation, electrotonic length and input impedance, and compute morphometric statistics.

neuroscience.name: Spiking network dynamics simulation
neuroscience.gist: Simulate balanced excitatory-inhibitory spiking networks, measure irregularity, synchrony and oscillations, and map dynamical regimes across coupling parameters.

neuroscience.name: Neural mass and mean-field models
neuroscience.gist: Simulate Wilson-Cowan, Jansen-Rit or firing-rate mean-field models, analyse fixed points and oscillations, and fit them to population signals or spectra.

neuroscience.name: Whole-brain network models
neuroscience.gist: Couple regional oscillator or neural mass models via structural connectomes and fit global coupling and delays to reproduce empirical functional connectivity.

neuroscience.name: Synaptic plasticity and learning rules
neuroscience.gist: Simulate STDP, BCM or homeostatic plasticity in neurons and networks and analyse weight stability, receptive field formation and the resulting memory capacity.

neuroscience.name: Attractor and working memory network models
neuroscience.gist: Build Hopfield, ring or continuous attractor networks, analyse their storage capacity, drift and noise robustness, and relate the dynamics to working memory or head-direction data.

neuroscience.name: Single-channel recording kinetics
neuroscience.gist: Idealize single ion-channel patch recordings into open and closed events, fit dwell-time distributions with exponential mixtures, and estimate aggregated Markov gating schemes with missed-event correction.

neuroscience.name: Fast-scan cyclic voltammetry neurochemistry
neuroscience.gist: Extract dopamine or serotonin transients from background-subtracted voltammograms with principal component regression, and fit release and Michaelis-Menten uptake kinetics to evoked signals.

neuroscience.name: Voltage imaging spike extraction
neuroscience.gist: Recover spikes and subthreshold potentials from noisy genetically encoded voltage indicator traces, using photobleaching correction, spatial filters, matched-filter detection and SNR estimation.

neuroscience.name: Widefield mesoscale imaging analysis
neuroscience.gist: Correct widefield cortical fluorescence for hemodynamic contamination with multi-wavelength regression, register it to atlas areas, and compute area-wise activity maps and seed-based correlations.

neuroscience.name: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy analysis
neuroscience.gist: Convert fNIRS optical densities to oxy- and deoxyhemoglobin with the modified Beer-Lambert law, remove motion and systemic physiology with short channels, and fit task GLMs.

neuroscience.name: PET tracer kinetic modelling
neuroscience.gist: Fit compartment models, Logan or Patlak graphical analyses and reference-tissue models to dynamic PET time-activity curves to estimate binding potential, distribution volume and receptor occupancy.

neuroscience.name: Magnetic resonance spectroscopy quantification
neuroscience.gist: Phase, frequency-align and fit brain MR spectra as linear combinations of metabolite basis signals with baseline and lineshape terms, and report metabolite concentrations with Cramér-Rao bounds.

neuroscience.name: Quantitative MRI parameter mapping and signal modelling
neuroscience.gist: Estimate voxelwise physical or physiological tissue parameters from multi-contrast, multi-parameter MR acquisitions using biophysical signal models. This includes relaxation times, magnetization transfer and CEST exchange parameters, compartment fractions, and B0/B1 field maps. Methods include Bloch and extended-phase-graph simulation of pulse sequences, dictionary matching for MR fingerprinting, joint or spatially regularized model inversion, correction of field inhomogeneity and noise-floor bias, Cramér-Rao-based acquisition protocol optimization, and test-retest reliability and phantom validation of quantitative maps.
neuroscience.broadened_from: Quantitative MRI relaxometry and myelin mapping

neuroscience.name: Population receptive field mapping
neuroscience.gist: Fit Gaussian or difference-of-Gaussians pRF models to fMRI responses evoked by moving retinotopic stimuli, and derive eccentricity, polar-angle and size maps and visual area borders.

neuroscience.name: Voxelwise encoding models
neuroscience.gist: Predict fMRI or ECoG responses to naturalistic stimuli from stimulus feature spaces with banded ridge regression and FIR delays, and estimate held-out prediction accuracy and variance partitioning.

neuroscience.name: Brain age and normative modelling
neuroscience.gist: Model how imaging-derived phenotypes vary with age and covariates using Gaussian process or quantile regression, predict brain age, and compute individual deviation scores with bias correction.

neuroscience.name: Lesion-symptom mapping
neuroscience.gist: Relate voxelwise or region-wise lesion masks to behavioural deficit scores with mass-univariate tests, lesion-volume control and multivariate SVR-based mapping under permutation thresholds.

neuroscience.name: Multi-site neuroimaging harmonization
neuroscience.gist: Remove scanner and site effects from imaging features with ComBat-style empirical Bayes location-scale adjustment while preserving biological covariate effects, and validate the residual site signal.

neuroscience.name: EEG microstate analysis
neuroscience.gist: Cluster global field power peak topographies into polarity-invariant microstate maps with modified k-means, back-fit them to continuous EEG, and compare durations, coverage and transition statistics.

neuroscience.name: Cortical travelling wave analysis
neuroscience.gist: Detect and characterize propagating waves in multi-electrode or imaging data by phase-gradient estimation, optical flow and circular-linear fits of wave direction, speed and wavelength.

neuroscience.name: Neural field models and pattern formation
neuroscience.gist: Simulate spatially continuous Amari or Wilson-Cowan neural field equations, derive Turing instabilities and bump or travelling-wave solutions, and relate them to visual hallucination or cortical wave patterns.

neuroscience.name: Neurostimulation volume-conductor field modelling
neuroscience.gist: Compute electric fields and potentials induced by TMS, tDCS or DBS electrodes in layered spherical or simplified finite-element head and tissue models, and optimize electrode montages to a target.

neuroscience.name: Axonal activation by electrical stimulation
neuroscience.gist: Model extracellular stimulation of myelinated and unmyelinated fibres with cable models and activating functions to compute strength-duration curves, recruitment and fibre selectivity.

neuroscience.name: EMG and motor unit decomposition
neuroscience.gist: Process surface or intramuscular EMG with envelope and onset detection, and decompose high-density recordings into motor unit spike trains by convolutive blind source separation.

neuroscience.name: Sensorimotor adaptation state-space models
neuroscience.gist: Fit single- and multi-rate state-space learning models to trial-by-trial reaching errors in visuomotor rotation or force-field adaptation, estimating retention, learning rates and savings.

neuroscience.name: Optimal feedback control of movement
neuroscience.gist: Model reaching and posture with LQG optimal feedback control and signal-dependent noise, simulating trajectories and variability and fitting cost weights to kinematic data.

neuroscience.name: Central pattern generator models
neuroscience.gist: Simulate half-centre oscillators and coupled phase-oscillator networks for rhythmic motor output, analyse phase locking, frequency control and gait transitions, and fit models to motor-nerve recordings.

neuroscience.name: Auditory periphery and sound localization models
neuroscience.gist: Simulate cochlear filterbanks, hair-cell transduction and auditory nerve firing, and model interaural time and level difference processing to predict localization and pitch responses.

neuroscience.name: Circadian and actigraphy rhythm analysis
neuroscience.gist: Estimate period, phase and amplitude of activity, temperature or reporter rhythms with cosinor, Lomb-Scargle and nonparametric interdaily stability and intradaily variability measures, and detect phase shifts.

neuroscience.name: Animal vocalization analysis
neuroscience.gist: Detect and segment birdsong syllables or rodent ultrasonic vocalizations in audio spectrograms, extract acoustic features and cluster call types or quantify song learning similarity.

neuroscience.name: Neurodegenerative disease progression modelling
neuroscience.gist: Infer biomarker abnormality orderings with event-based models, fit sigmoidal progression trajectories, or simulate network diffusion of pathology on connectomes to predict atrophy patterns.

neuroscience.name: Histological neuroanatomy quantification
neuroscience.gist: Count and localize labelled neurons in microscopy stacks with blob detection and design-based stereology, trace neurite skeletons for Sholl analysis, and register sections to atlas coordinates.

neuroscience.name: Task-trained recurrent network models
neuroscience.gist: Train small rate RNNs on cognitive tasks such as context-dependent integration or delayed comparison, then reverse-engineer their fixed points, linearized dynamics and correspondence to recorded neural data.

neuroscience.name: Burst detection and network bursts in spike trains
neuroscience.gist: Detect single-unit bursts with Poisson surprise, rank surprise or ISI-threshold methods, and identify and characterize network bursts in multi-electrode array recordings of cultured neurons.

neuroscience.name: Hierarchical statistics for nested neural data
neuroscience.gist: Analyse neuroscience data nested across trials, cells, animals and sessions with linear and generalized mixed models or hierarchical bootstrap, avoiding pseudoreplication and computing power for experimental designs.

neuroscience.name: Neuronal avalanches and criticality
neuroscience.gist: Detect cascades of activity in spike or LFP data, fit power-law and alternative heavy-tailed distributions to avalanche sizes and durations by maximum likelihood, estimate branching ratios with subsampling-robust methods, and test scaling relations against shuffled data.

neuroscience.name: Neural signal complexity and entropy measures
neuroscience.gist: Quantify the complexity of EEG, LFP or spike signals with Lempel-Ziv complexity, sample and multiscale entropy, permutation entropy and perturbational complexity indices, and relate them to arousal, anaesthesia depth or disease state.

neuroscience.name: Coordinate-based neuroimaging meta-analysis
neuroscience.gist: Pool reported activation peak coordinates across studies with activation likelihood estimation or multilevel kernel density methods, build modelled activation maps, and threshold them with permutation-based cluster inference and contrast or conjunction analyses.

neuroscience.name: Connectivity gradients and data-driven parcellation
neuroscience.gist: Derive cortical organizational gradients from connectivity matrices with diffusion-map or Laplacian embeddings, align them across subjects with Procrustes methods, and partition the brain into parcels by spectral or region-growing clustering with homogeneity validation.

neuroscience.name: Brain image registration and spatial normalization
neuroscience.gist: Align anatomical and functional brain volumes with rigid, affine and nonlinear deformable registration that optimizes mutual information or cross-correlation, transform coordinates and labels to template space, and evaluate alignment with overlap and landmark errors.

neuroscience.name: MRI tissue segmentation and bias-field correction
neuroscience.gist: Estimate and remove smooth intensity inhomogeneity from structural MRI, then classify voxels into grey matter, white matter and CSF with Gaussian mixtures, Markov random field priors and partial-volume models, scoring results with Dice overlap.

neuroscience.name: Quantitative susceptibility mapping
neuroscience.gist: Reconstruct tissue magnetic susceptibility from multi-echo gradient-echo phase by phase unwrapping, background field removal and regularized dipole inversion, and quantify iron-related susceptibility in deep grey matter.

neuroscience.name: Hippocampal replay sequence detection
neuroscience.gist: Decode position from population spikes during candidate events with Bayesian decoders, score sequential structure with weighted correlation or line-fitting, and establish replay significance against time-bin, cell-identity and circular shuffles.

neuroscience.name: Cell assembly detection
neuroscience.gist: Identify co-active neuronal ensembles in binned population activity using PCA/ICA with Marchenko-Pastur thresholds, non-negative factorization or sequence-detection methods, and track assembly expression and reactivation across behavioural epochs.

neuroscience.name: Fisher information and population coding theory
neuroscience.gist: Compute linear and full Fisher information of tuned neural populations, quantify how noise and information-limiting correlations shape discrimination thresholds, and estimate bias-corrected information from finite recorded trials.

neuroscience.name: Efficient and sparse coding of natural stimuli
neuroscience.gist: Derive optimal sensory codes with whitening, ICA and sparse dictionary learning on natural image or sound statistics, and compare the emergent filters and response distributions with measured receptive fields and nonlinearities.

neuroscience.name: Volterra-Wiener nonlinear system identification
neuroscience.gist: Characterize nonlinear neural input-output transformations by estimating Wiener or Volterra kernels from white-noise stimulation, fitting Laguerre-expanded or cascade LNL models, and validating kernel predictions on held-out data.

neuroscience.name: Developmental self-organization of cortical maps
neuroscience.gist: Simulate activity-dependent formation of orientation, ocular dominance and retinotopic maps with Kohonen, elastic-net or correlation-based Hebbian models, and analyse pinwheel density, map periodicity and their dependence on input statistics.

neuroscience.name: Electroretinography and phototransduction modelling
neuroscience.gist: Fit phototransduction cascade models such as the Lamb-Pugh a-wave model, Naka-Rushton intensity-response functions and photoreceptor adaptation kinetics to flash ERG and single-cell photocurrent recordings.

neuroscience.name: Vestibular and oculomotor control models
neuroscience.gist: Model the vestibulo-ocular reflex, velocity storage, neural integrators and saccadic burst generators as control systems, and fit their gains, time constants and leak to head- and eye-movement recordings.

neuroscience.name: Intracellular calcium and second-messenger signalling
neuroscience.gist: Simulate neuronal and glial calcium dynamics with buffering, pumps and IP3-receptor models, and biochemical cascades such as CaMKII bistability or cAMP/PKA signalling, analysing thresholds, oscillations and stochastic effects.

neuroscience.name: Synaptic receptor kinetics and transmitter diffusion
neuroscience.gist: Model neurotransmitter release and cleft diffusion with deterministic or Monte Carlo reaction-diffusion, fit Markov kinetic schemes of AMPA, NMDA or GABA-A receptors to rapid-application currents, and predict synaptic waveform variability.

neuroscience.name: Compound action potential and nerve conduction analysis
neuroscience.gist: Analyse clinical and in vitro nerve conduction recordings by measuring latencies, conduction velocities and amplitudes, and invert compound action potentials into fibre-diameter or conduction-velocity distributions.

neuroscience.name: Cerebral autoregulation and intracranial pressure dynamics
neuroscience.gist: Assess cerebral autoregulation from blood-pressure and cerebral blood-flow velocity with transfer-function and correlation indices, and analyse intracranial pressure waveforms with compliance and CSF-dynamics models such as Marmarou's infusion model.

neuroscience.name: Neuroendocrine pulsatile secretion analysis
neuroscience.gist: Detect hormone pulses and estimate secretion and elimination kinetics from frequently sampled LH, GnRH, cortisol or growth hormone series with deconvolution and pulse-detection algorithms, and quantify pulse frequency and regularity.

neuroscience.name: Autonomic and electrodermal psychophysiology
neuroscience.gist: Decompose skin conductance into tonic and phasic components, estimate heart-rate variability and baroreflex sensitivity, and model stimulus-evoked autonomic responses for emotion, arousal or fear-conditioning experiments.

neuroscience.name: Neural electrode interface electrochemistry
neuroscience.gist: Fit equivalent-circuit models to electrode impedance spectra, simulate electrode-tissue interfaces in circuit simulators, and compute charge-injection limits, polarization and thermal noise for recording and stimulation electrodes.

neuroscience.name: Closed-loop neuromodulation algorithms
neuroscience.gist: Design and evaluate real-time phase and amplitude estimators such as autoregressive forward prediction, and closed-loop stimulation controllers for adaptive DBS or phase-locked stimulation, scoring timing accuracy on recorded or simulated signals.

neuroscience.name: Optogenetic light propagation and photostimulation
neuroscience.gist: Simulate light transport in brain tissue with Monte Carlo photon scattering or diffusion models, compute irradiance volumes and tissue heating from fibre or LED sources, and model opsin photocurrent kinetics to plan stimulation protocols.

neuroscience.name: Episodic memory and free recall models
neuroscience.gist: Fit computational memory models such as the temporal context model, SAM or REM to free-recall and recognition data, reproducing serial-position, lag-CRP and confidence-ROC effects and comparing model variants.

neuroscience.name: Continuous-report working memory models
neuroscience.gist: Fit mixture models with guess and swap components, variable-precision and resource models to delayed-estimation errors on circular feature spaces, estimating capacity and precision as functions of set size.

neuroscience.name: Interval timing and temporal reproduction
neuroscience.gist: Model behavioural timing with scalar-variability, pacemaker-accumulator and Bayesian observer models, fitting peak-procedure, temporal bisection and interval-reproduction data to estimate Weber fractions and central-tendency biases.

neuroscience.name: Foraging and patch-leaving decision models
neuroscience.gist: Model patch-leaving and exploration-exploitation behaviour with marginal value theorem, foraging-value and Bayesian bandit models, and fit leaving times and choice sequences to estimate travel-time sensitivity and environmental-rate learning.

neuroscience.name: Rodent behavioural assay quantification
neuroscience.gist: Score standard rodent assays from tracking data, including water-maze search strategies, open-field and elevated-maze anxiety indices, freezing in fear conditioning and novel-object preference, with appropriate thresholds and group statistics.

ecology.name: Capture-recapture abundance estimation
ecology.gist: Estimate closed or open population size, survival and recruitment from individual encounter histories using Lincoln-Petersen, Huggins, Cormack-Jolly-Seber or Jolly-Seber likelihoods.

ecology.name: Spatially explicit capture-recapture density
ecology.gist: Fit SCR models to detections of individuals at trap, camera or hair-snare arrays to estimate animal density and home-range scale parameters.

ecology.name: Distance sampling density estimation
ecology.gist: Fit half-normal or hazard-rate detection functions to line- or point-transect distances, with covariates and truncation, to estimate density and its variance.

ecology.name: Site occupancy with imperfect detection
ecology.gist: Fit single-season, multi-season or multi-species occupancy models to repeated detection/non-detection surveys to separate occupancy from detection probability.

ecology.name: N-mixture models for repeated counts
ecology.gist: Estimate site abundance and detection probability from replicated unmarked point counts using binomial or Poisson N-mixture likelihoods.

ecology.name: Matrix population models and demography
ecology.gist: Build Leslie or Lefkovitch stage matrices from vital-rate data and compute growth rate, stable stage distribution, reproductive value, sensitivities and elasticities.

ecology.name: Integral projection models
ecology.gist: Fit size-dependent survival, growth and fecundity regressions and discretize them into an IPM kernel to project populations and analyze trait-dependent demography.

ecology.name: Population viability analysis
ecology.gist: Simulate stochastic population trajectories with environmental and demographic stochasticity, catastrophes and density dependence to estimate quasi-extinction risk.

ecology.name: Time-series models of population dynamics
ecology.gist: Fit Gompertz, Ricker or state-space models with process and observation error to abundance time series to infer density dependence and environmental drivers.

ecology.name: Population trend estimation from monitoring schemes
ecology.gist: Estimate annual indices and long-term trends from long-running count surveys with missing site-years using GAMs, log-linear models or TRIM-style imputation.

ecology.name: Predator-prey and consumer-resource dynamics
ecology.gist: Fit or simulate Lotka-Volterra, Rosenzweig-MacArthur and functional-response ODE models to interacting-species data and analyze stability and cycles.

ecology.name: Functional response estimation from feeding trials
ecology.gist: Fit Holling type II/III and predator-dependent functional responses to prey-depletion experiment data, accounting for depletion with Rogers random-predator equations.

ecology.name: Fisheries stock assessment
ecology.gist: Fit surplus-production, delay-difference or age-structured catch-at-age models to catch and survey-index data to estimate biomass, fishing mortality and reference points.

ecology.name: Harvest and wildlife management optimization
ecology.gist: Derive optimal harvest or culling policies under uncertainty via stochastic dynamic programming or management strategy evaluation on simulated populations.

ecology.name: Epidemiology of wildlife disease
ecology.gist: Fit or simulate SIR-type compartmental and host-pathogen models to wildlife surveillance prevalence data to estimate transmission and evaluate control.

ecology.name: Invasive species spread modelling
ecology.gist: Estimate spread rates and dispersal kernels from invasion records using reaction-diffusion, integrodifference or stratified-diffusion models and forecast range expansion.

ecology.name: Metapopulation and patch-occupancy dynamics
ecology.gist: Fit incidence-function or Levins-type models to patch occupancy histories in fragmented landscapes to estimate colonization, extinction and connectivity effects.

ecology.name: Species distribution modelling
ecology.gist: Relate presence-absence or presence-background records to environmental rasters with GLMs, GAMs, MaxEnt-style or boosted-tree models and map habitat suitability with spatial cross-validation.

ecology.name: Joint species distribution models
ecology.gist: Fit multivariate probit or latent-factor models to community presence-absence matrices to partition environmental responses from residual species associations.

ecology.name: Point-process models of species occurrence
ecology.gist: Fit inhomogeneous Poisson or log-Gaussian Cox processes to opportunistic occurrence points with sampling-bias covariates and integrate them with structured survey data.

ecology.name: Range shifts under climate change
ecology.gist: Quantify latitudinal or elevational shifts in species ranges or abundance-weighted centroids from repeated surveys and attribute them to warming trends.

ecology.name: Species richness, rarefaction and alpha diversity
ecology.gist: Compute rarefaction and extrapolation curves, Chao1/ACE/jackknife richness estimators, coverage-based standardization, and Shannon, Simpson and Hill-number diversity profiles with bias corrections and bootstrap confidence intervals across sites or treatments.

ecology.name: Beta diversity and turnover partitioning
ecology.gist: Partition compositional dissimilarity into turnover and nestedness components and relate it to environmental and geographic distance.

ecology.name: Multivariate community ordination
ecology.gist: Apply NMDS, PCA, CA, CCA and RDA to site-by-species abundance matrices with environmental covariates to describe and test community gradients.

ecology.name: Permutation tests on community composition
ecology.gist: Test treatment or gradient effects on multivariate community data with PERMANOVA, ANOSIM, Mantel tests and dispersion homogeneity tests.

ecology.name: Community classification and indicator species
ecology.gist: Cluster vegetation or faunal plots into community types and identify indicator or diagnostic species with IndVal-style statistics and fidelity measures.

ecology.name: Species abundance distributions
ecology.gist: Fit log-series, lognormal, broken-stick and neutral-model distributions to rank-abundance data and compare them by likelihood or information criteria.

ecology.name: Neutral and niche community assembly models
ecology.gist: Simulate Hubbell neutral, lottery and niche-based assembly models and estimate parameters such as immigration rate and speciation from observed communities.

ecology.name: Species-area and diversity scaling relationships
ecology.gist: Fit power-law, semi-log and nested species-area, endemics-area and distance-decay relationships to plot or island survey data.

ecology.name: Functional trait diversity
ecology.gist: Compute functional richness, evenness, divergence and community-weighted means from species trait matrices, handling mixed trait types via Gower distances.

ecology.name: Phylogenetic community structure
ecology.gist: Compute phylogenetic diversity, MPD and MNTD with null-model standardization to test for phylogenetic clustering or overdispersion in assemblages.

ecology.name: Null models for co-occurrence
ecology.gist: Test species co-occurrence and checkerboard patterns in presence-absence matrices against fixed-fixed or fixed-equiprobable randomization null models.

ecology.name: Ecological network analysis
ecology.gist: Compute nestedness, modularity, connectance and specialization of plant-pollinator, host-parasitoid or seed-dispersal interaction matrices against null models.

ecology.name: Food web structure and dynamics
ecology.gist: Build trophic networks from feeding-link data, compute trophic levels and omnivory, and simulate secondary extinctions or bioenergetic dynamics.

ecology.name: Stable isotope trophic analysis
ecology.gist: Estimate trophic positions, isotopic niche widths and diet proportions from delta13C/delta15N data with Bayesian mixing models and standard ellipse areas.

ecology.name: Animal movement track processing
ecology.gist: Clean, filter and regularize GPS or Argos telemetry fixes, removing outliers and handling fix-rate gaps and location error before analysis.

ecology.name: Behavioural state segmentation of tracks
ecology.gist: Fit hidden Markov models to step lengths and turning angles of telemetry data to infer latent behavioural states and their covariate dependence.

ecology.name: Home-range and utilization distribution estimation
ecology.gist: Estimate home ranges from relocations with MCP, kernel density, autocorrelated KDE and Brownian-bridge methods and quantify overlap between individuals.

ecology.name: Resource and step selection functions
ecology.gist: Fit used-versus-available logistic or conditional logistic step-selection models to telemetry and habitat rasters to quantify habitat preference.

ecology.name: Continuous-time movement models
ecology.gist: Fit Ornstein-Uhlenbeck and correlated-random-walk continuous-time models to irregularly sampled tracks to estimate speed, range crossing time and diffusion.

ecology.name: Migration timing and route analysis
ecology.gist: Detect departure, arrival and stopover events in migratory tracks or geolocator light-level data and estimate migration phenology and routes.

ecology.name: Landscape connectivity and resistance modelling
ecology.gist: Compute least-cost paths, circuit-theory current flow and graph-based connectivity metrics on resistance surfaces to identify corridors.

ecology.name: Landscape pattern metrics
ecology.gist: Compute patch-, class- and landscape-level fragmentation metrics from categorical land-cover rasters and relate them to species responses across scales.

ecology.name: Systematic conservation planning
ecology.gist: Select reserve networks meeting species representation targets at minimum cost with integer programming or simulated annealing, including connectivity penalties.

ecology.name: Camera-trap data analysis
ecology.gist: Process camera-trap detection tables into independent events, activity patterns and relative abundance indices, and estimate overlap of diel activity kernels.

ecology.name: Passive acoustic monitoring and soundscape indices
ecology.gist: Compute acoustic indices and detect target vocalizations in field audio recordings with spectrogram template matching or feature-based classifiers.

ecology.name: Environmental DNA and metabarcoding analysis
ecology.gist: Process OTU/ASV count tables from eDNA surveys with contamination filtering, rarefaction and occupancy models accounting for false positives.

ecology.name: Phenology modelling
ecology.gist: Model timing of flowering, leaf-out, emergence or breeding from long-term records with growing-degree-day, thermal-time and changepoint models.

ecology.name: Plant growth and forest stand dynamics
ecology.gist: Fit allometric biomass equations, diameter growth and mortality models to forest inventory plots and simulate stand development.

ecology.name: Spatial point pattern analysis of plants
ecology.gist: Analyze mapped stem locations with Ripley's K, pair-correlation and mark-correlation functions to test clustering, competition and spatial association.

ecology.name: Spatial autocorrelation in ecological data
ecology.gist: Diagnose and model spatial autocorrelation in survey residuals using variograms, Moran's I, eigenvector mapping and spatial GLMMs.

ecology.name: Mixed models for ecological field experiments
ecology.gist: Analyze nested, split-plot and repeated-measures field experiment data with GLMMs, handling overdispersion, zero inflation and random block effects.

ecology.name: Ecological meta-analysis
ecology.gist: Compute effect sizes such as log response ratios from published study summaries and fit random-effects and meta-regression models with heterogeneity and bias tests.

ecology.name: Biodiversity indicators from citizen science
ecology.gist: Derive occupancy trends and multispecies indicators from unstructured or semi-structured citizen-science records while correcting for observer effort and bias.

ecology.name: Ecological stoichiometry and nutrient budgets
ecology.gist: Model elemental ratios, consumer nutrient recycling and nutrient flux budgets for organisms and ecosystems using mass-balance calculations.

ecology.name: Ecosystem productivity and carbon flux
ecology.gist: Partition eddy-covariance or chamber CO2 flux data into GPP and respiration with light-response and temperature-respiration models after gap filling.

ecology.name: Remote sensing of vegetation and habitat
ecology.gist: Derive NDVI time series, land-cover classifications and vegetation change from multispectral raster data to characterize habitats and their dynamics.

ecology.name: Early warning signals of regime shifts
ecology.gist: Detect critical slowing down in ecological time series through rolling variance, autocorrelation and skewness trends and test them against surrogate data.

ecology.name: Individual-based population simulation
ecology.gist: Build agent-based simulations of individuals with movement, foraging, reproduction and mortality rules and calibrate emergent patterns to field data via pattern-oriented modelling.

ecology.name: Thermal performance curves
ecology.gist: Fit nonlinear thermal performance models such as Sharpe-Schoolfield, Briere or Gaussian-Gompertz to temperature-dependent rate data, and estimate optima, critical limits and warming tolerance.

ecology.name: Metabolic scaling and allometry
ecology.gist: Estimate body-mass and temperature scaling exponents of metabolic rate, abundance or life-history traits with log-log regression, standardized major axis and Arrhenius-Boltzmann models.

ecology.name: Dynamic energy budget modelling
ecology.gist: Parameterize and simulate DEB or bioenergetic models of individual growth, maturation and reproduction from food and temperature regimes, and fit them to growth and reproduction data.

ecology.name: Known-fate and nest survival analysis
ecology.gist: Estimate survival and cause-specific mortality from radio-tagged individuals or monitored nests with Kaplan-Meier, Cox, Mayfield, logistic-exposure and competing-risks models.

ecology.name: Individual growth curves and age estimation
ecology.gist: Fit von Bertalanffy, Gompertz, logistic or Richards growth models to length-at-age or mark-recapture growth increments with individual random effects and measurement error.

ecology.name: Optimal foraging and patch-use models
ecology.gist: Derive and test marginal value theorem, prey-choice and giving-up-density predictions against simulated or observed foraging data, and compute optimal diet and patch residence times.

ecology.name: Accelerometer biologging behaviour classification
ecology.gist: Segment and classify tri-axial accelerometer and magnetometer streams into behaviours, compute ODBA and VeDBA energy-expenditure proxies, and handle calibration and orientation.

ecology.name: Animal social network analysis
ecology.gist: Build association networks from co-occurrence or interaction data with gambit-of-the-group indices, then test social structure with data-stream permutations and node-level centrality.

ecology.name: Collective animal movement
ecology.gist: Quantify group polarization, cohesion, leadership and nearest-neighbour interactions from trajectory data of flocks, schools or herds, and fit or simulate self-propelled particle models.

ecology.name: Paleoecological proxy reconstruction
ecology.gist: Analyse sediment-core pollen, diatom or charcoal counts with age-depth models, zonation, ordination and transfer functions such as weighted averaging to reconstruct past vegetation and climate.

ecology.name: Dendroecology and tree-ring analysis
