ecology.gist: Crossdate, detrend and standardize ring-width series into chronologies, then compute climate-growth response functions, release events and basal area increment trends.

ecology.name: Fire and disturbance regime analysis
ecology.gist: Estimate fire return intervals, Weibull hazard models, severity distributions and disturbance-recovery trajectories from fire-scar records, burn histories or disturbance inventories.

ecology.name: Stream habitat and environmental flow ecology
ecology.gist: Relate fish or invertebrate habitat suitability to hydraulic variables and compute flow-regime indicators and habitat-flow relationships for environmental flow assessment.

ecology.name: Biotic indices for bioassessment
ecology.gist: Compute multimetric indices of biotic integrity, saprobic indices and observed/expected (RIVPACS-style) scores from macroinvertebrate, diatom or fish samples against reference conditions.

ecology.name: Niche overlap and hypervolume estimation
ecology.gist: Quantify species niche breadth and overlap in environmental space with kernel-density niche overlap (Schoener's D), n-dimensional hypervolumes and niche equivalency and similarity tests.

ecology.name: Island biogeography dynamics
ecology.gist: Fit equilibrium immigration-extinction models of island biogeography to island species lists or turnover surveys, and estimate area and isolation effects on colonization and extinction.

ecology.name: Macroecological gradients
ecology.gist: Analyse latitudinal and elevational diversity gradients, Bergmann's and Rapoport's rules, and range-size distributions across gridded assemblage data with spatially aware regression.

ecology.name: Empirical dynamic modelling
ecology.gist: Apply simplex projection, S-maps and convergent cross mapping to ecological time series to detect nonlinearity and chaos and to infer causal interactions between species and drivers.

ecology.name: Spatial population synchrony
ecology.gist: Quantify synchrony among spatially replicated population time series with correlation-distance functions, wavelet coherence and Moran-effect models, and attribute it to dispersal or climate.

ecology.name: Species coexistence and competition theory
ecology.gist: Fit Lotka-Volterra or annual-plant competition models to response-surface experiments, then compute niche and fitness differences, invasion growth rates and coexistence outcomes.

ecology.name: Community stability and random-matrix analysis
ecology.gist: Assess local stability, resilience, reactivity and structural stability of multispecies community matrices, and apply May-type random-matrix and feasibility-domain analyses.

ecology.name: Plankton and NPZ ecosystem models
ecology.gist: Simulate and calibrate nutrient-phytoplankton-zooplankton-detritus ODE or 1-D water-column models against chlorophyll, nutrient and plankton observations from lakes or oceans.

ecology.name: Litter decomposition and soil carbon dynamics
ecology.gist: Fit single-, double-exponential and asymptotic decay models to litterbag mass-loss data, and simulate multi-pool soil organic carbon models such as RothC or CENTURY.

ecology.name: Species sensitivity distributions and ecotoxicology
ecology.gist: Fit dose-response curves to toxicity tests and log-normal or log-logistic species sensitivity distributions to derive EC50s, NOECs, HC5 values and mixture-toxicity predictions.

ecology.name: Conservation genetics of populations
ecology.gist: Estimate effective population size, inbreeding, heterozygosity loss and genetic bottlenecks from microsatellite or SNP genotypes with linkage-disequilibrium and temporal methods.

ecology.name: Landscape genetics
ecology.gist: Relate pairwise genetic differentiation among sampled individuals or populations to geographic and landscape-resistance distances with isolation-by-distance, MLPE and causal-modelling approaches.

ecology.name: Biodiversity-ecosystem functioning analysis
ecology.gist: Partition net biodiversity effects into complementarity and selection components, and fit diversity-productivity and multifunctionality relationships from BEF experiment plot data.

ecology.name: Eco-evolutionary and adaptive dynamics
ecology.gist: Simulate trait evolution coupled to population dynamics with quantitative-genetic, adaptive dynamics or evolutionary game models, and find evolutionarily stable strategies and branching points.

ecology.name: Host-macroparasite aggregation and burden
ecology.gist: Fit negative binomial and zero-inflated distributions to parasite counts per host, estimate aggregation, prevalence and intensity, and simulate Anderson-May macroparasite models.

ecology.name: Seed dispersal kernels and seed bank dynamics
ecology.gist: Fit dispersal kernels to seed-trap or seedling data with inverse modelling, and estimate seed bank persistence, germination and seed-to-seedling transition rates.

ecology.name: Life tables and survivorship analysis
ecology.gist: Construct cohort and static life tables from age-at-death or census data, and compute survivorship curves, age-specific mortality hazards, net reproductive rate, generation time and life expectancy, with parametric Gompertz or Siler fits.

ecology.name: Multistate and multievent capture-recapture
ecology.gist: Fit Arnason-Schwarz, multistate and multievent models to encounter histories to estimate state-specific survival, movement between sites and transitions among breeding, disease or uncertain states.

ecology.name: Integrated population models
ecology.gist: Jointly fit count, capture-recapture and productivity data in a single population likelihood or Bayesian state-space model to estimate vital rates, including unobserved ones such as immigration.

ecology.name: Removal, depletion and double-observer sampling
ecology.gist: Estimate abundance and capture or detection probability from successive-removal electrofishing or trapping passes, catch-effort depletion and independent or dependent double-observer counts, using Zippin, Carle-Strub, Leslie and DeLury estimators.

ecology.name: Fisheries acoustics and echo integration
ecology.gist: Process echosounder volume-backscatter data with noise removal, bottom detection and thresholding, then convert echo-integrated NASC to fish density and biomass using target-strength-length relationships.

ecology.name: Biophysical ecology and heat-budget modelling
ecology.gist: Compute operative temperatures, body temperatures and water loss of organisms from radiation, convection and evaporation energy balances, and build mechanistic activity-window or distribution predictions from microclimate data.

ecology.name: Compositional analysis of microbial community data
ecology.gist: Analyse 16S or shotgun taxon count tables with log-ratio transforms, compositional differential-abundance tests, zero handling and correlation-network inference that accounts for the closed-sum constraint.

ecology.name: Ecological forecasting and data assimilation
ecology.gist: Produce iterative probabilistic forecasts of populations or ecosystem states with particle filters or ensemble Kalman filters, propagating parameter, driver and process uncertainty and scoring forecasts with proper scoring rules.

ecology.name: Simulation-based inference for ecological models
ecology.gist: Calibrate stochastic ecological simulators with intractable likelihoods using approximate Bayesian computation, synthetic likelihood or summary-statistic matching, and assess parameter identifiability.

ecology.name: Aquatic ecosystem metabolism from diel oxygen
ecology.gist: Estimate gross primary production, ecosystem respiration and reaeration in streams and lakes from high-frequency dissolved-oxygen, temperature and light sonde data with one- or two-station oxygen mass-balance models.

ecology.name: Ecohydrology and plant water use
ecology.gist: Model soil-water balance, plant water stress and transpiration from rainfall, soil moisture and sap-flow data with stochastic Rodriguez-Iturbe-type or bucket models, and link water availability to vegetation dynamics.

ecology.name: Vegetation pattern formation and self-organization
ecology.gist: Simulate and analyse Klausmeier, Rietkerk or scale-dependent-feedback reaction-diffusion models of banded and spotted vegetation, compute Turing instability conditions and compare spectral pattern statistics with imagery.

ecology.name: Ecological survey design and power analysis
ecology.gist: Design stratified, systematic, adaptive or rotating-panel monitoring schemes and compute by simulation the sample sizes and survey effort needed to detect trends, occupancy changes or treatment effects.

ecology.name: Plotless and vegetation cover sampling estimators
ecology.gist: Estimate plant density, cover, frequency and basal area from point-centred quarter, nearest-neighbour, line-intercept, point-intercept and variable-radius (Bitterlich) sampling, with design-based variance estimators.

ecology.name: Leaf gas exchange and photosynthesis models
ecology.gist: Fit Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry A-Ci curves, light-response curves and Ball-Berry or Medlyn stomatal conductance models to gas-exchange data to estimate Vcmax, Jmax, respiration and water-use efficiency.

ecology.name: Bioaccumulation and toxicokinetic modelling
ecology.gist: Fit one- and multi-compartment uptake-elimination models to tissue contaminant time courses to estimate BCF, BAF and depuration rates, and model trophic biomagnification factors through food webs.

ecology.name: Acoustic telemetry array analysis
ecology.gist: Process detections of tagged animals at passive receiver arrays: filter false detections, model detection range, compute residency and movement networks, and estimate fine-scale positions from time-difference-of-arrival.

ecology.name: Animal personality and behavioural repeatability
ecology.gist: Estimate repeatability, behavioural syndromes and individual plasticity from repeated behavioural assays with multivariate and random-regression mixed models, partitioning among- and within-individual variance.

ecology.name: Larval dispersal and Lagrangian connectivity
ecology.gist: Track virtual larvae or propagules through gridded ocean or river current fields with Lagrangian particle-tracking models including behaviour and mortality, and build connectivity matrices among habitat patches.

ecology.name: Ecosystem service mapping and modelling
ecology.gist: Quantify spatially explicit ecosystem services such as carbon storage, pollination supply, sediment retention and water yield from land-cover rasters with InVEST-style production-function models and evaluate land-use scenarios.

ecology.name: Spatial hotspot and cluster detection of ecological events
ecology.gist: Detect hotspots of roadkill, poaching, strandings or disease cases with kernel intensity, Getis-Ord statistics and spatial or space-time scan statistics, accounting for underlying exposure and multiple testing.

ecology.name: Length-frequency analysis and cohort decomposition
ecology.gist: Decompose length-frequency samples into age cohorts with finite mixture models or ELEFAN-type methods to estimate growth, recruitment pulses and total mortality from catch-curve analysis.

ecology.name: Diet composition and prey selectivity
ecology.gist: Quantify diet from stomach contents, scats or DNA diet data with frequency-of-occurrence, numeric and mass indices, and estimate prey selectivity with Ivlev, Chesson and resource-selection electivity indices versus availability.

ecology.name: Ecological threshold detection along gradients
ecology.gist: Identify community and species threshold responses to stressor gradients with segmented regression, TITAN-style indicator change-point analysis, gradient forests and nonparametric change-point methods.

ecology.name: Environmental impact assessment with BACI designs
ecology.gist: Evaluate anthropogenic or restoration impacts with before-after-control-impact and beyond-BACI designs using mixed models for asymmetrical controls, temporal autocorrelation and the power to detect impacts.

ecology.name: Structural equation modelling in ecology
ecology.gist: Fit covariance-based and piecewise structural equation and path models to observational ecological data to test causal hypotheses about direct and indirect effects, including d-separation tests and latent variables.

ecology.name: Community size spectra
ecology.gist: Estimate size-spectrum slopes and biomass-size distributions from plankton, benthic or fish survey data with bounded power-law maximum likelihood, and simulate size-based multispecies community models.

ecology.name: Canopy structure and light environment
ecology.gist: Derive leaf area index, gap fraction and canopy openness from hemispherical photographs or transmittance data using Beer-Lambert inversion, and compute canopy height and structure metrics from LiDAR point clouds.

ecology.name: Insect pest population and outbreak dynamics
ecology.gist: Model insect pest outbreaks with temperature-driven stage-structured development, Nicholson-Bailey host-parasitoid dynamics and spruce-budworm-type bistable models, and forecast outbreak timing from trap-count data.

ecology.name: Respirometry and individual metabolic rate estimation
ecology.gist: Process intermittent-flow or closed respirometry oxygen traces to estimate standard and maximum metabolic rates, aerobic scope and excess post-exercise oxygen consumption, with background correction and slope-quality filtering.

mechanical-engineering.name: Experimental modal analysis from FRFs
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate natural frequencies, damping ratios and mode shapes from measured frequency response functions or impulse-hammer data using curve-fitting methods such as rational fraction polynomials or PolyMAX.

mechanical-engineering.name: Operational modal analysis of structures
mechanical-engineering.gist: Identify modal parameters from ambient, output-only vibration records of bridges, towers or machines via stochastic subspace identification or frequency-domain decomposition.

mechanical-engineering.name: Rotating machinery vibration diagnostics
mechanical-engineering.gist: Detect unbalance, misalignment, looseness or rub in shafts from accelerometer and proximity-probe signals using order tracking, orbit analysis and spectral features.

mechanical-engineering.name: Gearbox condition monitoring
mechanical-engineering.gist: Analyse gear-mesh vibration with time-synchronous averaging, sideband analysis and residual signals to detect tooth cracks, pitting and wear.

mechanical-engineering.name: Rotordynamics and critical speeds
mechanical-engineering.gist: Build finite-element rotor-bearing models with gyroscopic and bearing-stiffness effects to compute Campbell diagrams, critical speeds, stability margins and unbalance response.

mechanical-engineering.name: Tuned mass dampers and vibration isolation
mechanical-engineering.gist: Design and optimize passive absorbers, isolators and damping treatments to meet transmissibility or response specifications under harmonic, random or seismic excitation.

mechanical-engineering.name: Random vibration and fatigue under spectra
mechanical-engineering.gist: Propagate PSD loads through structural transfer functions and estimate RMS response and spectral fatigue damage using Dirlik, Narrow-band or rainflow-equivalent methods.

mechanical-engineering.name: Nonlinear oscillator dynamics
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate and analyse systems with Duffing, friction, clearance or impact nonlinearities using harmonic balance, numerical continuation, bifurcation diagrams and Poincaré maps.

mechanical-engineering.name: Finite element linear structural analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Assemble and solve beam, frame, plate or solid finite-element models for stresses, deflections and reactions, including mesh convergence and verification against analytical solutions.

mechanical-engineering.name: Structural buckling and stability
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute linear eigenvalue buckling loads, imperfection sensitivity and nonlinear post-buckling paths with arc-length methods for columns, shells and stiffened panels.

mechanical-engineering.name: Composite laminate analysis and design
mechanical-engineering.gist: Apply classical lamination theory and failure criteria such as Tsai-Wu, Hashin or Puck to compute ply stresses and optimize stacking sequences for stiffness, strength and weight.

mechanical-engineering.name: Fatigue life prediction of components
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate crack initiation life from load histories using rainflow counting, S-N and strain-life curves, mean-stress corrections and Miner's rule damage accumulation.

mechanical-engineering.name: Fracture mechanics and crack growth
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute stress intensity factors and integrate Paris-law or NASGRO crack growth under variable-amplitude loading for damage-tolerance and inspection-interval assessment.

mechanical-engineering.name: Structural health monitoring damage detection
mechanical-engineering.gist: Detect and localize damage in structures from changes in modal properties, guided-wave signals or strain data using statistical novelty detection and damage indices.

mechanical-engineering.name: Finite element model updating
mechanical-engineering.gist: Calibrate stiffness, mass and boundary-condition parameters of structural models to match measured modal or static data via sensitivity-based or Bayesian updating.

mechanical-engineering.name: Structural topology and shape optimization
mechanical-engineering.gist: Optimize material layout or geometry of structures for compliance, frequency or stress objectives using SIMP, level-set or parametric shape optimization.

mechanical-engineering.name: Constitutive modeling of engineering materials
mechanical-engineering.gist: Fit plasticity, viscoelastic, hyperelastic or creep constitutive models to tensile, relaxation or cyclic test data and implement return-mapping integration.

mechanical-engineering.name: Strain gauge and DIC data reduction
mechanical-engineering.gist: Convert strain-rosette or digital image correlation measurements into principal strains, stress fields and material properties, with temperature compensation and error analysis.

mechanical-engineering.name: Aircraft flight dynamics and stability
mechanical-engineering.gist: Trim and linearize six-degree-of-freedom aircraft models from aerodynamic derivative tables and analyse longitudinal and lateral-directional modes and handling qualities.

mechanical-engineering.name: Aircraft system identification from flight tests
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate stability and control derivatives from flight-test maneuver data with equation-error, output-error or filter-error methods in time or frequency domain.

mechanical-engineering.name: Aircraft performance and mission analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute range, endurance, climb, takeoff and landing performance and fuel burn over mission profiles from drag polars, engine decks and standard atmosphere models.

mechanical-engineering.name: Aircraft conceptual sizing and design
mechanical-engineering.gist: Perform constraint analysis and weight-estimation iteration to size wing loading, thrust-to-weight and geometry of fixed-wing or eVTOL aircraft for given requirements.

mechanical-engineering.name: Potential-flow and panel-method aerodynamics
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute lift, induced drag and pressure distributions on airfoils and wings using vortex-lattice, lifting-line and panel methods with viscous corrections.

mechanical-engineering.name: Aeroelastic flutter and divergence analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Couple structural modes with unsteady aerodynamics to predict flutter speed, divergence and limit-cycle oscillations via p-k methods or time-domain simulation.

mechanical-engineering.name: Wind tunnel data reduction and corrections
mechanical-engineering.gist: Process balance and pressure-tap measurements into aerodynamic coefficients with blockage, wall-interference and tare corrections, and quantify uncertainty.

mechanical-engineering.name: Compressible flow and nozzle analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Analyse isentropic, shock and expansion flows, quasi-1D nozzles and inlets for mass flow, thrust and shock positions under varying back pressure.

mechanical-engineering.name: Gas turbine cycle and performance modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Build on- and off-design thermodynamic models of turbojet, turbofan or turboshaft engines with component maps to compute thrust, specific fuel consumption and matching.

mechanical-engineering.name: Turbomachinery meanline design
mechanical-engineering.gist: Design and evaluate compressor, turbine, fan or pump stages from velocity triangles and loss correlations to predict efficiency, pressure ratio and operating maps.

mechanical-engineering.name: Rocket propulsion and trajectory performance
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model chemical rocket engine performance, staging and ascent trajectories with drag and gravity losses to compute payload capability, burn profiles and propellant budgets.

mechanical-engineering.name: Orbital mechanics and maneuver planning
mechanical-engineering.gist: Propagate perturbed orbits and design transfers, rendezvous and station-keeping maneuvers using Lambert solvers, J2 perturbations and delta-v optimization.

mechanical-engineering.name: Spacecraft attitude determination and control
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate spacecraft attitude from star tracker, sun sensor and gyro data with quaternion filters, and design control laws for reaction wheels, thrusters or magnetorquers.

mechanical-engineering.name: Spacecraft thermal analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Build lumped-node radiative and conductive thermal network models of spacecraft with orbital heating to predict temperature ranges and size heaters and radiators.

mechanical-engineering.name: Incompressible CFD of internal and external flows
mechanical-engineering.gist: Solve laminar or RANS flows in ducts, cavities and around bluff bodies with finite-volume or finite-difference codes, including grid convergence and validation.

mechanical-engineering.name: Turbulence statistics from flow measurements
mechanical-engineering.gist: Process hot-wire, LDV or PIV data into mean profiles, Reynolds stresses, spectra and integral length scales, and fit wall-law or wake parameters.

mechanical-engineering.name: Pipe network and hydraulic system analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Solve flow and pressure distributions in piping, ducting or hydraulic circuits with friction and minor-loss correlations, including pump matching and water-hammer transients.

mechanical-engineering.name: Heat exchanger design and rating
mechanical-engineering.gist: Size or rate shell-and-tube, plate-fin and compact heat exchangers with effectiveness-NTU or LMTD methods, pressure-drop correlations and cost or weight optimization.

mechanical-engineering.name: Transient conduction and thermal modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate transient and multidimensional conduction in components with finite-difference or finite-element methods, including inverse estimation of heat flux or properties from thermocouple data.

mechanical-engineering.name: Electronics cooling and thermal management
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model heat sinks, cold plates, heat pipes and thermal resistance networks to keep junction temperatures within limits under given power and airflow conditions.

mechanical-engineering.name: Refrigeration and HVAC thermodynamic cycles
mechanical-engineering.gist: Analyse vapor-compression, heat-pump and air-handling systems with real-fluid property models to compute COP, capacity and component sizing across operating conditions.

mechanical-engineering.name: Power cycle and combined heat-power analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model Rankine, Brayton, organic Rankine and combined cycles with exergy analysis to evaluate and optimize efficiency, net output and part-load behavior.

mechanical-engineering.name: Internal combustion engine cycle analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Process in-cylinder pressure traces to compute heat release, indicated work and combustion phasing, or simulate engine cycles with Wiebe and heat-transfer models.

mechanical-engineering.name: Combustion chemical kinetics and flames
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate ignition delay, laminar flame speed and reactor behavior with detailed or reduced kinetic mechanisms, and perform mechanism reduction or sensitivity analysis.

mechanical-engineering.name: Battery thermal and electrochemical modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Fit equivalent-circuit or reduced electrochemical cell models to cycling data and simulate pack temperature, state of charge and aging under drive or duty cycles.

mechanical-engineering.name: Linear feedback controller design
mechanical-engineering.gist: Design PID, lead-lag or loop-shaping controllers for mechanical plants to meet bandwidth, overshoot and stability-margin specifications, verified by frequency- and time-domain analysis.

mechanical-engineering.name: State-space optimal and robust control
mechanical-engineering.gist: Synthesize LQR, LQG, H-infinity or mu controllers for multivariable mechanical and aerospace plants, including uncertainty modeling and robustness verification.

mechanical-engineering.name: Model predictive control of mechanical systems
mechanical-engineering.gist: Formulate and solve constrained linear or nonlinear MPC problems for vehicles, actuators or thermal systems and assess tracking, constraint satisfaction and computation cost.

mechanical-engineering.name: System identification of dynamic plants
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate transfer-function, ARX or state-space models of motors, actuators and structures from input-output test data, with model order selection and validation.

mechanical-engineering.name: State estimation and sensor fusion
mechanical-engineering.gist: Fuse IMU, GNSS, encoder and other sensor data with extended, unscented or error-state Kalman filters to estimate vehicle pose, velocity and sensor biases.

mechanical-engineering.name: Servo and motion control systems
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model and tune motor-drive and electromechanical actuator loops with friction, backlash and resonance compensation, input shaping and feedforward for precision positioning.

mechanical-engineering.name: Fault detection in dynamic systems
mechanical-engineering.gist: Detect and isolate actuator, sensor and component faults in mechanical and aerospace systems with observer-based residuals, parity relations and statistical change detection.

mechanical-engineering.name: Robot kinematics and geometric modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Position, velocity and accuracy analysis of serial, parallel, redundant and mobile-base mechanisms. Covers closed-form and numerical inverse solutions, Jacobians and singularity analysis, manipulability and workspace mapping, redundancy resolution, tool-frame and kinematic-parameter identification from measurement data, and accuracy or error-budget evaluation.

mechanical-engineering.name: Robot dynamics identification and control
mechanical-engineering.gist: Identify inertial and friction parameters of manipulators from joint torque and trajectory data and design computed-torque, impedance or adaptive controllers.

mechanical-engineering.name: Motion planning and trajectory optimization
mechanical-engineering.gist: Plan collision-free paths and time-optimal or minimum-energy trajectories for manipulators, mobile robots or drones with sampling-based planners and direct collocation.

mechanical-engineering.name: Mobile robot localization and mapping
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate robot trajectories and build maps from odometry, range or landmark measurements using particle filters, scan matching and pose-graph optimization.

mechanical-engineering.name: Multibody dynamics simulation
mechanical-engineering.gist: Formulate and integrate constrained equations of motion for linkages, mechanisms and vehicles with contact and joints, checking energy and constraint drift.

mechanical-engineering.name: Vehicle dynamics and suspension modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate ride and handling of road vehicles with quarter-car, bicycle and tire models to evaluate comfort, stability and suspension or steering design.

mechanical-engineering.name: Material removal process mechanics
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model and analyse the physics of subtractive manufacturing processes such as turning, milling, drilling, grinding, abrasive and nontraditional machining (EDM, ECM, laser, waterjet). Tasks cover cutting and thrust force models, chip formation and shear-plane mechanics, cutting-zone temperatures, tool wear and tool life (Taylor-type) fitting, surface roughness and surface integrity prediction, material removal rate and energy, and dynamic process stability. Work spans calibrating mechanistic coefficients from force or wear measurements, simulating process dynamics, and optimizing cutting parameters against cost, quality or stability constraints.

mechanical-engineering.name: Manufacturing metrology and tolerance analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Evaluate form and position deviations from coordinate-measurement point clouds, fit geometric features, and perform worst-case and statistical tolerance stack-ups.

mechanical-engineering.name: Additive manufacturing process modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate thermal histories, melt-pool dimensions, residual stress and distortion in powder-bed or directed-energy deposition builds and relate process parameters to defects.

mechanical-engineering.name: Hydrodynamic lubrication and fluid-film bearings
mechanical-engineering.gist: Solve the Reynolds equation for journal, thrust and squeeze-film bearings to compute pressure fields, load capacity, friction, eccentricity and dynamic stiffness and damping coefficients.

mechanical-engineering.name: Contact mechanics, friction and wear
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute Hertzian and non-Hertzian contact pressures, subsurface stresses and rough-surface contact, and fit friction and Archard-type wear models to tribometer data.

mechanical-engineering.name: Machine element design and sizing
mechanical-engineering.gist: Size shafts, bolted joints, springs, keys, gears and welds against static and fatigue strength criteria from design standards, and optimize them for mass or safety factor.

mechanical-engineering.name: Linkage and cam mechanism synthesis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Synthesize four-bar and multi-bar linkages for function, path or motion generation, and design cam profiles and follower motion laws subject to pressure-angle and curvature constraints.

mechanical-engineering.name: Pressure vessel and piping stress assessment
mechanical-engineering.gist: Evaluate thick- and thin-walled vessels, nozzles and piping under pressure, thermal and sustained loads with stress classification, flexibility analysis and code allowables.

mechanical-engineering.name: Impact, crashworthiness and explicit dynamics
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate high-rate impact, energy absorption and crushing of structures with explicit time integration and strain-rate-dependent material models, and evaluate occupant or payload deceleration metrics.

mechanical-engineering.name: Acoustics and noise control engineering
mechanical-engineering.gist: Predict sound transmission loss, muffler and duct attenuation, enclosure and barrier performance and structure-borne radiation using transfer-matrix, modal and statistical energy methods.

mechanical-engineering.name: Aeroacoustic noise prediction
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate jet, fan, propeller and airframe noise with acoustic analogies and semi-empirical models, and process microphone-array data with beamforming for source localization.

mechanical-engineering.name: Structural reliability analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute failure probabilities and reliability indices for limit-state functions with FORM, SORM, importance sampling and subset simulation, and perform reliability-based design.

mechanical-engineering.name: Uncertainty quantification and surrogate modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Propagate parametric uncertainty through engineering simulations with polynomial chaos, Gaussian-process or Kriging surrogates and compute Sobol sensitivity indices from designed computer experiments.

mechanical-engineering.name: Prognostics and remaining useful life estimation
mechanical-engineering.gist: Build degradation models from run-to-failure sensor data of engines, bearings or batteries and estimate remaining useful life with particle filters, health indices or data-driven regressors.

mechanical-engineering.name: Wind turbine rotor aerodynamics and loads
mechanical-engineering.gist: Apply blade-element momentum theory with tip-loss, dynamic-inflow and stall corrections to compute power curves, thrust and blade loads, and design blade chord and twist distributions.

mechanical-engineering.name: Propeller and rotorcraft performance
mechanical-engineering.gist: Analyse propellers and helicopter or multirotor rotors with momentum, blade-element and vortex-wake models to predict thrust, power, figure of merit and forward-flight trim.

mechanical-engineering.name: Hypersonic and atmospheric entry aerothermodynamics
mechanical-engineering.gist: Predict entry trajectories, stagnation-point heating, Newtonian surface pressures and thermal protection system sizing for capsules and lifting bodies entering planetary atmospheres.

mechanical-engineering.name: Missile and interceptor guidance
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate engagement kinematics and design proportional-navigation, optimal or sliding-mode guidance laws, evaluating miss distance under seeker noise, lag and target maneuvers.

mechanical-engineering.name: Multirotor UAV dynamics and flight control
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model quadrotor and multirotor rigid-body dynamics with motor and rotor aerodynamics, and design attitude and position controllers, control allocation and disturbance rejection.

mechanical-engineering.name: Boundary layer and viscous flow analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute laminar and turbulent boundary layers with similarity solutions, integral methods and marching schemes, and predict skin friction, separation and transition via stability or e^N methods.

mechanical-engineering.name: Reduced-order modeling of fluid flows
mechanical-engineering.gist: Extract coherent structures and low-dimensional dynamics from flow snapshots with proper orthogonal decomposition, dynamic mode decomposition and Galerkin or sparse-regression models.

mechanical-engineering.name: Multiphase and free-surface flow simulation
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate bubbles, droplets, sloshing and free-surface flows with volume-of-fluid, level-set or lattice-Boltzmann methods, and analyse interface dynamics and phase-averaged quantities.

mechanical-engineering.name: Flow-induced vibration
mechanical-engineering.gist: Predict vortex-induced vibration, galloping and fluid-elastic instability of cylinders, cables and tube bundles with wake-oscillator and empirical models, and analyse lock-in from response records.

mechanical-engineering.name: Thermal radiation heat transfer
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute view factors and solve radiosity networks for enclosures with diffuse, specular or spectrally selective surfaces, including participating-media radiation via Monte Carlo ray tracing.

mechanical-engineering.name: Boiling, condensation and two-phase heat transfer
mechanical-engineering.gist: Apply pool and flow-boiling, critical heat flux and condensation correlations to predict heat transfer coefficients, pressure drop and dryout in evaporators, condensers and cooling channels.

mechanical-engineering.name: Solidification and phase-change modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Solve Stefan and enthalpy-method problems for casting solidification, freezing and phase-change thermal storage to predict solidification fronts, cooling curves and shrinkage-prone regions.

mechanical-engineering.name: Metal forming process analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model sheet and bulk forming such as deep drawing, bending, rolling and extrusion with slab, upper-bound or finite-element methods to predict forces, springback and forming-limit failure.

mechanical-engineering.name: Statistical process control and quality engineering
mechanical-engineering.gist: Analyse manufacturing measurements with control charts, process capability indices, gauge R&R and designed experiments to detect process shifts and identify factors that drive quality.

mechanical-engineering.name: Production scheduling and manufacturing system modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model job-shop, flow-shop and assembly lines with discrete-event simulation, queueing models and constraint or integer programming to optimize throughput, makespan and buffer sizes.

mechanical-engineering.name: CNC toolpath generation and machining planning
mechanical-engineering.gist: Generate and analyse G-code toolpaths for milling and turning, including feed-rate scheduling, interpolation, scallop-height control and kinematic limits of multi-axis machines.

mechanical-engineering.name: Human biomechanics and musculoskeletal modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute joint kinematics, kinetics and muscle forces from motion-capture and force-plate data with inverse dynamics and static optimization for gait, sports or ergonomics analysis.

mechanical-engineering.name: Vehicle powertrain and energy management
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate electric, hybrid and conventional powertrains over drive cycles with efficiency maps to compute energy consumption and range, and optimize energy-management strategies.

mechanical-engineering.name: Marine hydrodynamics and seakeeping
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate ship and offshore-structure resistance, propulsion, wave-induced motions and response amplitude operators with strip theory, Morison loading and spectral sea-state analysis.

mechanical-engineering.name: Ultrasonic nondestructive evaluation
mechanical-engineering.gist: Process ultrasonic A-scan, B-scan and phased-array data with time-of-flight, synthetic aperture and total focusing methods to size flaws, measure thickness and compute dispersion curves in plates and welds.

mechanical-engineering.name: Shock response spectrum and transient shock analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute shock response spectra, pseudo-velocity and equivalent pulses from pyroshock, drop and transient acceleration records, and synthesize or qualify test inputs against SRS specifications.

mechanical-engineering.name: Piezoelectric transducers and energy harvesting
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model electromechanically coupled piezoelectric beams, stacks and patches for sensing, actuation, shunt damping or vibration energy harvesting, and optimize load impedance and geometry for power output.

mechanical-engineering.name: Thin-walled beam section analysis
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute section properties, shear flow, shear center, torsion constants and warping functions for open, closed and multicell thin-walled sections of wings, fuselages and frames, including restrained-warping torsion.

mechanical-engineering.name: Thermal stress and thermoelasticity
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute stresses and distortions caused by temperature fields in disks, cylinders, plates, bonded joints and assemblies with analytical thermoelastic solutions or coupled thermal-structural finite elements.

mechanical-engineering.name: Convective heat transfer in channels and enclosures
mechanical-engineering.gist: Predict forced, natural and mixed convection Nusselt numbers in ducts, fins, cavities and over surfaces from correlations, similarity solutions or numerical simulation, including conjugate heat transfer and fitting correlations to test data.

mechanical-engineering.name: Microfluidics and low-Reynolds-number flow
mechanical-engineering.gist: Analyse Stokes and creeping flows, electroosmotic transport, mixing and droplet generation in microchannels with lubrication theory, hydraulic-resistance networks and numerical solvers.

mechanical-engineering.name: Porous media flow and heat transfer
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model Darcy, Forchheimer and Brinkman flow and heat transfer in packed beds, filters, foams and wicks, estimate permeability and effective conductivity, and simulate thermal non-equilibrium.

mechanical-engineering.name: Rheology and non-Newtonian flow
mechanical-engineering.gist: Fit power-law, Carreau, Herschel-Bulkley and viscoelastic constitutive models to rheometer data and compute pressure drops, velocity profiles and flow curves for non-Newtonian fluids in pipes, slits and processing equipment.

mechanical-engineering.name: Compressible CFD and shock-capturing schemes
mechanical-engineering.gist: Solve the Euler and compressible Navier-Stokes equations with finite-volume Godunov, Roe, HLLC and MUSCL schemes for shock tubes, nozzles and supersonic flows, verifying against exact Riemann solutions and assessing order of accuracy.

mechanical-engineering.name: Particle-laden and spray flows
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate Lagrangian particle and droplet transport with drag, lift, evaporation and wall deposition, and analyse spray size distributions, separator efficiency and erosion in gas-solid and gas-liquid flows.

mechanical-engineering.name: Discrete element modeling of granular materials
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate granular flows in hoppers, mills, chutes and packings with soft-sphere DEM contact laws, calibrate contact parameters to bulk tests and extract flow rates, stresses and segregation.

mechanical-engineering.name: Orbit determination from tracking data
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate spacecraft orbits from range, Doppler, angles or GNSS measurements with batch least squares and sequential filters, propagate covariance and assess conjunction collision probability.

mechanical-engineering.name: Aircraft gust and maneuver loads
mechanical-engineering.gist: Compute V-n diagrams, discrete 1-cosine and continuous von Karman gust responses, and maneuver and landing loads of flexible aircraft to derive wing shear, bending and torsion load envelopes.

mechanical-engineering.name: Legged locomotion and balance control
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model biped and quadruped robots with inverted-pendulum, ZMP and centroidal dynamics, and generate gaits and balance controllers evaluated for stability, foot forces and energy cost.

mechanical-engineering.name: Camera and hand-eye calibration for robotics
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate camera intrinsics, lens distortion, extrinsics and hand-eye transforms from calibration-target images or point correspondences with PnP, bundle adjustment and AX=XB solvers.

mechanical-engineering.name: Continuum and soft robot modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model tendon-driven, concentric-tube and pneumatic soft robots with constant-curvature, Cosserat-rod or finite-element formulations to compute shape, workspace and stiffness and solve their inverse kinematics.

mechanical-engineering.name: Multi-agent formation and consensus control
mechanical-engineering.gist: Design and simulate consensus, formation-keeping, flocking and cooperative control laws for teams of robots, drones or spacecraft over communication graphs, analysing convergence and robustness to delays and link loss.

mechanical-engineering.name: Adaptive and learning control
mechanical-engineering.gist: Design model-reference adaptive, self-tuning, iterative learning and repetitive controllers for mechanical plants with uncertain or periodic dynamics, and evaluate parameter convergence and tracking improvement.

mechanical-engineering.name: Nonlinear control design
mechanical-engineering.gist: Design feedback-linearization, backstepping, sliding-mode and Lyapunov-based controllers for nonlinear mechanical systems such as pendulums, cranes and underactuated vehicles, verifying stability regions and chattering behavior.

mechanical-engineering.name: Welding process thermal and distortion modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Simulate weld thermal cycles with Rosenthal and Goldak heat sources, predict fusion-zone size, cooling rates, residual stresses and distortion, and relate welding parameters to joint quality.

mechanical-engineering.name: Polymer processing and injection molding
mechanical-engineering.gist: Model mold filling with Hele-Shaw flow, cooling time, packing, shrinkage and warpage, as well as extrusion screw throughput, from polymer rheology and thermal properties.

mechanical-engineering.name: Surface texture and roughness metrology
mechanical-engineering.gist: Process profilometer and areal surface measurements with form removal, Gaussian and robust filtering, and compute roughness, waviness, bearing-area and PSD-based texture parameters according to ISO standards.

mechanical-engineering.name: Machine tool geometric and thermal error modeling
mechanical-engineering.gist: Build volumetric error models of multi-axis machine tools from laser-interferometer, ballbar or touch-probe data using homogeneous transforms, and identify and compensate geometric and thermally induced errors.

mechanical-engineering.name: Reliability data analysis and maintenance optimization
mechanical-engineering.gist: Fit Weibull, lognormal and repairable-system models to failure and censored life data, evaluate fault trees and reliability block diagrams, and optimize preventive maintenance and spares policies.

mechanical-engineering.name: Multidisciplinary design optimization
mechanical-engineering.gist: Formulate coupled aero-structural, thermal or propulsion design problems with MDF, IDF or collaborative architectures, compute coupled sensitivities, and solve them with gradient-based or multi-objective optimizers.

mechanical-engineering.name: Gear geometry and transmission error
mechanical-engineering.gist: Generate involute and modified tooth profiles, compute contact ratio, mesh stiffness, tooth contact patterns and static transmission error, and design profile or lead modifications to reduce gear whine.

mechanical-engineering.name: Bladed disk vibration and mistuning
mechanical-engineering.gist: Analyse cyclic-symmetric bladed disks with nodal-diameter modes, Campbell and ZZENF interference diagrams, and statistical mistuning amplification using reduced-order lumped or component-mode models.

mechanical-engineering.name: Micromechanics and homogenization of heterogeneous materials
mechanical-engineering.gist: Estimate effective elastic, thermal and strength properties of fiber, particle and porous composites with rule-of-mixtures, Halpin-Tsai, Mori-Tanaka and periodic RVE finite-element homogenization.

mechanical-engineering.name: Dynamic load and force identification
mechanical-engineering.gist: Reconstruct unknown input forces, impacts or distributed loads on structures from measured accelerations or strains by regularized deconvolution, inverse FRF methods and Kalman-type input estimators.

electrical-engineering.name: Active and passive analog filter synthesis
electrical-engineering.gist: Realize Butterworth, Chebyshev, elliptic or Bessel responses as LC ladders or Sallen-Key/MFB stages with standard-value components, then verify magnitude, group delay and component sensitivity by netlist simulation.

electrical-engineering.name: Op-amp loop stability and compensation
electrical-engineering.gist: Analyze loop gain, phase margin and step ringing of amplifier, regulator or feedback circuits from macromodels or Bode data, and design Miller, lead or snubber compensation to meet stability specs.

electrical-engineering.name: Semiconductor device model parameter extraction
electrical-engineering.gist: Fit diode, BJT or MOSFET compact-model parameters (saturation current, ideality, threshold, mobility, series resistance) to measured I-V and C-V curves, with temperature dependence and fit-quality checks.

electrical-engineering.name: Noise analysis of analog front ends
electrical-engineering.gist: Compute input-referred noise spectra, integrated noise and SNR for amplifier, transimpedance or sensor-readout chains from device noise models, and estimate 1/f corners from measured spectra.

electrical-engineering.name: ADC and DAC dynamic characterization
electrical-engineering.gist: Derive SNR, SINAD, SFDR, ENOB, INL and DNL from sine-wave or histogram test captures of data converters, handling coherent sampling, windowing and missing codes.

electrical-engineering.name: Delta-sigma modulator design
electrical-engineering.gist: Choose noise-transfer functions, loop order and coefficients for discrete- or continuous-time delta-sigma modulators, then simulate bitstreams to check SQNR, stability and idle tones.

electrical-engineering.name: Phase-locked loop and clock jitter analysis
electrical-engineering.gist: Model charge-pump or digital PLL loop dynamics, predict phase-noise transfer and lock time, and extract random and deterministic jitter components from timing-error records.

electrical-engineering.name: Monte Carlo and corner yield analysis
electrical-engineering.gist: Propagate component tolerances, mismatch and temperature corners through circuit simulations to estimate parametric yield, worst-case performance and the dominant sensitivities.

electrical-engineering.name: Switched-mode power converter simulation
electrical-engineering.gist: Simulate buck, boost, flyback or resonant converters with ngspice or averaged models to size magnetics and capacitors, predict ripple and efficiency, and verify control-loop and transient behaviour.

electrical-engineering.name: Battery equivalent-circuit modeling and SOC estimation
electrical-engineering.gist: Identify RC-network battery models from pulse-discharge and drive-cycle data and estimate state of charge and health with observers, coulomb counting or filtering.

electrical-engineering.name: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy circuit fitting
electrical-engineering.gist: Fit equivalent circuits with constant-phase elements and Warburg terms to impedance spectra of cells, sensors or coatings, checking Kramers-Kronig consistency and parameter identifiability.

electrical-engineering.name: Signal integrity of high-speed interconnects
electrical-engineering.gist: Analyze transmission-line reflections, crosstalk, insertion loss and eye diagrams for PCB or cable links from TDR traces or touchstone files, and design equalization or termination.

electrical-engineering.name: Sensor bridge and transducer calibration
electrical-engineering.gist: Build calibration models for thermistors, RTDs, strain-gauge bridges, thermocouples or load cells, including nonlinearity, temperature compensation and uncertainty budgets from reference measurements.

electrical-engineering.name: FIR and IIR digital filter design
electrical-engineering.gist: Design digital filters to passband/stopband, phase or group-delay specifications by windowing, Parks-McClellan, least squares or bilinear transformation, and verify them on test signals.

electrical-engineering.name: Time-frequency analysis of nonstationary signals
electrical-engineering.gist: Apply STFT, wavelets, Wigner-Ville or synchrosqueezing to vibration, chirp or transient recordings to track instantaneous frequency and localize events.

electrical-engineering.name: Multirate processing and sample-rate conversion
electrical-engineering.gist: Design decimators, interpolators, polyphase filter banks and fractional resamplers, quantifying aliasing, imaging and computational cost on sampled data streams.

electrical-engineering.name: Adaptive filtering and echo cancellation
electrical-engineering.gist: Implement LMS, NLMS, RLS or frequency-domain adaptive filters for system identification, interference or echo cancellation, and evaluate convergence and misadjustment on recorded signals.

electrical-engineering.name: Sensor array direction-of-arrival estimation
electrical-engineering.gist: Estimate source bearings from multichannel array snapshots with beamforming, MUSIC, ESPRIT or sparse methods, handling calibration errors, coherent sources and limited snapshots.

electrical-engineering.name: Sparse recovery and compressed sensing
electrical-engineering.gist: Reconstruct sparse or compressible signals from undersampled or random measurements with L1 minimization, OMP or iterative thresholding, and characterize recovery against sparsity and noise.

electrical-engineering.name: FMCW and pulse-Doppler radar processing
electrical-engineering.gist: Turn raw radar ADC cubes into range-Doppler maps with pulse compression, windowing, MTI and CFAR detection, and estimate target range, velocity and angle.

electrical-engineering.name: Time-delay estimation and source localization
electrical-engineering.gist: Estimate time differences of arrival with generalized cross-correlation and localize acoustic, RF or seismic emitters by TDOA/FDOA multilateration with error analysis.

electrical-engineering.name: Fixed-point DSP quantization analysis
electrical-engineering.gist: Choose word lengths, scaling and coefficient quantization for filters or FFTs in fixed-point arithmetic, predicting roundoff noise, overflow and limit cycles against a floating-point reference.

electrical-engineering.name: Physiological signal conditioning
electrical-engineering.gist: Process ECG, EMG, EEG or PPG recordings with baseline-wander removal, powerline notch filtering, artifact rejection and feature detection such as QRS or pulse peaks.

electrical-engineering.name: Channel coding and decoding performance
electrical-engineering.gist: Implement encoders and decoders for convolutional, LDPC, polar, Reed-Solomon or BCH codes, and estimate BER/FER curves, coding gain and error floors by Monte Carlo simulation.

electrical-engineering.name: OFDM synchronization and channel estimation
electrical-engineering.gist: Process OFDM baseband captures to recover timing and carrier-frequency offset, estimate and equalize the channel from pilots, and report EVM and throughput.

electrical-engineering.name: MIMO detection and precoding
electrical-engineering.gist: Simulate multi-antenna links with ZF, MMSE, sphere or lattice-reduction detection and SVD or block-diagonalization precoding, evaluating capacity and error rates under channel-estimation error.

electrical-engineering.name: Wireless propagation measurement modeling
electrical-engineering.gist: Fit path-loss exponents, shadowing statistics, delay spread and Rician/Nakagami fading parameters to drive-test or channel-sounder measurements.

electrical-engineering.name: Single-carrier timing and carrier recovery
electrical-engineering.gist: Design and test Gardner, Mueller-Muller, Costas and decision-directed loops that recover symbol timing, frequency and phase from impaired PSK/QAM baseband samples.

electrical-engineering.name: Blind modulation recognition from IQ captures
electrical-engineering.gist: Classify modulation type and estimate symbol rate, carrier offset and SNR from unknown IQ recordings using cyclostationary features, higher-order cumulants or likelihood tests.

electrical-engineering.name: Coherent optical link DSP and impairments
electrical-engineering.gist: Model fiber chromatic dispersion, PMD, laser phase noise and Kerr nonlinearity, and implement compensation and equalization DSP to recover constellations and estimate OSNR margins.

electrical-engineering.name: Radio resource allocation and scheduling
electrical-engineering.gist: Formulate power control, subcarrier assignment or user scheduling in cellular and Wi-Fi networks as optimization problems and evaluate throughput-fairness tradeoffs by system-level simulation.

electrical-engineering.name: AC power flow and contingency screening
electrical-engineering.gist: Solve Newton-Raphson or fast-decoupled power flow on transmission or distribution networks and screen N-1 outages for thermal and voltage violations using sensitivity factors.

electrical-engineering.name: Optimal power flow and economic dispatch
electrical-engineering.gist: Solve DC or AC optimal power flow and economic dispatch with generator costs, line limits and reserves, deriving locational marginal prices and binding constraints.

electrical-engineering.name: Unit commitment and generation scheduling
electrical-engineering.gist: Build MILP unit-commitment models with startup costs, ramp limits, minimum up/down times and reserve requirements, and analyze schedules under forecast uncertainty.

electrical-engineering.name: Transient stability time-domain simulation
electrical-engineering.gist: Integrate multi-machine swing and exciter/governor equations through faults and switching events to determine critical clearing times and rotor-angle or frequency stability.

electrical-engineering.name: Short-circuit analysis and protection coordination
electrical-engineering.gist: Compute symmetrical and unsymmetrical fault currents with sequence networks and set overcurrent, distance or differential relays to meet selectivity and sensitivity requirements.

electrical-engineering.name: Transmission grid state estimation

electrical-engineering.name: Harmonic and power quality analysis

electrical-engineering.name: Load and renewable generation forecasting

electrical-engineering.name: Distribution feeder voltage and PV hosting capacity

electrical-engineering.name: Oscillation mode identification from PMU data
electrical-engineering.gist: Extract frequencies, damping and mode shapes of electromechanical oscillations from synchrophasor ambient or ringdown data with Prony, matrix-pencil or subspace methods.

electrical-engineering.name: Electric machine parameter identification
electrical-engineering.gist: Estimate equivalent-circuit and mechanical parameters of induction, synchronous or PM machines from no-load, locked-rotor, standstill or operating data, and predict torque-speed and efficiency maps.

electrical-engineering.name: Grid-tied inverter control design
electrical-engineering.gist: Design current, voltage and synchronization loops for grid-following or grid-forming inverters with LCL filters, and verify dynamics, harmonics and weak-grid stability by simulation.

electrical-engineering.name: Energy storage and microgrid dispatch
electrical-engineering.gist: Optimize battery, diesel and renewable dispatch in microgrids or behind-the-meter systems under tariffs, degradation costs and islanding constraints using LP/MILP or dynamic programming.

electrical-engineering.name: Equipment thermal rating and insulation ageing
electrical-engineering.gist: Model hot-spot temperatures of transformers, cables or overhead lines from load and ambient histories with IEC/IEEE thermal models and estimate loss of life or dynamic ratings.

electrical-engineering.name: Data-driven system identification
electrical-engineering.gist: Estimate ARX, ARMAX, state-space or transfer-function models of plants from input-output experiments using prediction-error or subspace methods, with model-order selection and validation.

electrical-engineering.name: PID tuning and loop shaping
electrical-engineering.gist: Tune PID and lead-lag controllers for identified plants to meet overshoot, settling, bandwidth and robustness margins, including anti-windup, filtering and disturbance-rejection checks.

electrical-engineering.name: Model predictive control design
electrical-engineering.gist: Formulate linear or nonlinear MPC with input, rate and state constraints for process, thermal, vehicle or power-electronic plants and evaluate closed-loop performance and computation time.

electrical-engineering.name: Inertial sensor fusion and attitude estimation
electrical-engineering.gist: Fuse gyroscope, accelerometer, magnetometer and GNSS data with complementary, extended or error-state Kalman filters to estimate orientation and position, including sensor bias calibration.

electrical-engineering.name: Robust H-infinity and mu control
electrical-engineering.gist: Model plant uncertainty with weighting functions, synthesize H2/H-infinity or mixed-sensitivity controllers, and assess robust stability and performance via singular values or structured singular values.

electrical-engineering.name: Model-based fault detection and isolation
electrical-engineering.gist: Generate residuals from observers or parity relations for motors, actuators or sensors, and design detection thresholds that isolate faults while controlling false-alarm rates on operating data.

electrical-engineering.name: Wire antenna method-of-moments analysis
electrical-engineering.gist: Solve thin-wire integral equations for dipoles, monopoles, Yagis or loops to compute current distributions, input impedance, gain and radiation patterns versus frequency.

electrical-engineering.name: Real-time task schedulability analysis
electrical-engineering.gist: Determine whether periodic and sporadic firmware tasks meet deadlines under rate-monotonic or EDF scheduling via response-time analysis, blocking terms and execution-trace measurements.

electrical-engineering.name: Duty-cycled sensor node energy budgeting
electrical-engineering.gist: Estimate battery lifetime of wireless embedded devices from current-profile captures and state-machine models, then optimize sleep schedules, sampling and radio duty cycles.

electrical-engineering.name: Serial bus protocol decoding from captures
electrical-engineering.gist: Decode UART, SPI, I2C, CAN or 1-Wire transactions from sampled logic or analog captures, recovering bit timing, frames, checksums and protocol errors.

electrical-engineering.name: S-parameter network analysis and de-embedding
electrical-engineering.gist: Process touchstone measurements to calibrate, de-embed fixtures, check passivity and causality, convert between network representations, and extract equivalent-circuit or line parameters.

electrical-engineering.name: Impedance matching network design
electrical-engineering.gist: Design L, pi, T, stub or multi-section transformer matching networks for antennas, amplifiers or loads over a band, trading off bandwidth, Q and component losses.

electrical-engineering.name: Antenna array pattern synthesis
electrical-engineering.gist: Compute element excitations for linear or planar arrays to meet sidelobe, null, beamwidth or shaped-beam masks using Dolph-Chebyshev, Taylor or convex-optimization methods.

electrical-engineering.name: PA behavioral modeling and digital predistortion
electrical-engineering.gist: Fit memory-polynomial or Volterra models to power-amplifier input/output captures and identify predistorters that reduce ACPR and EVM while respecting efficiency constraints.

electrical-engineering.name: Microstrip and planar filter design
electrical-engineering.gist: Design coupled-line, hairpin, stepped-impedance or stub microwave filters from prototype coefficients and substrate parameters, verifying responses with transmission-line network models.

electrical-engineering.name: Parametric and nonparametric spectral estimation
electrical-engineering.gist: Estimate power spectra of noisy sampled signals with periodogram, Welch, multitaper, AR/Burg, Capon or Lomb-Scargle methods, quantifying resolution, leakage, variance and confidence intervals.

electrical-engineering.name: Speech and audio enhancement
electrical-engineering.gist: Suppress noise, reverberation and interference in speech or music recordings with spectral subtraction, Wiener or MMSE-STSA estimators, and score results with SNR, PESQ-like or segmental metrics.

electrical-engineering.name: Linear predictive speech analysis and coding
electrical-engineering.gist: Extract LPC coefficients, formants, pitch and voicing from speech frames, and build vocoder or CELP-style encoders whose bitrate and spectral distortion are measured on recordings.

electrical-engineering.name: ISI channel equalization and sequence estimation
electrical-engineering.gist: Design linear, decision-feedback, fractionally spaced or MLSE/Viterbi equalizers for dispersive single-carrier channels from training sequences, and compare residual ISI, MSE and BER.

electrical-engineering.name: Spread-spectrum and GNSS signal acquisition and tracking
electrical-engineering.gist: Generate and correlate PN or Gold codes to acquire code phase and Doppler, then run DLL/PLL tracking on DSSS or GNSS IF samples to produce pseudoranges and C/N0 estimates.

electrical-engineering.name: RF and satellite link budget analysis
electrical-engineering.gist: Compute end-to-end link margins from transmit power, antenna gains, path, atmospheric and rain losses, system noise temperature and required Eb/N0, including availability statistics and sensitivity sweeps.

electrical-engineering.name: Information-theoretic capacity and rate-distortion computation
electrical-engineering.gist: Numerically evaluate channel capacities, mutual information for finite constellations, water-filling allocations and rate-distortion functions with Blahut-Arimoto or convex optimization.

electrical-engineering.name: Spectrum sensing and signal detection
electrical-engineering.gist: Detect occupied bands in wideband captures with energy, matched-filter, eigenvalue or cyclostationary detectors, setting thresholds for a target false-alarm rate and characterizing ROC curves versus SNR.

electrical-engineering.name: Quantization and source coding
electrical-engineering.gist: Design scalar Lloyd-Max, companded and vector quantizers or transform and entropy coders for sampled signals, and measure rate-distortion performance against theoretical bounds.

electrical-engineering.name: Image denoising, deblurring and restoration
electrical-engineering.gist: Restore degraded images with Wiener, Richardson-Lucy, total-variation or wavelet-shrinkage methods given estimated point-spread functions and noise models, scoring with PSNR and SSIM.

electrical-engineering.name: Multi-target tracking and data association
electrical-engineering.gist: Track multiple maneuvering targets from cluttered radar or sonar detections with Kalman/IMM filters and nearest-neighbor, JPDA or MHT association, evaluating with OSPA or track-purity metrics.

electrical-engineering.name: LQR, LQG and optimal state-feedback design
electrical-engineering.gist: Design state-feedback, observer and Kalman-filter-based controllers by solving Riccati equations for linearized plants, tuning weights to trade performance, effort and noise sensitivity.

electrical-engineering.name: Nonlinear and sliding-mode control
electrical-engineering.gist: Design feedback-linearizing, backstepping, sliding-mode or Lyapunov-based controllers for nonlinear electromechanical plants and verify robustness, chattering and region of attraction by simulation.

electrical-engineering.name: Field-oriented and direct torque control of motor drives
electrical-engineering.gist: Implement Clarke/Park transforms, current regulators, flux observers and PWM/space-vector modulation for induction or PM motor drives, verifying torque, speed and current-ripple performance.

electrical-engineering.name: Static timing analysis of digital circuits
electrical-engineering.gist: Propagate arrival and required times through gate-level netlists with delay models, clock skew and setup/hold constraints to find critical paths, slack and maximum clock frequency.

electrical-engineering.name: Boolean logic minimization and synthesis
electrical-engineering.gist: Minimize and map combinational or sequential logic from truth tables, FSM descriptions or netlists using Quine-McCluskey, Espresso-style heuristics, BDDs or SAT-based equivalence checking.

electrical-engineering.name: CRC, LFSR and scrambler design
electrical-engineering.gist: Analyze and select CRC polynomials, LFSR sequences and scramblers for undetected-error probability, period, correlation and spectral properties, and verify implementations against captured frames.

electrical-engineering.name: Electromagnetic transients and traveling-wave fault location
electrical-engineering.gist: Simulate switching and lightning surges on lines and cables with Bergeron or frequency-dependent line models, and locate faults from traveling-wave arrival times in recorded transients.

electrical-engineering.name: Power system reliability and adequacy assessment
electrical-engineering.gist: Estimate LOLE, EENS and reliability indices of generation and distribution systems with capacity outage tables, Markov models or sequential Monte Carlo using component failure and repair data.

electrical-engineering.name: HVDC and FACTS device modeling
electrical-engineering.gist: Model LCC/VSC HVDC links, SVCs, STATCOMs and series compensators in power flow and dynamic studies, sizing controllers and assessing their effect on voltage support and transfer capacity.

electrical-engineering.name: FDTD electromagnetic simulation
electrical-engineering.gist: Write finite-difference time-domain solvers with absorbing boundaries and dispersive materials to simulate scattering, waveguides, cavities or shielding, extracting S-parameters, resonances or field maps.

electrical-engineering.name: Capacitance and inductance parasitic extraction
electrical-engineering.gist: Compute capacitance matrices, partial inductances and resistances of conductor geometries such as traces, vias, busbars or coils with finite-difference, boundary-element or partial-element methods.

electrical-engineering.name: EMC emissions and shielding analysis
electrical-engineering.gist: Predict conducted and radiated emissions of circuits and cables, design EMI filters and shields, and compare spectra from simulation or receiver scans with CISPR/FCC limit masks.

electrical-engineering.name: Oscillator design and phase noise modeling
electrical-engineering.gist: Analyze LC, crystal or ring oscillators for startup, amplitude and frequency stability, and predict or fit phase-noise spectra with Leeson or impulse-sensitivity models from simulations or measurements.

electrical-engineering.name: RF receiver cascade and dynamic range budgeting
electrical-engineering.gist: Plan receiver and transmitter chains by cascading gain, noise figure, P1dB and IP3 across stages, then verify sensitivity, blocking, intermodulation and spurious-free dynamic range by two-tone simulation.

electrical-engineering.name: Power semiconductor loss and junction thermal modeling
electrical-engineering.gist: Compute conduction and switching losses of MOSFETs, IGBTs and diodes from datasheet curves and mission profiles, and predict junction temperatures with Foster/Cauer thermal networks and heatsink sizing.

electrical-engineering.name: Magnetic component and transformer design
electrical-engineering.gist: Design inductors and high-frequency transformers by selecting core, turns, gap and winding, estimating core loss with Steinmetz models, winding AC loss with Dowell's method, and temperature rise.

electrical-engineering.name: Photovoltaic module modeling and MPPT
electrical-engineering.gist: Fit single- and double-diode PV models to I-V curves under irradiance and temperature, simulate partial shading, and compare perturb-and-observe, incremental-conductance or global MPPT algorithms.

electrical-engineering.name: Power distribution network impedance design
electrical-engineering.gist: Model PCB and package power-delivery networks with VRM, planes and decoupling capacitors to meet a target impedance profile, optimizing capacitor selection and predicting supply noise under load transients.

electrical-engineering.name: Electronic component reliability and accelerated life testing
electrical-engineering.gist: Fit Weibull, lognormal or Arrhenius/Eyring acceleration models to failure and censored life-test data of electronic parts, and predict MTBF, FIT rates and warranty returns with confidence bounds.

electrical-engineering.name: Non-intrusive load monitoring and disaggregation
electrical-engineering.gist: Disaggregate aggregate household or building power measurements into appliance-level consumption using event detection, steady-state signatures, factorial HMMs or sparse coding, and score energy-assignment accuracy.

electrical-engineering.name: Substation grounding grid design
electrical-engineering.gist: Compute ground resistance, ground potential rise, and step and touch voltages of grounding grids in uniform or two-layer soil from resistivity soundings, and size conductors and rods to meet IEEE 80-style safety limits.

electrical-engineering.name: Overhead line and cable parameter calculation
electrical-engineering.gist: Derive series impedance and shunt admittance matrices of overhead lines and cables with Carson's equations, Kron reduction and sequence transformation, including bundling, earth return and skin effect versus frequency.

electrical-engineering.name: Small-signal eigenanalysis and power system stabilizer design
electrical-engineering.gist: Linearize multi-machine power system models, compute eigenvalues, participation factors and mode shapes, and tune power system stabilizers or damping controllers to meet minimum damping-ratio targets.

electrical-engineering.name: Voltage stability and continuation power flow
electrical-engineering.gist: Trace PV and QV curves with continuation power flow, locate saddle-node and limit-induced bifurcations, and compute loadability margins and the reactive-support actions that restore them.

electrical-engineering.name: Load frequency control and AGC
electrical-engineering.gist: Model multi-area frequency dynamics with governors, turbines, tie lines and inertia, then design and evaluate area control error, AGC and droop schemes against load steps and renewable fluctuations.

electrical-engineering.name: Insulation diagnostics from dissolved gas and partial discharge data
electrical-engineering.gist: Interpret transformer dissolved-gas analyses with ratio methods, Duval triangles or classifiers, and analyze phase-resolved partial-discharge patterns to identify insulation defect types and their severity.

electrical-engineering.name: Ultrasound and acoustic imaging beamforming
electrical-engineering.gist: Reconstruct B-mode or plane-wave images from multichannel RF element data with delay-and-sum, adaptive minimum-variance or synthetic-aperture beamforming, and quantify resolution, contrast and sidelobes.

electrical-engineering.name: Loudspeaker and electroacoustic transducer modeling
electrical-engineering.gist: Identify Thiele-Small and nonlinear parameters from impedance and displacement measurements, and design sealed, vented or passive-radiator enclosures and crossovers to meet response targets.

electrical-engineering.name: Pulse shaping and modulated-signal spectral analysis

electrical-engineering.name: Medium access and random-access protocol performance
electrical-engineering.gist: Analyze throughput, delay and collision behaviour of ALOHA, CSMA/CA, TDMA and ARQ/HARQ schemes using Markov-chain models such as Bianchi's and event-driven simulation.

electrical-engineering.name: Adaptive control

electrical-engineering.name: Iterative learning and repetitive control

electrical-engineering.name: Sampled-data and digital controller implementation

electrical-engineering.name: Digital fault simulation and test pattern generation
electrical-engineering.gist: Simulate stuck-at, transition and bridging faults in gate-level netlists, generate test vectors with D-algorithm, PODEM or SAT-based ATPG, and compute fault coverage and test-set compaction.

electrical-engineering.gist: Estimate dynamic, short-circuit and leakage power of gate-level or RTL designs from switching activity derived probabilistically or from simulation traces, and evaluate clock gating and voltage scaling.

electrical-engineering.name: Analog IC transistor sizing with gm/Id methodology
electrical-engineering.gist: Size transistors of OTAs, comparators and bias networks from gm/Id lookup tables or device models to meet gain, bandwidth, swing and power targets, verified by netlist simulation.

electrical-engineering.name: Rational macromodeling and model order reduction

civil-engineering.name: Nonlinear seismic response of buildings

civil-engineering.name: Ground-motion record selection and scaling

civil-engineering.name: Seismic fragility and loss estimation

civil-engineering.name: Structural reliability analysis

civil-engineering.name: Wind loading and tall-building response

civil-engineering.name: Bridge weigh-in-motion and load rating

civil-engineering.name: Reinforced concrete section analysis

civil-engineering.name: Passive and active vibration control

civil-engineering.name: Finite element model updating

civil-engineering.name: Human-induced floor and footbridge vibration

civil-engineering.name: Pile and shallow foundation capacity
