applied-mathematics.gist: Solving incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on staggered or collocated grids with Chorin-type projection, pressure-correction or vorticity-streamfunction formulations, and verifying divergence control and temporal order on benchmark flows.

applied-mathematics.name: PDE-based image processing and segmentation
applied-mathematics.gist: Applying nonlinear diffusion (Perona-Malik), inpainting PDEs, active contours and Mumford-Shah or Chan-Vese level-set segmentation to images, with attention to discretization, stopping criteria and parameter sensitivity.

applied-mathematics.name: Shape and topology optimization
applied-mathematics.gist: Optimizing material layouts or domain shapes for structural, thermal or flow objectives with SIMP density methods, level-set shape derivatives or homogenization, including filtering, checkerboard control and compliance verification.

applied-mathematics.name: Multirate signal processing and filter banks
applied-mathematics.gist: Designing decimators, interpolators, polyphase structures, sample-rate converters and perfect-reconstruction or near-perfect-reconstruction filter banks, and measuring aliasing, imaging and reconstruction error.

applied-mathematics.name: Sensor array processing and beamforming
applied-mathematics.gist: Processing multichannel array data with delay-and-sum, MVDR/Capon and adaptive beamformers, designing array weights and geometries, and assessing beam patterns, sidelobes and source-localization accuracy.

applied-mathematics.name: Fractal and multifractal signal analysis
applied-mathematics.gist: Estimating Hurst exponents, long-range dependence and multifractal spectra of signals and surfaces with detrended fluctuation analysis, wavelet leaders, box counting or structure functions, validated on synthetic fractional processes.

applied-mathematics.name: Orthogonal polynomials and Gaussian quadrature construction
applied-mathematics.gist: Generating recurrence coefficients for orthogonal polynomials of arbitrary weights from moments or discretized measures with Stieltjes, Lanczos or modified Chebyshev algorithms, and building Gauss, Radau and Lobatto rules via Golub-Welsch.

applied-mathematics.name: Numerical and automatic differentiation
applied-mathematics.gist: Computing derivatives with finite-difference stencils, complex-step, forward- and reverse-mode automatic differentiation and regularized differentiation of noisy data, analysing truncation-versus-rounding tradeoffs and noise amplification.

applied-mathematics.name: Differential-algebraic equations
applied-mathematics.gist: Solving index-1 and higher-index DAEs from circuits, multibody and process models with BDF or Radau methods, index reduction, consistent initialization and drift stabilization, and checking constraint satisfaction.

applied-mathematics.name: Parallel-in-time integration
applied-mathematics.gist: Applying parareal, PFASST-style or multigrid-reduction-in-time algorithms to ODE and PDE time stepping, studying convergence across iterations, the choice of coarse propagators and theoretical speed-up.

applied-mathematics.name: Optimal experimental design and sensor placement
applied-mathematics.gist: Selecting measurement locations, times or inputs to maximize information about model parameters with A-, D- or E-optimal criteria, Fisher information and greedy or convex relaxations, for linear and linearized inverse problems.

applied-mathematics.name: Random matrix computations
applied-mathematics.gist: Sampling Gaussian, Wishart and other random matrix ensembles and comparing empirical eigenvalue densities, spacing distributions and extreme eigenvalues with semicircle, Marchenko-Pastur and Tracy-Widom predictions.

applied-mathematics.name: Fokker-Planck equation solvers
applied-mathematics.gist: Solving forward and backward Kolmogorov equations for diffusion processes with positivity-preserving finite-volume or spectral schemes, computing stationary densities, escape rates and first-passage statistics, and comparing with SDE ensembles.

applied-mathematics.name: Nonlinear and polynomial eigenvalue problems
applied-mathematics.gist: Solving quadratic, polynomial, rational and transcendental eigenvalue problems via linearization, contour-integral (Beyn) methods or Newton-type iterations, as arising from damped vibrations, delays and resonances, and checking backward errors.

applied-mathematics.name: Construction and analysis of time-stepping methods
applied-mathematics.gist: Deriving Runge-Kutta and linear multistep methods from order conditions, plotting absolute stability regions, designing strong-stability-preserving or low-storage schemes, and confirming order and stability empirically.

applied-mathematics.name: Variational image registration
applied-mathematics.gist: Aligning images or point sets with rigid, affine, elastic, diffusion-regularized or diffeomorphic deformation models, minimizing similarity measures with multilevel optimization, and evaluating landmark error and Jacobian regularity.

formal-mathematics.name: SAT-based combinatorial existence and bound search
formal-mathematics.gist: Encode the existence of a combinatorial object (colorings that avoid monochromatic substructures, Ramsey-type configurations, van der Waerden certificates) as CNF. Solve it with SAT solvers and local search to improve lower bounds, confirm small values exhaustively, and output a witness or an UNSAT verdict with a checkable proof trace.

formal-mathematics.name: Resolution and DRAT proof checking
formal-mathematics.gist: Parse UNSAT proof traces or resolution derivations produced by solvers, replay them step by step, and report the validity, size and core clauses of each proof.

formal-mathematics.name: SMT verification of program properties
formal-mathematics.gist: Generate verification conditions for loops, bit-vector code or array manipulations, discharge them with an SMT solver, and report proven properties or concrete counterexamples.

formal-mathematics.name: Finite-state model checking
formal-mathematics.gist: Build the explicit or symbolic state space of a protocol or concurrent algorithm, check safety and liveness properties, and extract minimal counterexample traces.

formal-mathematics.name: Property-based testing of algorithm implementations
formal-mathematics.gist: Check a given implementation of a sorting, graph or numeric algorithm against a reference specification with randomized and exhaustive small-case testing, and localize and minimize failing inputs.

formal-mathematics.name: Loop invariant and termination certificates
formal-mathematics.gist: Synthesize linear or polynomial invariants and ranking functions for given imperative programs using LP/SDP or template enumeration, then verify them on the transition relation.

formal-mathematics.name: Interval arithmetic rigorous enclosures
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute guaranteed enclosures of function values, roots or extrema with interval Newton methods and branch-and-bound, and certify existence and uniqueness of zeros in boxes.

formal-mathematics.name: Rigorous ODE integration and enclosures
formal-mathematics.gist: Propagate validated enclosures of ODE solutions with Taylor-model or Lohner-type steps to certify periodic orbits, bounds on trajectories or invariant regions.

formal-mathematics.name: Floating-point error analysis
formal-mathematics.gist: Quantify the rounding error of numerical kernels by comparison against exact or high-precision arithmetic, derive forward error bounds, and identify ill-conditioned inputs.

formal-mathematics.name: High-precision evaluation of mathematical constants
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute constants defined by series, integrals or limits to hundreds of digits with mpmath, using convergence acceleration and certified tail bounds.

formal-mathematics.name: Integer relation detection with PSLQ/LLL
formal-mathematics.gist: Search for closed forms of numerically computed constants by finding integer relations among high-precision values, and validate them to extra precision.

formal-mathematics.name: Recurrence and generating-function guessing
formal-mathematics.gist: Infer linear recurrences, holonomic equations or algebraic generating functions from the initial terms of a sequence via Padé approximation or linear algebra, then test the guesses on further terms.

formal-mathematics.name: Symbolic summation and hypergeometric identities
formal-mathematics.gist: Prove or discover binomial and hypergeometric sum identities with Gosper/Zeilberger-type creative telescoping, and output certificate recurrences.

formal-mathematics.name: Asymptotic enumeration via singularity analysis
formal-mathematics.gist: Derive leading-order and correction asymptotics of combinatorial counts from generating-function singularities and compare them with exact counts.

formal-mathematics.name: Exact enumeration with transfer matrices
formal-mathematics.gist: Count lattice paths, tilings, self-avoiding configurations or constrained words on strips by building transfer matrices and extracting exact counts and growth constants.

formal-mathematics.name: Graph enumeration up to isomorphism
formal-mathematics.gist: Generate non-isomorphic graphs or hypergraphs with given properties using canonical augmentation or canonical labeling, and tabulate counts by invariants.

formal-mathematics.name: Extremal graph theory computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Determine Turán-type numbers, extremal graphs or saturation numbers for small parameters by exhaustive search, ILP, or semidefinite flag-algebra bounds.

formal-mathematics.name: Graph invariants and spectral computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute chromatic, independence and domination numbers, characteristic polynomials and spectral properties for families of structured graphs, and test conjectured inequalities.

formal-mathematics.name: Combinatorial designs and difference sets
formal-mathematics.gist: Construct or classify block designs, Steiner systems, Hadamard matrices and cyclic difference sets with algebraic constructions and backtracking, and verify their defining properties.

formal-mathematics.name: Latin squares and orthogonal arrays
formal-mathematics.gist: Construct, complete or count Latin squares, mutually orthogonal sets and orthogonal arrays, and compute isotopy class invariants.

formal-mathematics.name: Permutation patterns and statistics
formal-mathematics.gist: Enumerate pattern-avoiding permutation classes, compute distributions of permutation statistics, and test equidistribution and Wilf-equivalence conjectures.

formal-mathematics.name: Integer partitions and q-series identities
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute restricted partition functions and q-series expansions to verify Rogers–Ramanujan-type identities, congruences and generating-function product formulas.

formal-mathematics.name: Symmetric functions and tableaux
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute Schur, Kostka and Littlewood–Richardson coefficients, plethysms and tableau enumerations by combinatorial algorithms and check them against character formulas.

formal-mathematics.name: Combinatorics on words
formal-mathematics.gist: Analyze avoidability of powers and patterns, factor complexity, morphic sequences and de Bruijn-type constructions using automata and exhaustive word search.

formal-mathematics.name: Additive combinatorics and Sidon sets
formal-mathematics.gist: Search for extremal sum-free sets, Sidon sets, sumset-size configurations and arithmetic-progression-free sets, and compare them with known bounds.

formal-mathematics.name: Polyominoes, tilings and exact cover
formal-mathematics.gist: Count or construct tilings of regions by polyominoes and other tile sets with dancing-links exact cover or SAT, and classify the solutions up to symmetry.

formal-mathematics.name: Combinatorial game theory computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute Sprague–Grundy values, canonical forms and outcome classes for impartial and partizan games, detect periodicity, and verify winning strategies.

formal-mathematics.name: Primality proving and certificates
formal-mathematics.gist: Produce and check Pratt, Pocklington or ECPP-style primality certificates for large integers and run probable-prime pipelines over structured families.

formal-mathematics.name: Integer factorization algorithms
formal-mathematics.gist: Implement and tune Pollard rho, p−1, ECM or quadratic sieve variants to factor batches of structured integers and report the factorizations together with performance statistics.

formal-mathematics.name: Discrete logarithms in finite groups
formal-mathematics.gist: Solve discrete-log instances in multiplicative groups or elliptic-curve groups with baby-step giant-step, Pohlig–Hellman and index calculus, and verify the results.

formal-mathematics.name: Prime distribution and arithmetic functions
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute prime-counting functions, prime gaps and races, and sums of multiplicative functions over large ranges with sieves, and compare them with analytic predictions.

formal-mathematics.name: Diophantine equation solving
formal-mathematics.gist: Find all solutions of Thue, Pell, norm-form or exponential Diophantine equations within bounds using descent, lattice reduction and modular sieving.

formal-mathematics.name: Continued fractions and Diophantine approximation
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute continued fraction expansions, best approximations and irrationality measure estimates for algebraic and transcendental numbers.

formal-mathematics.name: Elliptic curve arithmetic and point counting
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute group orders, torsion, reductions modulo primes and Frobenius traces of elliptic curves over finite fields and the rationals, and test Sato–Tate-type statistics.

formal-mathematics.name: Algebraic number field computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute integral bases, discriminants, prime decompositions, units and small class groups of number fields, and tabulate fields by their invariants.

formal-mathematics.name: Binary and ternary quadratic forms
formal-mathematics.gist: Reduce quadratic forms, enumerate classes and genera, and count representation numbers of integers by forms.

formal-mathematics.name: Modular forms coefficient computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute q-expansion coefficients of eta products, theta series and Hecke eigenforms, and verify congruences, multiplicativity and Ramanujan-bound behaviour.

formal-mathematics.name: Finite field arithmetic and polynomials
formal-mathematics.gist: Find irreducible and primitive polynomials, factor polynomials over GF(q), and compute minimal polynomials and normal bases.

formal-mathematics.name: Lattice basis reduction applications
formal-mathematics.gist: Apply LLL/BKZ to recover small solutions, short vectors or hidden relations in knapsack, approximate-GCD and simultaneous-approximation instances.

formal-mathematics.name: Error-correcting code computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute minimum distances, weight enumerators and automorphisms of linear and cyclic codes, and search for codes that meet or improve tabulated bounds.

formal-mathematics.name: Boolean functions and S-box analysis
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute nonlinearity, Walsh spectra, differential uniformity and algebraic degree of Boolean and vectorial functions, and search for functions with optimal profiles.

formal-mathematics.name: Sequences with low correlation
formal-mathematics.gist: Search for binary or polyphase sequences, Golay pairs and Costas arrays with optimal autocorrelation or merit factor using algebraic constructions and stochastic search.

formal-mathematics.name: Finite group computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute orders, conjugacy classes, subgroup lattices and presentations of permutation and matrix groups with Schreier–Sims and coset enumeration.

formal-mathematics.name: Character tables and representation theory
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute character tables, decompose tensor and induced representations, and verify orthogonality relations for finite groups.

formal-mathematics.name: Lie algebras and root systems
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute root systems, Weyl group orbits, weight multiplicities via Freudenthal's formula, and tensor product decompositions for semisimple Lie algebras.

formal-mathematics.name: Gröbner bases and polynomial systems
formal-mathematics.gist: Solve or decide polynomial systems exactly with Gröbner bases and elimination, count solutions, and verify geometry theorems algebraically.

formal-mathematics.name: Real algebraic geometry and root isolation
formal-mathematics.gist: Isolate real roots with Sturm or Descartes methods, decide polynomial inequalities and compute cylindrical decompositions for low-dimensional semialgebraic sets.

formal-mathematics.name: Sum-of-squares positivity certificates
formal-mathematics.gist: Find SOS and Positivstellensatz certificates for polynomial inequalities via semidefinite programming, then rationalize them and check them exactly.

formal-mathematics.name: Exact linear algebra over integers
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute Hermite and Smith normal forms, integer kernels, determinants and rational solutions with modular and p-adic methods for structured integer matrices.

formal-mathematics.name: Lattice polytopes and Ehrhart theory
formal-mathematics.gist: Enumerate lattice points, compute Ehrhart polynomials, volumes and face lattices of rational polytopes, and test unimodality and positivity conjectures.

formal-mathematics.name: Matroid and hyperplane arrangement computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute Tutte and characteristic polynomials, flats and representability of matroids from vector configurations and hyperplane arrangements.

formal-mathematics.name: Simplicial homology computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute homology groups with torsion, Euler characteristics and Betti numbers of simplicial complexes built from combinatorial or geometric data.

formal-mathematics.name: Knot and link invariant computation
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute Alexander, Jones and HOMFLY polynomials, determinants and crossing statistics from PD codes or braid words, and distinguish knots in tables.

formal-mathematics.name: Cellular automata and symbolic dynamics
formal-mathematics.gist: Classify cellular automaton rules, compute topological entropy of subshifts of finite type, and detect periodic and glider behaviour by exhaustive simulation.

formal-mathematics.name: Finite automata and regular languages
formal-mathematics.gist: Construct, minimize and compare finite automata, decide language equivalence, and count accepted words by length through transfer matrices.

formal-mathematics.name: Term rewriting and equational reasoning
formal-mathematics.gist: Check confluence and termination of rewrite systems, run Knuth–Bendix completion, and decide word problems in finitely presented algebras.

formal-mathematics.name: Exact Markov chain and probability computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute exact hitting times, stationary distributions and absorption probabilities for combinatorial Markov chains with rational arithmetic, and validate them by simulation.

formal-mathematics.name: Exact integer programming with certificates
formal-mathematics.gist: Solve combinatorial optimization instances to proven optimality with ILP or constraint programming, and output primal solutions together with dual or branching certificates.

formal-mathematics.name: Conjecture testing over integer sequences
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute large ranges of a number-theoretic or combinatorial sequence to test a stated conjecture, locate counterexamples or record values, and summarize the empirical growth.

formal-mathematics.name: Model counting and knowledge compilation
formal-mathematics.gist: Compile CNF formulas or combinatorial constraints into BDDs, ZDDs or d-DNNF and use them to count models exactly, enumerate solution families, compute weighted counts or reliability polynomials, and cross-check the results against brute force on small cases.

formal-mathematics.name: First-order saturation theorem proving
formal-mathematics.gist: Implement or drive resolution, superposition or tableau provers on TPTP-style first-order problems, then output refutation proofs or saturated clause sets and report proof length and search statistics.

formal-mathematics.name: Formal proof database verification
formal-mathematics.gist: Parse formal proof databases in simple proof languages (Metamath-style substitution systems, Hilbert-style or natural-deduction calculi), verify every theorem against its axioms and definitions, and report dependency graphs, axiom usage and invalid or unused steps.

formal-mathematics.name: Quantified Boolean formula solving
formal-mathematics.gist: Encode two-player games, planning or synthesis questions as QBF, solve them by expansion, QCDCL or CEGAR, and output Skolem or Herbrand function certificates that are checked independently.

formal-mathematics.name: Presburger arithmetic and arithmetic decision procedures
formal-mathematics.gist: Decide quantified linear integer or real arithmetic formulas with Cooper's method, Fourier–Motzkin elimination or automata-based procedures, and output equivalent quantifier-free formulas or satisfying assignments.

formal-mathematics.name: Certifying algorithms and witness checking
formal-mathematics.gist: Run graph and optimization algorithms that emit certificates, such as Kuratowski subgraphs, odd cycles, min-cuts, dual solutions or topological orders, and write independent checkers that validate each claimed answer.

formal-mathematics.name: Abstract interpretation of small programs
formal-mathematics.gist: Analyze imperative programs with interval, octagon or polyhedral abstract domains using widening and narrowing, compute sound variable bounds and assertion verdicts, and compare their precision with concrete executions.

formal-mathematics.name: Lambda calculus and type inference
formal-mathematics.gist: Implement normalization, Hindley–Milner inference or type checking for simply typed and dependently typed calculi, then type-check or normalize collections of terms and report principal types, normal forms or type errors.

formal-mathematics.name: Polynomial factorization, GCDs and resultants over Z and Q
formal-mathematics.gist: Factor integer polynomials with Hensel lifting and Zassenhaus or van Hoeij recombination, compute modular GCDs, resultants and discriminants, and detect cyclotomic or decomposable structure.

formal-mathematics.name: Symbolic integration and closed-form ODE solutions
formal-mathematics.gist: Decide elementary integrability with Risch-type algorithms, find Liouvillian solutions of linear ODEs with Kovacic's algorithm or find hypergeometric solutions, and verify the closed forms by differentiation.

formal-mathematics.name: p-adic computations and Newton polygons
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute p-adic roots by Hensel lifting, determine slope factorizations with Newton polygons, evaluate p-adic valuations, logarithms and series, and certify the precision of the results.

formal-mathematics.name: Fast exact arithmetic algorithms
formal-mathematics.gist: Implement and verify Karatsuba, Toom–Cook, NTT-based multiplication, Montgomery and Barrett reduction or subquadratic GCD for big integers and polynomials, and benchmark them against reference arithmetic.

formal-mathematics.name: Zeta and L-function zero computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Locate and count zeros of the Riemann zeta function and Dirichlet L-functions with Riemann–Siegel and Turing-method checks, verify the Riemann hypothesis on given ranges, and study zero-spacing statistics.

formal-mathematics.name: Exponential and character sums
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute Gauss, Jacobi, Kloosterman and character sums over finite fields and residue rings, verify evaluations and Weil-type bounds, and study the distribution of normalized angles.

formal-mathematics.name: Numerical semigroups and the Frobenius problem
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute Frobenius numbers, genus, Apéry sets and gap structures of numerical semigroups, enumerate semigroups by genus, and test conjectures such as Wilf's inequality.

formal-mathematics.name: Transformation semigroups and Green's relations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute sizes, idempotents, Green's D-, L- and R-class structure, ideals and presentations of semigroups generated by transformations, partial permutations or matrices.

formal-mathematics.name: Finite model finding for algebraic axioms
formal-mathematics.gist: Search for finite models of equational or first-order axiom systems such as quasigroups, lattices or exotic semigroups with SAT or Mace-style search, find the smallest models, and enumerate them up to isomorphism.

formal-mathematics.name: Posets, linear extensions and Möbius inversion
formal-mathematics.gist: Count linear extensions, compute Möbius functions, order dimension, zeta polynomials and chain or antichain statistics of finite posets and lattices, and verify inversion formulas.

formal-mathematics.name: Discrete geometry of point configurations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute order types, convex-position subsets, crossing numbers, distinct-distance counts and no-k-in-line configurations of planar point sets by exact orientation predicates and exhaustive or SAT search.

formal-mathematics.name: Delsarte linear programming bounds
formal-mathematics.gist: Set up Delsarte LP and SDP bounds for codes, designs and association schemes using Krawtchouk or Gegenbauer polynomials, solve them in exact or rationalized form, and compare them with known constructions.

formal-mathematics.name: Combinatorial maps and surface embeddings
formal-mathematics.gist: Represent graph embeddings as rotation systems, compute face counts and genus, enumerate maps or dessins by genus and degree, and determine the minimal genus of small graphs.

formal-mathematics.name: Tropical geometry computations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute tropical hypersurfaces, Newton subdivisions, tropical intersections and valuations of Puiseux-series solutions, and count curves through points with tropical methods.

formal-mathematics.name: Plane algebraic curves and Puiseux expansions
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute singular points, Puiseux expansions, branch structure, delta invariants and geometric genus of plane curves, and find rational parametrizations where they exist.

formal-mathematics.name: Invariant theory of finite groups
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute Molien series, primary and secondary invariants and fundamental invariants for finite matrix groups, and verify Hilbert series and syzygies against the computed generators.

formal-mathematics.name: Monomial ideals and Stanley–Reisner rings
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute Hilbert series, multigraded Betti numbers, Alexander duals and Cohen–Macaulayness of monomial and edge ideals from combinatorial data with exact algebra.

formal-mathematics.name: Galois group determination
formal-mathematics.gist: Determine Galois groups of integer polynomials from Frobenius cycle-type statistics, resolvent factorizations and discriminants, and tabulate polynomial families by their transitive group.

formal-mathematics.name: Pólya enumeration and cycle-index counting
formal-mathematics.gist: Count colorings, necklaces, chemical isomers or structures under group actions with Burnside's lemma and cycle indices, and validate the counts by explicit orbit enumeration.

formal-mathematics.name: Context-free grammars and pushdown languages
formal-mathematics.gist: Parse with CYK or Earley algorithms, convert grammars to normal forms, detect ambiguity on bounded lengths, and count words or derivations through algebraic generating functions.

formal-mathematics.name: Graph labelings and decompositions
formal-mathematics.gist: Search for graceful, harmonious and magic labelings and for decompositions of graphs into cycles, paths or Hamiltonian factors with backtracking, SAT or algebraic constructions, and verify them exactly.

formal-mathematics.name: Bilinear complexity and comparator networks
formal-mathematics.gist: Search for low-rank matrix multiplication schemes by solving Brent equations, or for optimal-size and optimal-depth sorting networks, with SAT and local search, then verify them exhaustively or algebraically.

formal-mathematics.name: Modal and temporal logic decision procedures
formal-mathematics.gist: Decide satisfiability and validity of formulas in modal logics (K, S4, S5) and LTL or CTL using tableaux, translation to automata or filtration, then output Kripke countermodels or closed tableau proofs and check them independently.

formal-mathematics.name: Exact geometric predicates and robust computational geometry
formal-mathematics.gist: Implement convex hulls, Delaunay triangulations, segment intersection or polygon Boolean operations with exact or adaptive-precision orientation and incircle predicates, and compare their output against naive floating-point versions on degenerate inputs.

formal-mathematics.name: Certified minimax and Chebyshev approximation
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute best polynomial or rational approximations with the Remez algorithm and Chebyshev interpolation, and certify the sup-norm approximation error rigorously, for example for correctly rounded elementary-function kernels.

formal-mathematics.name: Verified numerical linear algebra
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute rigorous enclosures of linear-system solutions, eigenvalues, singular values and matrix inverses with Rump-style residual methods and Krawczyk tests, and certify nonsingularity or positive definiteness.

formal-mathematics.name: Algebraic decoding and linear complexity
formal-mathematics.gist: Implement Berlekamp–Massey, Sugiyama, Peterson–Gorenstein–Zierler or Guruswami–Sudan decoding of BCH and Reed–Solomon codes, compute linear complexity profiles of sequences, and measure decoding success against error weight.

formal-mathematics.name: Bernoulli numbers and special-number congruences
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute Bernoulli, Euler, Stirling and Bell numbers modulo primes or exactly, find irregular, Wieferich or Wilson primes, and verify Kummer-type, Lucas-type or Touchard congruences over large ranges.

formal-mathematics.name: Isogeny graphs and modular polynomials
formal-mathematics.gist: Build supersingular and ordinary l-isogeny graphs over finite fields with Vélu formulas or modular polynomials, analyse volcano structure, diameters and spectral expansion, and compute endomorphism-ring levels.

formal-mathematics.name: Zeta functions of curves over finite fields
formal-mathematics.gist: Count points on hyperelliptic and plane curves over extensions of finite fields, perform Jacobian arithmetic with Cantor's algorithm, reconstruct L-polynomials, and verify functional equations and Weil bounds.

formal-mathematics.name: Arithmetic dynamics
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute periodic and preperiodic points, cycle structures of polynomial and rational maps modulo primes and over number fields, dynatomic polynomials and canonical heights, and test uniform-boundedness and cycle-length statistics.

formal-mathematics.name: Additive representation counts
formal-mathematics.gist: Count representations of integers as sums of primes, powers or polygonal numbers (Goldbach, Waring, Lagrange-type problems) with convolutions and FFT, and compare them with Hardy–Littlewood singular-series predictions.

formal-mathematics.name: Multiple zeta values and polylogarithm identities
formal-mathematics.gist: Evaluate multiple zeta values and multiple polylogarithms to high precision, generate double-shuffle and duality relations by exact linear algebra, and check dimension conjectures by weight.

formal-mathematics.name: Sparse linear algebra over finite fields
formal-mathematics.gist: Solve or find kernels of large sparse systems over GF(p) or GF(2) with structured Gaussian elimination, Wiedemann or block Lanczos methods, as in sieve-based factoring or rank computations, and verify the solutions.

formal-mathematics.name: Finite-dimensional algebras and quiver representations
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute radicals, Wedderburn decompositions, indecomposable modules, Auslander–Reiten quivers and dimension vectors for path algebras with relations and group algebras over finite fields.

formal-mathematics.name: Free and braid group algorithms
formal-mathematics.gist: Solve subgroup membership, index and conjugacy questions in free groups with Stallings foldings and Whitehead moves, and compute Garside or Dehornoy normal forms and conjugacy classes in braid groups.

formal-mathematics.name: Coxeter groups and Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials
formal-mathematics.gist: Enumerate reduced words, Bruhat intervals, descent statistics and Kazhdan–Lusztig and R-polynomials for finite and affine Coxeter groups, and test combinatorial invariance and positivity conjectures.

formal-mathematics.name: Cluster algebras and quiver mutation
formal-mathematics.gist: Mutate quivers and exchange matrices, enumerate mutation classes, compute cluster variables and frieze patterns, and verify finite-type classification, Laurent positivity and periodicity phenomena.

formal-mathematics.name: Spherical codes and packing configurations
formal-mathematics.gist: Construct point configurations on spheres and in Euclidean space that maximize minimal distance or kissing numbers, or minimize energy, by lattice constructions and optimization, and verify their exact properties.

formal-mathematics.name: Random generation of combinatorial structures
formal-mathematics.gist: Implement uniform or Boltzmann samplers, recursive-method generators and Markov-chain samplers for trees, maps, partitions and words, and validate the uniformity and size distributions statistically.

formal-mathematics.name: Bijective combinatorics
formal-mathematics.gist: Implement and verify explicit bijections between Catalan, Schröder, Motzkin or tableau families, check which statistics they transport, and search for statistic-preserving bijections on small sizes.

formal-mathematics.name: Extremal set systems
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute or bound maximum sizes of intersecting, Sperner, cover-free or union-closed families and VC-dimension-constrained set systems by exhaustive search, ILP and shifting arguments, and verify the extremal examples.

formal-mathematics.name: Tree decompositions and width parameters
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute treewidth, pathwidth, branchwidth or cliquewidth of graphs exactly or by heuristics, produce verifiable decompositions, and run dynamic programming over them to solve counting or optimization problems.

formal-mathematics.name: Timed automata reachability
formal-mathematics.gist: Analyse networks of timed automata with zone graphs and difference-bound matrices, decide reachability and timing properties, and extract concrete timed witness traces.

formal-mathematics.name: Petri net analysis
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute reachability and coverability (Karp–Miller) graphs, place and transition invariants, boundedness, liveness and deadlock freedom of Petri nets, and certify the verdicts with invariants or firing sequences.

formal-mathematics.name: Probabilistic model checking
formal-mathematics.gist: Check PCTL and expected-reward properties of Markov decision processes and Markov chains with exact or interval value iteration and policy iteration, and output optimal schedulers and certified probability bounds.

formal-mathematics.name: Bisimulation and process equivalence checking
formal-mathematics.gist: Decide strong, weak and branching bisimilarity, trace and failure equivalence of labeled transition systems with partition refinement, minimize the systems, and output distinguishing formulas.

formal-mathematics.name: Small Turing machine enumeration and halting deciders
formal-mathematics.gist: Enumerate small Turing machines or tag systems, apply cycler, translated-cycler, backward-reasoning and closed-language deciders, and certify busy-beaver-style values together with nonhalting proofs.

formal-mathematics.name: Combinatorial rigidity
formal-mathematics.gist: Test generic and infinitesimal rigidity of bar-joint frameworks with Laman pebble games and rigidity-matrix ranks, enumerate minimally rigid graphs, and find stresses and flexes.

formal-mathematics.name: Sparse polynomial interpolation and rational reconstruction
formal-mathematics.gist: Recover sparse polynomials and rational functions from black-box evaluations with Ben-Or–Tiwari, Zippel or Prony-type methods, combined with Chinese remaindering and rational reconstruction, and verify the results at random points.

formal-mathematics.name: Lattice point counting problems
formal-mathematics.gist: Count lattice points in circles, spheres, hyperbolic regions and polygons exactly for large parameters, compute the Gauss-circle and Dirichlet-divisor error terms, and study their growth and moments.

formal-mathematics.name: Permanents and hafnians
formal-mathematics.gist: Compute permanents, hafnians and immanants of structured or sparse matrices with Ryser, Glynn or dynamic-programming algorithms, count perfect matchings, and test permanent inequalities and conjectures.

geosciences.name: Earthquake location and phase picking
geosciences.gist: Pick P and S arrivals on multi-station waveforms, then invert them with a 1D velocity model for hypocentres, origin times and location uncertainty ellipsoids.

geosciences.name: Template matching earthquake detection
geosciences.gist: Cross-correlate known event waveforms against continuous multi-channel records to detect small repeating or swarm events, set detection thresholds by MAD statistics and estimate relative magnitudes.

geosciences.name: Seismic moment tensor inversion
geosciences.gist: Invert waveforms or first-motion polarities for full or deviatoric moment tensors, decompose them into double-couple and CLVD parts, and quantify nodal-plane uncertainty.

geosciences.name: Earthquake catalog statistics and ETAS
geosciences.gist: Estimate magnitude of completeness, Gutenberg-Richter b-values and Omori-Utsu or ETAS aftershock parameters from event catalogs by maximum likelihood, and decluster or forecast seismicity rates.

geosciences.name: Ambient noise cross-correlation interferometry
geosciences.gist: Preprocess continuous noise records, stack inter-station cross-correlations into empirical Green's functions, and measure group or phase velocity dispersion or seismic velocity changes over time.

geosciences.name: Receiver function crustal analysis
geosciences.gist: Deconvolve teleseismic P waveforms into receiver functions and use H-kappa stacking or inversion to estimate crustal thickness, Vp/Vs and layered structure beneath a station.

geosciences.name: Seismic travel-time tomography
geosciences.gist: Set up ray-based sensitivity kernels from source-receiver travel times and solve regularized linear or iterative inversions for 2D or 3D velocity perturbations, with resolution tests.

geosciences.name: Shear-wave splitting and anisotropy
geosciences.gist: Measure fast-polarization directions and delay times from split shear phases by grid-search eigenvalue or transverse-energy minimization, and interpret layered or dipping anisotropy.

geosciences.name: Seismic site response and HVSR
geosciences.gist: Compute horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios, spectral ratios against reference sites or 1D transfer functions of layered soil columns to estimate resonance frequencies and amplification.

geosciences.name: Ground motion models and seismic hazard
geosciences.gist: Regress ground-motion prediction equations on strong-motion records with mixed effects and integrate source, magnitude and attenuation models into probabilistic hazard curves and uniform hazard spectra.

geosciences.name: Reflection seismic data processing
geosciences.gist: Process synthetic or real shot gathers through gain, deconvolution, velocity analysis, NMO correction, stacking and migration to image subsurface reflectors.

geosciences.name: Gravity anomaly reduction and inversion
geosciences.gist: Apply free-air, Bouguer and terrain corrections to gravity survey data, separate regional and residual fields, and forward-model or invert for density bodies and basin depth.

geosciences.name: Magnetic anomaly processing and interpretation
geosciences.gist: Grid aeromagnetic or ground magnetic data, apply reduction to pole, upward continuation and derivative filters, and estimate source depths by Euler deconvolution or spectral methods.

geosciences.name: Electrical resistivity tomography inversion
geosciences.gist: Forward-model DC resistivity or induced-polarization surveys on 2D meshes and invert apparent resistivity pseudosections with smoothness regularization and depth-of-investigation analysis.

geosciences.name: Magnetotelluric and EM sounding inversion
geosciences.gist: Estimate impedance tensors from time-series electromagnetic fields, analyse dimensionality and phase tensors, and invert apparent resistivity and phase curves for layered conductivity models.

geosciences.name: Borehole well-log petrophysics
geosciences.gist: Clean and depth-match LAS well logs, then compute shale volume, porosity, water saturation and lithofacies, and correlate formation tops between wells.

geosciences.name: Rock physics and AVO analysis
geosciences.gist: Use Gassmann fluid substitution and effective-medium models to link elastic properties to porosity and fluids, and compute amplitude-versus-offset responses and attributes for reservoir characterization.

geosciences.name: Crustal heat flow and geotherms
geosciences.gist: Combine borehole temperature profiles with thermal conductivity and radiogenic heat production to estimate surface heat flow, correct for paleoclimate and topography, and solve steady or transient conductive geotherms.

geosciences.name: Lithospheric flexure and isostasy
geosciences.gist: Model elastic plate deflection under topographic or sediment loads and estimate effective elastic thickness from gravity-topography admittance or coherence, or from profile fits.

geosciences.name: Paleomagnetic directional statistics
geosciences.gist: Perform principal component analysis on demagnetization data, compute Fisher or Bingham mean directions, run fold and reversal tests, and derive virtual geomagnetic poles and apparent polar wander paths.

geosciences.name: Radiometric geochronology and isochrons
geosciences.gist: Fit isochrons and concordia ages to isotope-ratio data with correlated errors using York regression, compute weighted means and MSWD, and propagate decay-constant uncertainties.

geosciences.name: Aqueous speciation and mineral saturation
geosciences.gist: Compute activity coefficients, speciation, charge balance and saturation indices of natural waters from major-ion analyses, and model mixing or evaporation paths.

geosciences.name: Stable isotope fractionation and mixing
geosciences.gist: Apply temperature-dependent fractionation factors, Rayleigh distillation and Bayesian end-member mixing models to oxygen, hydrogen, carbon or sulfur isotope data.

geosciences.name: Igneous trace element petrogenesis modelling
geosciences.gist: Model batch and fractional melting, fractional crystallization and assimilation using partition coefficients, then fit observed REE and trace-element patterns of igneous suites.

geosciences.name: Compositional analysis of geochemical surveys
geosciences.gist: Apply log-ratio transforms, robust multivariate statistics and spatial methods to multi-element soil, stream-sediment or rock geochemistry to map anomalies and process signatures.

geosciences.name: Mineral reaction kinetics and reactive transport
geosciences.gist: Integrate coupled rate laws for mineral dissolution and precipitation, optionally along 1D flow paths, and fit rate constants or predict porosity and fluid composition evolution.

geosciences.name: Geothermometry and thermobarometry
geosciences.gist: Estimate equilibration temperatures and pressures from mineral compositions or geothermal fluid chemistry using calibrated exchange and net-transfer equilibria, with Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation.

geosciences.name: Aquifer pumping test analysis
geosciences.gist: Fit Theis, Cooper-Jacob, Hantush or Neuman type-curve solutions to drawdown and recovery data, accounting for well storage and boundaries, to estimate transmissivity, storativity and leakance.

geosciences.name: Numerical groundwater flow modelling
geosciences.gist: Build finite-difference or finite-element models of confined and unconfined aquifers with recharge, wells and river boundaries, and compute heads, budgets, capture zones and parameter calibration.

geosciences.name: Solute transport and tracer tests
geosciences.gist: Solve advection-dispersion-reaction equations analytically or numerically and fit breakthrough curves from tracer or contaminant data for velocity, dispersivity, retardation and decay.

geosciences.name: Unsaturated zone flow and Richards equation
geosciences.gist: Fit van Genuchten soil hydraulic functions to retention data and solve 1D Richards equation for infiltration, drainage and recharge under realistic atmospheric forcing.

geosciences.name: Hydrogeological geostatistics and kriging
geosciences.gist: Fit experimental variograms to heads, conductivities or concentrations, perform ordinary, universal or co-kriging and run conditional simulations to quantify spatial uncertainty.

geosciences.name: Groundwater level time series analysis
geosciences.gist: Decompose well hydrographs into responses to rainfall, pumping, barometric pressure and Earth tides via transfer-function or impulse-response models, and detect trends.

geosciences.name: Streamflow recession and baseflow separation
geosciences.gist: Apply digital filters and recession analysis to daily discharge records to separate baseflow, estimate storage-discharge relations and calibrate simple conceptual catchment models.

geosciences.name: Multispectral land cover classification
geosciences.gist: Classify land cover from multiband satellite reflectance stacks with supervised or unsupervised methods, including spectral indices, texture features and accuracy assessment against reference samples.

geosciences.name: Vegetation phenology from index time series
geosciences.gist: Smooth noisy, cloud-gapped NDVI or EVI time series per pixel and extract phenological metrics such as start, peak and end of season, and their interannual trends.

geosciences.name: Satellite image change detection
geosciences.gist: Co-register multitemporal imagery and detect land surface change by image differencing, change-vector analysis or time-series break detection, with thresholds and error assessment.

geosciences.name: Hyperspectral spectral unmixing
geosciences.gist: Extract endmembers and estimate abundance fractions from hyperspectral cubes with constrained linear or nonlinear unmixing, including noise estimation and dimensionality reduction.

geosciences.name: LiDAR terrain and canopy analysis
geosciences.gist: Filter airborne LiDAR point clouds into ground and vegetation returns, interpolate DTMs and canopy height models, and derive tree heights, cover and biomass metrics.

geosciences.name: Atmospheric correction of optical imagery
geosciences.gist: Convert top-of-atmosphere radiance to surface reflectance using dark-object, empirical-line or simplified radiative-transfer approaches, and handle cloud and shadow masking.

geosciences.name: SAR backscatter soil moisture retrieval
geosciences.gist: Calibrate and speckle-filter SAR backscatter and invert water-cloud or change-detection models to estimate surface soil moisture against in situ observations.

geosciences.name: DEM geomorphometry and drainage extraction
geosciences.gist: Condition digital elevation models, compute slope, curvature and flow accumulation, extract stream networks and watersheds, and analyse channel steepness and hypsometry.

geosciences.name: Atmospheric radiative transfer calculations
geosciences.gist: Compute shortwave and longwave fluxes, heating rates and radiative forcing through layered atmospheric columns using two-stream or line-by-line style band models.

geosciences.name: Climate variability modes and EOF analysis
geosciences.gist: Compute anomalies, EOFs, principal components and teleconnection indices from gridded climate fields, and assess significance, regressions and composite patterns.

geosciences.name: Climate extremes statistical analysis
geosciences.gist: Fit GEV and peaks-over-threshold models, including nonstationary ones, to station or gridded climate data for return levels, return periods and changes in extreme events.

geosciences.name: Statistical downscaling and bias correction
geosciences.gist: Bias-correct coarse climate model output against observations with quantile mapping or regression-based downscaling, and evaluate preservation of trends, extremes and spatial structure.

geosciences.name: Ensemble data assimilation for geophysical models
geosciences.gist: Implement EnKF, 3D-Var or particle filters that assimilate sparse noisy observations into dynamical models, with localization, inflation and verification of analysis skill.

geosciences.name: Eddy covariance surface flux processing
geosciences.gist: Process high-frequency wind, temperature and gas concentration records through despiking, coordinate rotation, spectral corrections and gap filling to obtain surface energy and carbon fluxes.

geosciences.name: Radiosonde thermodynamics and convective indices
geosciences.gist: Derive lifted parcel profiles, CAPE, CIN, LCL, precipitable water and stability indices from sounding data, with quality control of humidity and temperature profiles.

geosciences.name: Atmospheric dispersion and source inversion
geosciences.gist: Simulate pollutant or tracer concentrations with Gaussian plume or Lagrangian models and invert sensor observations for source location, strength and emission time series.

geosciences.name: Energy balance and climate sensitivity models
geosciences.gist: Build zero- to one-dimensional or two-box energy balance models, fit them to temperature and forcing records, and estimate climate sensitivity and feedback parameters.

geosciences.name: Paleoclimate proxy records and age models
geosciences.gist: Construct age-depth models from radiocarbon or tie points, calibrate proxies such as isotopes or Mg/Ca into climate variables, and analyse spectral and event structure with full uncertainty.

geosciences.name: Climate station record homogenization
geosciences.gist: Detect and correct inhomogeneities from instrument or site changes in station temperature and precipitation series using reference series and changepoint tests.

geosciences.name: GNSS position time series analysis
geosciences.gist: Model daily GNSS coordinate series with trends, offsets, seasonal terms and postseismic decay under colored noise to obtain velocities and realistic uncertainties.

geosciences.name: GNSS positioning and tropospheric delay estimation
geosciences.gist: Solve pseudorange or carrier-phase positioning from observations and orbits, estimate clock and zenith tropospheric delays, and convert delays to precipitable water vapor.

geosciences.name: InSAR deformation time series
geosciences.gist: Unwrap or invert interferogram stacks with small-baseline methods, correct atmospheric and orbital errors, and retrieve line-of-sight displacement histories and velocity maps.

geosciences.name: Elastic dislocation fault slip modelling
geosciences.gist: Invert GNSS and InSAR displacements with Okada or Mogi elastic half-space Green's functions for fault geometry, distributed slip or magma source parameters under smoothing regularization.

geosciences.name: Crustal strain rate and block modelling
geosciences.gist: Interpolate GNSS velocity fields into strain-rate tensors and fit rotating block models with elastic fault locking to estimate slip rates on fault systems.

geosciences.name: Spherical harmonic gravity field analysis
geosciences.gist: Synthesize and filter spherical harmonic gravity or geoid models, compute geoid heights and anomalies, and derive surface mass change from time-variable gravity coefficients.

geosciences.name: Tide gauge and sea level analysis
geosciences.gist: Perform harmonic tidal analysis of water-level records, remove tides and surges, and estimate relative sea level trends and accelerations corrected for vertical land motion.

geosciences.name: Volcanic plume and tephra dispersal modelling
geosciences.gist: Model eruption column heights from buoyant plume theory and simulate advection-diffusion of tephra fallout, then invert isopach or isomass deposit data for erupted volume, column height and grain-size distribution.

geosciences.name: Glacier mass balance and ice flow modelling
geosciences.gist: Compute glacier surface mass balance from degree-day or energy-balance models, and solve shallow-ice or flowline equations for ice thickness, velocity and the glacier's response to climate forcing.

geosciences.name: Snow hydrology and snowmelt modelling
geosciences.gist: Estimate snow water equivalent and melt from temperature-index or energy-balance snowpack models driven by meteorological records, and calibrate them against snow pillow or snow-course observations.

geosciences.name: Evapotranspiration estimation
geosciences.gist: Compute reference and actual evapotranspiration with Penman-Monteith, Priestley-Taylor or Hargreaves formulations from weather data, and close water or energy budgets with soil-water balance models.

geosciences.name: Flood frequency and rainfall-runoff routing
geosciences.gist: Fit flood-frequency distributions to annual maximum discharges, derive unit hydrographs and route storm hydrographs through channels and reservoirs with Muskingum or kinematic-wave methods.

geosciences.name: Fluvial hydraulics and sediment transport
geosciences.gist: Compute open-channel flow profiles, bed shear stress and bedload or suspended-load transport rates with empirical transport formulas, and fit sediment rating curves from gauging data.

geosciences.name: Landscape evolution and hillslope modelling
geosciences.gist: Simulate topographic evolution with stream-power incision and hillslope diffusion models, and fit erosion parameters from river long profiles, chi analysis or scarp degradation profiles.

geosciences.name: Landslide and slope stability analysis
geosciences.gist: Evaluate slope safety factors with infinite-slope and limit-equilibrium methods under pore-pressure scenarios, and build probabilistic or statistical landslide susceptibility models from terrain attributes.

geosciences.name: Structural geology orientation analysis and stress inversion
geosciences.gist: Analyse planar and linear orientation data on stereonets, compute fold axes and fabric eigenvectors, and invert fault-slip data for paleostress tensors and stress ratios.

geosciences.name: Earthquake source spectra and stress drop
geosciences.gist: Fit Brune or Boatwright source models to displacement spectra corrected for path and site effects, using single-station or spectral-ratio methods, to estimate corner frequencies, seismic moment, stress drop and radiated energy.

geosciences.name: Seismic attenuation and coda Q
geosciences.gist: Estimate intrinsic and scattering attenuation from coda decay, spectral decay or multiple lapse-time window analysis, and map frequency-dependent Q across stations.

geosciences.name: Seismic wave propagation simulation
geosciences.gist: Solve acoustic or elastic wave equations with finite-difference or spectral methods on 1D-2D models, with absorbing boundaries, to compute synthetic seismograms and validate them against analytic solutions.

geosciences.name: Active-source surface wave analysis and Vs profiling
geosciences.gist: Transform multichannel surface-wave shot records into dispersion images, pick fundamental and higher-mode curves, and invert them for near-surface shear-wave velocity profiles and Vs30.

geosciences.name: Seismic and infrasound array beamforming
geosciences.gist: Apply delay-and-sum, f-k and high-resolution beamforming to array recordings to estimate back-azimuth and slowness, compute array response functions and detect coherent arrivals.

geosciences.name: Geomagnetic field modelling and space weather indices
geosciences.gist: Evaluate and fit spherical harmonic main-field models, separate external variations in observatory magnetometer data, and derive activity indices or geomagnetically induced electric fields.

geosciences.name: Plate kinematics and tectonic reconstruction
geosciences.gist: Estimate Euler poles from spreading rates, transform azimuths or GNSS velocities, compose and interpolate finite rotations, and reconstruct past positions with propagated rotation uncertainties.

geosciences.name: Mantle convection and geodynamic modelling
geosciences.gist: Solve thermal convection, Stokes flow or plate-cooling problems numerically to study Rayleigh-number scaling, subduction thermal structure, seafloor subsidence and lithospheric deformation.

geosciences.name: Low-temperature thermochronology
geosciences.gist: Model fission-track annealing and (U-Th)/He diffusion with radiation damage, compute ages and track-length distributions, and invert them for time-temperature histories and exhumation rates.

geosciences.name: Cosmogenic nuclide exposure and erosion dating
geosciences.gist: Compute production-rate scaling and shielding corrections for 10Be, 26Al or 36Cl, and derive surface exposure ages, burial ages and catchment-averaged denudation rates with uncertainty propagation.

geosciences.name: Geochemical mass spectrometry data reduction
geosciences.gist: Reduce LA-ICP-MS, ICP-MS or multicollector time-resolved signals through blank subtraction, internal standardization, drift and mass-bias correction, and reference-material calibration into concentrations or isotope ratios with uncertainties.

geosciences.name: Mineral thermodynamics and equations of state
geosciences.gist: Fit Birch-Murnaghan or Vinet equations of state to P-V-T data and compute phase equilibria, reaction boundaries and stable assemblages by Gibbs free energy minimization.

geosciences.name: Ocean carbonate system chemistry
geosciences.gist: Solve the seawater carbonate system from pairs of measured parameters with temperature- and pressure-dependent constants, and quantify acidification, aragonite saturation and air-sea CO2 fluxes.

geosciences.name: Hydrographic water mass and geostrophic analysis
geosciences.gist: Process CTD and Argo profiles with the TEOS-10 equation of state into density, mixed-layer depth and water-mass fractions, and compute geostrophic velocities and transports from hydrographic sections.

geosciences.name: Ocean surface wave spectra and statistics
geosciences.gist: Estimate directional and frequency wave spectra from buoy or pressure records, derive significant wave height and peak periods, fit JONSWAP-type spectra and estimate extreme sea states.

geosciences.name: Atmospheric chemistry box modelling
geosciences.gist: Integrate stiff gas-phase photochemical mechanisms for ozone, NOx and VOC chemistry with photolysis and deposition, and analyse sensitivity regimes, lifetimes and chemical budgets.

geosciences.name: Cloud microphysics and aerosol activation
geosciences.gist: Simulate adiabatic parcel models with Köhler theory for cloud droplet activation, condensational growth and collision-coalescence, and relate aerosol size distributions to droplet number.

geosciences.name: Weather radar precipitation estimation
geosciences.gist: Correct radar reflectivity for clutter, attenuation and beam geometry, apply Z-R or polarimetric rainfall relations, and merge radar and gauge data into quantitative precipitation estimates.

geosciences.name: Geodetic network adjustment and coordinate transformations
geosciences.gist: Perform least-squares adjustment of leveling, traverse or triangulation networks with reliability testing, and estimate Helmert datum transformations and map-projection conversions between reference frames.

geosciences.name: Idealized atmosphere and ocean dynamics models
geosciences.gist: Solve shallow-water, barotropic vorticity or quasi-geostrophic equations numerically to study Rossby waves, geostrophic adjustment, wind-driven gyres and instabilities, and diagnose energy and enstrophy.

geosciences.name: Ground-penetrating radar processing
geosciences.gist: Process GPR profiles through time-zero correction, dewow, gain, background removal and migration, estimate velocities from diffraction hyperbolae, and convert results to depth sections and layer interpretations.

geosciences.name: Seismic full-waveform inversion
geosciences.gist: Invert recorded acoustic or elastic waveforms for 1D-2D velocity models by adjoint-state gradients and multiscale frequency continuation, with source-wavelet estimation and cycle-skipping diagnostics.

geosciences.name: Seismic impedance inversion and attributes
geosciences.gist: Tie wells to seismic with extracted wavelets, invert post-stack or pre-stack traces for acoustic and elastic impedance, and compute instantaneous, coherence or spectral attributes for horizon and facies interpretation.

geosciences.name: Kinematic finite-fault rupture inversion
geosciences.gist: Invert near-field or teleseismic waveforms for space-time slip distributions, rupture velocity and moment-rate functions on discretized faults, using multi-time-window or Bayesian parameterizations.

geosciences.name: Tsunami generation and propagation modelling
geosciences.gist: Compute initial sea-surface displacement from seafloor deformation and propagate tsunamis with linear or nonlinear shallow-water solvers to obtain arrival times, run-up estimates and source inversions from tide or DART records.

geosciences.name: Induced seismicity and pore-pressure diffusion
geosciences.gist: Model pore-pressure and poroelastic stress changes from fluid injection or reservoir depletion, compute Coulomb stress changes, and relate seismicity-front migration and rates to injection histories.

geosciences.name: Wellbore geomechanics and in situ stress
geosciences.gist: Estimate vertical, minimum and maximum horizontal stresses and pore pressure from density logs, leak-off tests, breakouts and tensile fractures, and analyse wellbore stability and critically stressed fractures.

geosciences.name: Glacial isostatic adjustment modelling
geosciences.gist: Compute viscoelastic Earth responses to ice-load histories using relaxation spectra or flat-Earth Maxwell models, and fit mantle viscosity profiles to relative sea-level curves, uplift rates and gravity changes.

geosciences.name: Cyclostratigraphy and astrochronology
geosciences.gist: Detect orbital Milankovitch cycles in stratigraphic proxy series by multitaper and evolutive spectral analysis, test sedimentation-rate hypotheses, and tune depth series to astronomical targets for floating time scales.

geosciences.name: Sedimentary basin backstripping and subsidence analysis
geosciences.gist: Decompact stratigraphic columns with porosity-depth laws, backstrip sediment and water loads to obtain tectonic subsidence, and fit McKenzie-type stretching and thermal subsidence models.

geosciences.name: Early diagenesis and porewater profile modelling
geosciences.gist: Solve steady and transient reaction-diffusion-advection equations for porewater solutes in sediments, fit organic matter degradation, sulfate reduction and methane profiles, and compute benthic fluxes.

geosciences.name: Groundwater age dating with environmental tracers
geosciences.gist: Interpret tritium-helium, CFC, SF6, 14C or noble gas data with lumped-parameter transit-time distributions, correct for excess air and geochemical reactions, and estimate mean residence times and mixing fractions.

geosciences.name: Seawater intrusion and variable-density flow
geosciences.gist: Model freshwater-saltwater interfaces in coastal aquifers with Ghyben-Herzberg sharp-interface solutions or variable-density flow simulations, and assess pumping, recharge and sea-level rise impacts on the salt wedge.

geosciences.name: Drought indices and hydroclimatic monitoring
geosciences.gist: Compute SPI, SPEI, PDSI or soil-moisture percentiles from precipitation and temperature records by distribution fitting, and characterize drought onset, duration, severity and spatial extent.

geosciences.name: Soil erosion and sediment yield modelling
geosciences.gist: Derive RUSLE rainfall erosivity, soil erodibility, slope-length and cover factors from rainfall, soil and DEM data, estimate soil loss and sediment delivery, and calibrate against plot or catchment sediment yields.

geosciences.name: Thermal infrared land surface temperature retrieval
geosciences.gist: Retrieve land surface temperature and emissivity from thermal bands with split-window, single-channel or temperature-emissivity separation algorithms, and analyse urban heat islands or surface energy balance.

geosciences.name: Passive microwave remote sensing retrievals
geosciences.gist: Invert multi-frequency brightness temperatures with emission models or empirical algorithms for sea-ice concentration, snow water equivalent, soil moisture or rain rate, accounting for footprint resampling and land contamination.

geosciences.name: Satellite radar altimetry processing
geosciences.gist: Retrack altimeter waveforms, apply range and geophysical corrections, and derive sea surface height anomalies, inland water levels or ice-sheet elevation changes from along-track data with crossover analysis.

geosciences.name: Photogrammetry and stereo DEM generation
geosciences.gist: Recover camera poses and 3D points from overlapping images by feature matching, bundle adjustment and triangulation, or from stereo satellite pairs, and generate and validate DEMs and differencing products.

geosciences.name: SAR polarimetric decomposition and classification
geosciences.gist: Compute coherency and covariance matrices from polarimetric SAR, apply Pauli, Freeman-Durden or H-A-alpha decompositions, and classify scattering mechanisms with Wishart-based clustering.

geosciences.name: Ocean colour bio-optical retrieval
geosciences.gist: Derive chlorophyll, suspended sediment and inherent optical properties from water-leaving reflectance with band-ratio or semi-analytical inversion models, and validate against in situ matchups.

geosciences.name: Ocean turbulence microstructure and mixing
geosciences.gist: Process microstructure shear and temperature-gradient profiles into dissipation rates by spectral fitting, and estimate diapycnal diffusivities, Thorpe scales and finescale mixing parameterizations.

geosciences.name: Sea ice thermodynamics and dynamics modelling
geosciences.gist: Simulate sea-ice growth and melt with Stefan or multilayer thermodynamic models under atmospheric forcing, and analyse ice drift, concentration and thickness distributions from buoy or satellite records.

geosciences.name: Permafrost and frozen ground thermal modelling
geosciences.gist: Solve heat conduction with phase change in freezing soils, estimate active-layer thickness with Stefan or Kudryavtsev approaches, and fit models to borehole and air-temperature records under warming scenarios.

geosciences.name: Atmospheric boundary layer similarity and profiles
geosciences.gist: Apply Monin-Obukhov similarity to tower or sodar wind and temperature profiles to estimate roughness length, stability and fluxes, and diagnose boundary-layer height from soundings, lidar or ceilometer backscatter.

geosciences.name: Weather forecast verification and ensemble calibration
geosciences.gist: Score deterministic and probabilistic forecasts with contingency tables, Brier, CRPS, rank histograms and spatial verification methods, and post-process ensembles with EMOS or analog calibration.

geosciences.name: Tropical cyclone analysis and risk modelling
geosciences.gist: Compute potential intensity from thermodynamic profiles, fit parametric wind-field models, analyse best-track climatology and intensification, and simulate synthetic tracks for wind and surge hazard.

geosciences.name: Air pollution receptor modelling and source apportionment
geosciences.gist: Apportion particulate or VOC speciation data to sources with positive matrix factorization or chemical mass balance, estimate uncertainties by bootstrapping, and link factors to meteorology and wind direction.

geosciences.name: Climate change detection and attribution
geosciences.gist: Regress observed climate fields onto forced response fingerprints by optimal or total-least-squares fingerprinting with internal-variability covariance from control runs, and quantify attributable warming and event attribution probabilities.

geosciences.name: Atmospheric remote sensing optimal estimation retrievals
geosciences.gist: Retrieve trace-gas columns, temperature or aerosol profiles from spectral radiances with DOAS fitting or Rodgers optimal estimation, computing averaging kernels, degrees of freedom and error budgets.

geosciences.name: Diffusion chronometry in minerals
geosciences.gist: Fit concentration profiles across zoned crystals with temperature-dependent diffusion models, accounting for initial conditions, anisotropy and convolution with analytical resolution, to estimate magmatic or metamorphic timescales.

ocean-sciences.name: CTD profile processing and QC
ocean-sciences.gist: Clean raw conductivity-temperature-depth casts (despiking, sensor lag correction, loop removal, binning) and derive TEOS-10 quantities such as Absolute Salinity, Conservative Temperature and density.

ocean-sciences.name: Mixed layer depth estimation
ocean-sciences.gist: Determine mixed layer and barrier layer depths from temperature, salinity and density profiles using threshold, gradient or curvature criteria, and build climatologies or time series from them.

ocean-sciences.name: Water mass analysis and mixing
ocean-sciences.gist: Identify and quantify source water contributions with T-S diagrams and optimum multiparameter analysis, solving constrained least-squares mixing problems on hydrographic data.

ocean-sciences.name: Geostrophic and dynamic height calculations
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute dynamic height, geostrophic velocity shear and transports from hydrographic sections, choosing reference levels and propagating errors.

ocean-sciences.name: Satellite altimetry sea level analysis
ocean-sciences.gist: Process along-track or gridded sea surface height anomalies to estimate trends, seasonal cycles, eddy kinetic energy and geostrophic surface currents.

ocean-sciences.name: Tide gauge sea level trends
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse long tide gauge records for relative sea level trends, acceleration, vertical land motion correction and datum shifts with autocorrelated noise models.

ocean-sciences.name: Harmonic tidal analysis and prediction
ocean-sciences.gist: Fit tidal constituents with nodal corrections to water level or current records via least squares, assess constituent resolvability and predict future tides.

ocean-sciences.name: Tidal current ellipses and tidal energetics
ocean-sciences.gist: Derive tidal ellipse parameters from velocity records or model output and compute tidal energy flux, dissipation and conversion estimates.

ocean-sciences.name: Storm surge residuals and extremes
ocean-sciences.gist: Separate meteorological residuals from tides and fit extreme value distributions (GEV, GPD, joint probability methods) to estimate return levels of coastal water level.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean wave spectral analysis
ocean-sciences.gist: Estimate frequency and directional wave spectra from buoy heave-pitch-roll or pressure records and derive significant wave height, peak period and spreading parameters.

ocean-sciences.name: Wave climate and extreme wave statistics
ocean-sciences.gist: Characterize multi-year hindcast or buoy wave records with seasonal statistics, joint Hs-Tp distributions and extreme value return periods for engineering design.

ocean-sciences.name: Wave propagation, shoaling and refraction
ocean-sciences.gist: Solve the linear dispersion relation and ray or mild-slope equations to transform offshore waves over variable bathymetry toward the shore, including breaking criteria.

ocean-sciences.name: Nonlinear waves and rogue wave statistics
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse or simulate nonlinear surface wave fields (second-order theory, NLS equation) and assess crest height distributions and freak wave occurrence.

ocean-sciences.name: Tsunami propagation modelling
ocean-sciences.gist: Simulate tsunami generation and propagation with shallow water equations on idealized or real bathymetry and compare arrival times and amplitudes with gauge records.

ocean-sciences.name: Shallow water numerical models
ocean-sciences.gist: Implement and verify finite-difference or finite-volume solvers for linear and nonlinear shallow water equations, including Kelvin waves, seiches and coastal setup.

ocean-sciences.name: Internal waves and tides
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute vertical normal modes from stratification, detect internal tides in moored records, and estimate isopycnal displacements and baroclinic energy flux.

ocean-sciences.name: Turbulent mixing from microstructure
ocean-sciences.gist: Estimate dissipation rate and diapycnal diffusivity from shear microstructure or fast thermistor profiles by spectral fitting, and apply finescale parameterizations.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean mesoscale eddy detection and tracking
ocean-sciences.gist: Detect coherent eddies in sea level or vorticity fields using Okubo-Weiss, closed-contour or wavelet methods and track them through time for census statistics.

ocean-sciences.name: Lagrangian drifter and float analysis
ocean-sciences.gist: Process surface drifter and subsurface float trajectories to estimate mean currents, eddy diffusivity, Lagrangian integral scales and dispersion statistics.

ocean-sciences.name: Particle tracking and connectivity
ocean-sciences.gist: Advect virtual particles through gridded velocity fields with numerical integration and diffusion to compute connectivity matrices, residence times or pollutant pathways.

ocean-sciences.name: Wind-driven circulation and Ekman dynamics
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute Ekman transport, Ekman pumping and Sverdrup transport from wind stress fields and model wind-driven gyres with reduced-gravity or quasi-geostrophic models.

ocean-sciences.name: Coastal upwelling indices and dynamics
ocean-sciences.gist: Derive upwelling indices from wind and sea surface temperature data and relate them to coastal-trapped dynamics, cross-shelf transport and productivity.

ocean-sciences.name: Air-sea heat and momentum fluxes
ocean-sciences.gist: Apply bulk flux algorithms (COARE-type) to meteorological and SST data to compute turbulent heat, freshwater and momentum fluxes and close surface heat budgets.

ocean-sciences.name: Upper ocean heat content and budgets
ocean-sciences.gist: Integrate temperature profiles into heat content anomalies, assess sampling bias and gap-filling methods, and diagnose regional heat budget terms.

ocean-sciences.name: Sea surface temperature analysis
ocean-sciences.gist: Process satellite or in situ SST records for diurnal warming correction, anomaly computation, marine heatwave detection and front identification.

ocean-sciences.name: Climate modes and ocean variability
ocean-sciences.gist: Extract ENSO, PDO, AMO and similar modes with EOF, spectral and coherence analysis of ocean fields, and build indices or lagged regressions.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean state estimation and data assimilation
ocean-sciences.gist: Combine observations with dynamical models via optimal interpolation, 3D-Var or ensemble Kalman filters on reduced ocean models and evaluate analysis errors.

ocean-sciences.name: Objective mapping of sparse observations
ocean-sciences.gist: Interpolate irregular hydrographic or float observations onto grids with Gaussian-Markov estimation, covariance fitting and mapping error estimates.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean model output diagnostics
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse NetCDF output of circulation models on curvilinear or staggered grids to compute transports, overturning streamfunctions, vorticity budgets and skill scores.

ocean-sciences.name: Meridional overturning circulation estimation
ocean-sciences.gist: Estimate overturning and heat transport across basin-wide sections from moored arrays, Ekman and geostrophic components with mass compensation constraints.

ocean-sciences.name: Estuarine circulation and salinity intrusion
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse or model estuarine stratification, exchange flow, flushing times and salt intrusion length using box models, Knudsen relations or 1D/2D solvers.

ocean-sciences.name: Coastal sediment transport and morphodynamics
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute bed shear stress under waves and currents, sediment fluxes and longshore transport, and simulate shoreline or profile evolution.

ocean-sciences.name: ADCP velocity data processing
ocean-sciences.gist: Process acoustic Doppler current profiler data with beam-to-earth transformations, error screening, sidelobe removal, and derive current profiles and backscatter.

ocean-sciences.name: Mooring time series analysis
ocean-sciences.gist: Clean and analyse moored instrument records with knockdown correction, filtering, rotary spectra, inertial oscillation detection and coherence between instruments.

ocean-sciences.name: Argo float data processing
ocean-sciences.gist: Handle Argo profile files for quality control, salinity drift correction, delayed-mode adjustments and derived climatological products.

ocean-sciences.name: Underwater glider data processing
ocean-sciences.gist: Reconstruct glider dive data with thermal lag correction, flight model calibration, depth-averaged current estimation and section gridding.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean observing network design
ocean-sciences.gist: Evaluate and optimize the placement of moorings, floats or gliders using observing system simulation experiments, information content and coverage metrics.

ocean-sciences.name: Sensor calibration and drift correction
ocean-sciences.gist: Calibrate oceanographic sensors (oxygen optodes, fluorometers, pH, conductivity) against reference samples and model drift and temperature dependence.

ocean-sciences.name: Seawater carbonate system calculations
ocean-sciences.gist: Solve the carbonate equilibria from pairs of measured parameters to derive pCO2, pH, saturation states and propagate uncertainties in constants and inputs.

ocean-sciences.name: Air-sea CO2 flux estimation
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute CO2 fluxes from underway pCO2 and gas transfer velocity parameterizations and interpolate or regress sparse observations into regional flux maps.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean acidification trend detection
ocean-sciences.gist: Detect long-term changes in pH, DIC and aragonite saturation at time series stations with seasonal decomposition and anthropogenic carbon separation methods.

ocean-sciences.name: Anthropogenic carbon estimation
ocean-sciences.gist: Estimate anthropogenic carbon inventories from hydrographic data with back-calculation, TTD or eMLR methods and assess method uncertainty.

ocean-sciences.name: Dissolved oxygen and hypoxia analysis
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse oxygen profiles and time series to quantify oxygen minimum zones, apparent oxygen utilization, hypoxic extent and deoxygenation trends.

ocean-sciences.name: Nutrient cycling and stoichiometry
