ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse nitrate, phosphate and silicate distributions with Redfield ratios, N* and P* tracers to infer remineralization, denitrification and nitrogen fixation.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean biogeochemical box and NPZD models
ocean-sciences.gist: Build and calibrate nutrient-phytoplankton-zooplankton-detritus or multi-box carbon cycle models as ODE systems and fit parameters to observations.

ocean-sciences.name: Primary productivity estimation
ocean-sciences.gist: Estimate net primary production from satellite chlorophyll, light and SST with bio-optical models, or from oxygen and incubation data with photosynthesis-irradiance fits.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean colour and bio-optics
ocean-sciences.gist: Invert remote sensing reflectance into chlorophyll, absorption and backscattering with semi-analytical algorithms and evaluate retrievals against in situ matchups.

ocean-sciences.name: Phytoplankton bloom phenology
ocean-sciences.gist: Detect bloom initiation, peak and duration from chlorophyll time series with threshold, cumulative or curve-fitting methods and relate timing to physical drivers.

ocean-sciences.name: Particle flux and biological pump
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse sediment trap, thorium-234 or particle optical data to estimate export flux, Martin curve attenuation and remineralization length scales.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean tracers and ventilation ages
ocean-sciences.gist: Use CFCs, SF6, tritium-helium or radiocarbon to compute tracer ages, transit time distributions and ventilation rates with inverse Gaussian models.

ocean-sciences.name: Stable isotope and paleoceanographic proxies
ocean-sciences.gist: Calibrate and apply proxy relationships (d18O, Mg/Ca, alkenones) to reconstruct past temperature and salinity with age models and uncertainty propagation.

ocean-sciences.name: Underwater sound propagation modelling
ocean-sciences.gist: Derive sound speed profiles from hydrography with standard equations, identify SOFAR channels and surface ducts, and compute acoustic transmission loss and path sensitivity in range-dependent ocean environments with ray tracing, normal modes or parabolic equation methods.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean ambient noise analysis
ocean-sciences.gist: Process hydrophone recordings into calibrated power spectral densities, percentile statistics and correlations with wind, shipping and rain.

ocean-sciences.name: Marine bioacoustic signal detection
ocean-sciences.gist: Detect and classify whale calls, clicks or fish sounds in passive acoustic recordings with spectrogram, matched-filter or feature-based classifiers.

ocean-sciences.name: Underwater acoustic source localization
ocean-sciences.gist: Localize sound sources from hydrophone array data using time difference of arrival, beamforming or matched-field processing.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean acoustic tomography and inversion
ocean-sciences.gist: Invert acoustic travel times or modal dispersion for sound speed, temperature or seabed geoacoustic parameters with linearized or Bayesian methods.

ocean-sciences.name: Active sonar and echosounder processing
ocean-sciences.gist: Process echosounder or multibeam backscatter for bottom detection, biomass estimation from volume backscatter, and target strength calibration.

ocean-sciences.name: Bathymetry gridding and seafloor analysis
ocean-sciences.gist: Grid multibeam or sparse soundings, remove artifacts, and derive slope, roughness and geomorphological features or predicted bathymetry from gravity.

ocean-sciences.name: Sea ice and polar ocean processes
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse sea ice concentration and thickness records, model thermodynamic ice growth, and diagnose brine rejection and polar ocean stratification changes.

ocean-sciences.name: Equatorial wave dynamics
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse equatorially trapped Kelvin, Rossby, Yanai and inertia-gravity waves using dispersion relations, meridional mode projections and wavenumber-frequency spectra of sea level, thermocline or current records.

ocean-sciences.name: Planetary Rossby wave propagation
ocean-sciences.gist: Estimate westward phase speeds and wavelengths of extratropical baroclinic Rossby waves from Hovmöller diagrams with Radon transforms or 2D FFTs, and compare them with standard and modified long-wave theory.

ocean-sciences.name: Baroclinic instability and linear stability analysis
ocean-sciences.gist: Solve eigenvalue problems for Eady, Phillips and Charney-type instabilities, and barotropic or baroclinic shear-flow instabilities, on observed or idealized ocean mean states to obtain growth rates and unstable scales.

ocean-sciences.name: Geostrophic and submesoscale turbulence diagnostics
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute wavenumber spectra, structure functions, spectral energy and enstrophy fluxes, and frontogenesis or submesoscale diagnostics from altimetry, ship sections or quasi-geostrophic turbulence simulations.

ocean-sciences.name: Double diffusion and thermohaline staircases
ocean-sciences.gist: Detect thermohaline staircases and intrusions in profiles, compute Turner angle and density ratio, and estimate salt-finger and diffusive-convection fluxes using laboratory-derived flux laws.

ocean-sciences.name: One-dimensional upper ocean mixing models
ocean-sciences.gist: Implement and calibrate column models (bulk mixed layer, Price-Weller-Pinkel, KPP, k-epsilon) driven by surface fluxes, and compare simulated temperature and mixed layer evolution with observations.

ocean-sciences.name: Benthic boundary layers and eddy covariance fluxes
ocean-sciences.gist: Fit law-of-the-wall and drag coefficients to near-bed velocity profiles, and derive benthic oxygen or heat fluxes from high-rate eddy covariance data with despiking, coordinate rotation and time-lag correction.

ocean-sciences.name: Thermohaline circulation box models
ocean-sciences.gist: Build Stommel-type and multi-box overturning models as ODE systems and explore multiple equilibria, hysteresis, freshwater forcing thresholds and bifurcation structure numerically.

ocean-sciences.name: Water mass transformation and formation rates
ocean-sciences.gist: Apply Walin-type density-space frameworks to surface fluxes and interior mixing to compute transformation and formation rates, subduction rates and potential vorticity diagnostics of mode waters.

ocean-sciences.name: Dense water overflows and open-ocean convection
ocean-sciences.gist: Model overflow plumes with streamtube and entrainment parameterizations, and diagnose deep convection depth and dense water volume from profiles and surface buoyancy loss.

ocean-sciences.name: Hydrographic box inverse methods
ocean-sciences.gist: Set up and solve underdetermined inverse problems for reference-level velocities across closed hydrographic sections with conservation constraints, using SVD, Gauss-Markov estimation and solution resolution analysis.

ocean-sciences.name: Steric sea level and sea level budget closure
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute thermosteric and halosteric sea level from profile data and combine them with ocean mass and altimetry estimates to close regional and global sea level budgets with uncertainty propagation.

ocean-sciences.name: Sea level rise projections and coastal flood allowances
ocean-sciences.gist: Combine probabilistic sea level projections with extreme water level distributions to compute expected flooding frequency amplification, design allowances and inundation extents on coastal elevation grids.

ocean-sciences.name: Wind-wave generation and spectral wave modelling
ocean-sciences.gist: Apply fetch- and duration-limited growth laws, fit JONSWAP and Pierson-Moskowitz spectra, and integrate simplified action balance equations with wind input, whitecapping and nonlinear source terms.

ocean-sciences.name: Wave setup, runup and overtopping
ocean-sciences.gist: Estimate surf-zone setup, wave runup exceedance levels and overtopping discharge at beaches and structures with empirical formulas, swash time series analysis and probabilistic design calculations.

ocean-sciences.name: Wave loads and floating body response
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute wave forces on offshore structures with Morison and diffraction approximations, response amplitude operators, and the spectral response and fatigue of moored or floating bodies in random seas.

ocean-sciences.name: Marine renewable energy resource assessment
ocean-sciences.gist: Quantify wave and tidal stream power resources, combine converter power matrices with sea-state statistics, and estimate annual energy yield, variability and array siting constraints.

ocean-sciences.name: HF radar surface current mapping
ocean-sciences.gist: Combine radial velocities from coastal HF radar sites into vector current maps with least-squares or open-boundary modal analysis, assessing geometric dilution of precision and validating against drifters or moorings.

ocean-sciences.name: Satellite scatterometer and SAR ocean observations
ocean-sciences.gist: Retrieve ocean surface winds from backscatter with geophysical model functions, estimate wave spectra from SAR imagery, and detect slicks, fronts or internal wave signatures in radar images.

ocean-sciences.name: Sea surface salinity and river plume dynamics
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse satellite and in situ surface salinity to map freshwater plumes, compute freshwater content and E-P budgets, and model buoyant coastal currents and plume spreading.

ocean-sciences.name: Underwater light field and radiative transfer
ocean-sciences.gist: Derive diffuse attenuation coefficients, euphotic depth and PAR profiles from radiometer casts, and solve simplified in-water radiative transfer models relating inherent and apparent optical properties.

ocean-sciences.name: Radium isotopes and trace element scavenging
ocean-sciences.gist: Use radium quartet, thorium and other radionuclide profiles to estimate coastal mixing rates, water ages and particle scavenging rates with advection-diffusion and reversible-exchange models.

ocean-sciences.name: Dissolved organic matter fluorescence analysis
ocean-sciences.gist: Process excitation-emission matrix spectra with blank subtraction, scatter removal and inner-filter correction, decompose them with PARAFAC, and compute optical indices of DOM sources and degradation.

ocean-sciences.name: Dissolved gases and net community production
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute gas saturation states from solubility functions, and estimate net community production and physical gas fluxes from O2/Ar, noble gas or N2 measurements with mixed layer mass balance models.

ocean-sciences.name: Plankton size spectra and imaging data
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse particle and plankton size distributions from imaging or optical counters, fit normalized biomass size spectra, and classify plankton images or features for abundance estimates.

ocean-sciences.name: Fisheries oceanography and habitat modelling
ocean-sciences.gist: Relate catch, survey or tracking data to environmental fields with GAMs and species distribution models, compute habitat indices, and assess climate-driven range shifts.

ocean-sciences.name: Underwater acoustic communication channels
ocean-sciences.gist: Characterize and simulate multipath, Doppler-spread underwater acoustic channels, and implement channel estimation, synchronization and equalization for underwater modem signals.

ocean-sciences.name: Sub-bottom and seismic reflection profiling
ocean-sciences.gist: Process chirp and boomer sub-bottom or marine seismic data with matched filtering, heave correction, gain and migration, and pick sediment horizons and compute layer thicknesses.

ocean-sciences.name: Underwater noise impact assessment
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute sound exposure levels, peak pressures and frequency-weighted cumulative exposure from pile driving, airgun or ship sources, and estimate impact ranges against marine animal threshold criteria.

ocean-sciences.name: Real-time ocean data QC and standards
ocean-sciences.gist: Implement automated QARTOD-style quality tests (range, spike, rate of change, flat line, climatology) for buoy and observatory streams, and convert and validate data against CF/ACDD NetCDF conventions.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean model numerics and parameterizations
ocean-sciences.gist: Test tracer advection schemes, vertical coordinates, spurious numerical mixing and eddy parameterizations (Gent-McWilliams, Redi) in idealized ocean model configurations with convergence and conservation diagnostics.

ocean-sciences.name: Ice shelf-ocean interaction
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute basal melt rates with three-equation boundary formulations and buoyant meltwater plume models, and diagnose sub-ice-shelf circulation and melt sensitivity to ocean temperature.

ocean-sciences.name: Marine contaminant fate and transport
ocean-sciences.gist: Quantify how pollutants released into the sea are transported, transformed and removed, and what exposure results. Pollutants include hydrocarbons, dissolved chemicals, radionuclides, pathogens, nutrients from accidental discharges and legacy contaminants. Processes include advection-diffusion, decay and degradation kinetics, volatilization, sediment-water partitioning, bioaccumulation, and mass-balance or exposure budgets. Methods include box and compartment models, Eulerian or Lagrangian transport simulations, parameter fitting to monitoring data, source inversion, and risk or impact estimation.

ocean-sciences.name: Tropical cyclone ocean response
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse and model the upper ocean response to hurricanes, including cold wakes, near-inertial current generation, mixed layer deepening and heat content loss, from floats, moorings and simple models.

ocean-sciences.name: Internal solitary waves and KdV theory
ocean-sciences.gist: Fit Korteweg-de Vries and extended KdV soliton solutions to observed internal wave packets, compute nonlinear and dispersive coefficients from stratification, and simulate their evolution over topography.

ocean-sciences.name: Marine carbon dioxide removal assessment
ocean-sciences.gist: Quantify the efficiency and detectability of ocean alkalinity enhancement or other marine CDR interventions using carbonate chemistry, air-sea equilibration timescales and monitoring signal-to-noise analysis.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean bottom pressure and barotropic mass variability
ocean-sciences.gist: Process bottom pressure recorder and satellite gravimetry records: remove instrument drift and tides, then estimate barotropic transport fluctuations, ocean mass changes and basin-scale bottom pressure modes.

ocean-sciences.name: Infragravity waves and harbour oscillations
ocean-sciences.gist: Separate infragravity energy from wind-sea and swell in pressure or elevation records, relate it to group-bound wave theory, and compute harbour or basin resonance modes and amplification factors.

ocean-sciences.name: Nearshore wave-driven currents
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute radiation stress gradients, longshore current profiles (Longuet-Higgins-type), undertow and rip current flows from surf-zone wave data or simple 1D/2D nearshore circulation models.

ocean-sciences.name: Coral reef and seagrass ecosystem metabolism
ocean-sciences.gist: Estimate net community calcification and production in reef or seagrass systems from alkalinity and DIC anomalies, flow respirometry, and residence-time-corrected mass balances.

ocean-sciences.name: Buoyant jets and outfall dilution
ocean-sciences.gist: Model near-field dilution of wastewater, brine or thermal discharges with integral jet-plume entrainment equations in stratified crossflows, and design diffuser configurations to meet dilution standards.

ocean-sciences.name: Hydrothermal plumes and vent fluxes
ocean-sciences.gist: Detect hydrothermal plumes in turbidity, redox and temperature anomaly profiles, apply Morton-Taylor-Turner plume theory to infer source heat flux, and estimate chemical fluxes from vent fields.

ocean-sciences.name: Sediment porewater diagenesis modelling
ocean-sciences.gist: Fit reaction-transport models to porewater profiles of oxygen, nitrate, sulfate, methane and metals to derive organic matter degradation rates, benthic fluxes and bioirrigation coefficients.

ocean-sciences.name: Trace metal speciation and ligand titrations
ocean-sciences.gist: Fit competitive ligand exchange titration data for metal-binding ligand concentrations and conditional stability constants, and compute inorganic and organic speciation of iron, copper and other trace metals.

ocean-sciences.name: Isotope fractionation in marine nutrient and carbon cycles
ocean-sciences.gist: Apply Rayleigh and steady-state isotope fractionation models and isotope mass balances to nitrate d15N, d18O, DIC d13C or Si isotopes to quantify assimilation, nitrification and denitrification.

ocean-sciences.name: Seawater analytical chemistry data reduction
ocean-sciences.gist: Reduce raw laboratory measurements, such as alkalinity titration curves by nonlinear least squares or Gran methods, spectrophotometric pH, Winkler oxygen and autoanalyzer nutrient runs, with calibration, blank and reference-material corrections.

ocean-sciences.name: Marine food web and ecosystem models
ocean-sciences.gist: Build mass-balanced food web models (Ecopath-type), size-structured or trophic ecosystem ODE models, and compute trophic levels, energy transfer efficiencies and responses to fishing or warming.

ocean-sciences.name: Marine plastic debris budgets and inverse sourcing
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse net-tow and beach survey abundance data with sampling statistics and windage and mixing corrections, and build mass budgets or inverse estimates of debris sources and sinks.

ocean-sciences.name: Stokes drift and Langmuir circulation
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute Stokes drift profiles from directional wave spectra, the turbulent Langmuir number and wave-enhanced mixing, and evaluate their effects on surface transport and mixed layer turbulence.

ocean-sciences.name: Strait exchange flows and hydraulic control
ocean-sciences.gist: Apply two-layer and rotating hydraulic theory to sill and strait flows to compute composite Froude numbers, maximal exchange transports and hydraulic jumps from sections or idealized models.

ocean-sciences.name: Topographic lee waves and bottom form drag
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute lee wave generation, energy flux and form drag for geostrophic or tidal flow over rough topography with linear theory on bathymetry spectra, and diagnose wave breaking and associated mixing.

ocean-sciences.name: Laboratory geophysical fluid dynamics experiments
ocean-sciences.gist: Process rotating-tank and stratified-flume experiments with particle image velocimetry, dye and conductivity-probe data to measure velocities, interface positions and dimensionless scaling relationships.

ocean-sciences.name: Coastal video imaging and nearshore bathymetry inversion
ocean-sciences.gist: Rectify coastal camera imagery, extract shorelines and timestack signals, and invert wave celerity or optical satellite imagery for shallow-water bathymetry with uncertainty estimates.

ocean-sciences.name: Gap filling and reconstruction of ocean fields
ocean-sciences.gist: Reconstruct cloud-gapped satellite or sparse historical ocean fields with DINEOF, reduced-space EOF reconstruction or statistical learning, and cross-validate reconstruction errors.

ocean-sciences.name: Marine spatial planning and protected area design
ocean-sciences.gist: Formulate reserve selection and ocean zoning as integer or heuristic optimization problems that balance biodiversity targets, connectivity, fisheries costs and other spatial constraints on gridded habitat data.

ocean-sciences.name: Ocean-aware ship and vehicle route optimization
ocean-sciences.gist: Compute minimum-time or minimum-energy routes for ships, gliders and AUVs through forecast current and wave fields with Zermelo-type, graph-search or level-set methods under seakeeping constraints.

ocean-sciences.name: Underwater vehicle navigation and acoustic positioning
ocean-sciences.gist: Estimate AUV and towed-body trajectories by fusing DVL, inertial, depth and LBL or USBL acoustic ranges with Kalman filters, smoothing and outlier rejection, and quantify navigation drift.

ocean-sciences.name: Waves in sea ice and the marginal ice zone
ocean-sciences.gist: Estimate wave attenuation rates and dispersion changes in ice-covered seas from buoy arrays or models, and relate them to floe size distributions and wave-induced ice breakup.

ocean-sciences.name: Sea ice drift and dynamics
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse ice drift from buoys or satellite motion products with free-drift momentum balances, wind factor and turning angle estimation, ice-ocean drag and simple rheology models.

ocean-sciences.name: Iceberg drift and melt modelling
ocean-sciences.gist: Simulate iceberg trajectories driven by wind, current, wave radiation and Coriolis forces, and model basal, lateral and wave-erosion melt with freshwater flux estimates compared against tracked icebergs.

ocean-sciences.name: Animal-borne sensors and acoustic telemetry
ocean-sciences.gist: Process CTD tags carried by marine mammals, dive records and acoustic telemetry detections to calibrate profiles, reconstruct animal positions and detection ranges, and derive behaviour-environment relationships.

ocean-sciences.name: Phytoplankton photophysiology and active fluorescence
ocean-sciences.gist: Fit fast repetition rate and PAM fluorescence induction curves for Fv/Fm, functional absorption cross-section and electron transport rates, and correct for non-photochemical quenching in fluorescence data.

ocean-sciences.name: Shelf sea fronts and tidal mixing
ocean-sciences.gist: Predict tidal mixing front positions with Simpson-Hunter stratification parameters, and compute potential energy anomaly budgets and seasonal stratification cycles in shelf seas from moorings and simple models.

ocean-sciences.name: Deliberate tracer and dye release experiments
ocean-sciences.gist: Analyse spreading of injected SF6, CF3SF5 or rhodamine dye in surveys to estimate diapycnal and isopycnal diffusivities from second moments, advection-diffusion fits and survey sampling corrections.

ocean-sciences.name: Conceptual ENSO and coupled ocean-atmosphere models
ocean-sciences.gist: Implement recharge, delayed and stochastically forced oscillator models of ENSO, fit their parameters to observed indices, and analyse stability, periodicity and predictability.

ocean-sciences.name: Neutral density and equation of state nonlinearity
ocean-sciences.gist: Construct neutral density and approximately neutral surfaces, quantify cabbeling, thermobaricity and spiciness, and diagnose the dianeutral transport that nonlinearities of the seawater equation of state cause.
